title: Query Cost Model Calibration in Confidential Virtual Machines
summary: With the growing adoption of Confidential Computing, running databases in confidential virtual machines (CVMs) such as AMD SEV-SNP has become an attractive way to protect sensitive cloud data with minimal changes to legacy DBMSs. However, analytical queries in such CVMs often suffer substantial overhead, and prior database work has largely stopped at benchmarking these slowdowns rather than optimizing them. We show that this problem stems from a hardware-software mismatch: query optimizers still rely on KVM-oriented (non-encrypted VM) cost assumptions that no longer hold in CVMs. To address this, we propose a lightweight CVM-aware cost calibration. It models two dominant sources of optimizer-facing overhead: data movement and RMP-related translation using simple physical proxies already available to the optimizer. Experiments show that the calibration significantly narrows the KVM/CVM performance gap, recovering up to 48 percent performance and even outperforming the KVM baseline on some workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机密虚拟机（CVM，如 AMD SEV-SNP）中数据库查询优化器成本模型失准的问题，提出一种轻量级的 CVM 感知成本校准方法，通过在 PostgreSQL 优化器的算子成本公式中注入数据移动开销和 RMP 相关翻译开销两项惩罚项，使优化器在 CVM 环境下选择更合理的执行计划，实验表明可最高恢复 48% 的性能。
AI.motivation: 机密计算虽能在不修改遗留 DBMS 的前提下保护敏感数据，但 CVM 中分析查询存在显著性能开销。现有研究多止步于基准测试这种性能损失，而忽视了根本原因：查询优化器仍沿用 KVM（非加密 VM）下的成本假设，导致硬件（SEV-SNP 的加密、完整性保护机制）与软件（成本模型）之间存在不匹配。作者通过实验识别出两类主要开销——数据移动开销（bounce-buffer、加密内存传输）和 RMP 检查开销（地址翻译与保护内存访问验证带来的 CPI 膨胀），并证明这些开销对不同算子（如 hash join 与 nested-loop join）的影响是高度非均匀的，会导致优化器在 CVM 中误选执行计划。
AI.method: 方法核心是在 PostgreSQL 优化器原有算子成本公式基础上，叠加两个 CVM 感知开销项：(1) 数据移动成本 datamovecost(ws, x) = ws · η_dm · σ(x)，其中 ws 为工作集（基于页数或元组×宽度估算），x 为超出缓存容量的溢出因子，σ(x) 为激活函数；(2) RMP 相关翻译成本 rmptcost(a, x) = a · η_rmp · (1 + α_rmp · σ(x))，其中 a 反映页访问强度与局部性。两类算子分别建模：顺序扫描、位图扫描、物化等以数据移动开销为主；索引扫描、嵌套循环连接（带索引探测）、哈希连接（构建 hash 表超 L3 时）则同时考虑两种开销。算子级公式如表 2 所示（如 Index scan 加上 rows_out·H(I) 作为索引树访问代理）。参数 η_dm、η_rmp、α_rmp、ε 等通过在每个工作负载三分之一查询上逐参数调优获得。该方法仅修改优化器成本估算逻辑，不增加执行期机制，开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在 PostgreSQL 16.9 + AMD EPYC 7413（64 GiB，32 vCPUs）的 SEV-SNP 环境中评估四个 OLAP 工作负载：JOB 节省 6.90%（318.63s → 296.63s），CEB 节省 17.14%（780.51s → 646.71s），Stack 节省 48.35%（354.72s → 183.20s），TPC-DS 节省 3.54%（4049.78s → 3906.28s）。在 CEB 和 Stack 上甚至超越 KVM 基线执行时间（677.16s 与 329.53s）。改善的查询占比：JOB 43.4%、CEB 38.8%、Stack 62.5%、TPC-DS 44.4%。延迟分布方面，Stack 的中位延迟从 0.71s 降至 0.53s，标准差从 7.00s 压缩至 2.24s，最大延迟从 50.80s 降至 13.84s，长尾显著改善。差异源于不同工作负载对算子选择与成本建模的敏感度不同。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的轻量级 CVM 感知成本校准通过在查询优化器中注入针对数据移动和 RMP 检查两项开销的惩罚，使 PostgreSQL 在 SEV-SNP 环境下显著缩小与 KVM 的性能差距，最多可恢复 48% 性能，并在部分工作负载上超越非加密 KVM 基线。结论指出该方法虽不追求穷尽式优化，但证明合理的成本模型校准是提升 CVM 中数据库性能的有效途径，未来工作可结合工作负载自适应参数调优及与基数估计等其他 DBMS 组件的更深度集成以获得更大端到端收益。

title: 3D Spatial Pattern Matching
summary: Spatial pattern matching is the process of matching query entities and constraints with database entities and relations. It has many applications, including similar region search, housing market search, landmark search, and road network matching. To our knowledge, all existing spatial pattern matching approaches frame the problem in a 2 dimensional space, where entities lie in a cartesian plane and relationships defined between them are contained in 2 dimensions. However, this problem framing has significant limitations when searching for real world entities that have height in addition to position. To address this limitation, we extend spatial pattern matching to 3 dimensions and provide a generalized definition of the problem. We describe a subgraph matching algorithm capable of resolving 3D spatial patterns over distance relations and release two 3D spatial pattern matching datasets, one synthetic and one containing real 3D building data from the city of Hamburg, Germany. We test our subgraph matching algorithm on both datasets and present results as a baseline for future methods to build upon.

AI.tldr: 本文将空间模式匹配（Spatial Pattern Matching）从传统的二维空间扩展到三维空间，提出了三维空间模式匹配问题的通用定义，并设计了一种基于子图匹配的算法来处理三维距离关系，同时发布了合成数据集与汉堡市真实三维建筑数据集，为后续研究提供基线。
AI.motivation: 现有空间模式匹配方法均局限于二维平面，无法有效表达和处理具有高度信息的三维实体（如建筑物、地形等），难以满足真实世界中三维空间查询的需求。
AI.method: 1. 将空间模式匹配问题形式化扩展到三维空间，给出通用化的问题定义；2. 基于距离关系（distance relations）设计一种子图匹配（subgraph matching）算法，用于解析三维空间模式；3. 构建并发布两个三维数据集：一个合成数据集 + 一个源自德国汉堡市真实三维建筑数据的数据集。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与汉堡真实三维建筑数据集上对所提子图匹配算法进行了测试，给出了基线性能结果，为后续三维空间模式匹配方法的改进与比较提供参考。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将空间模式匹配问题推广到三维空间，验证了在三维场景下进行空间模式匹配的可行性，并通过开源数据集与基线结果为该研究方向奠定了基础。

title: EcoTable: Cost-effective Table Integration in Data Lakes for Natural Language Queries
summary: The diverse formats of CSV and Parquet files in data lakes pose a significant challenge to traditional ETL, which relies on data engineers to pre-define a target database schema and build a complex pipeline for data integration. Moreover, with this approach, the integrated data often cannot support various analytical needs, as the predefined schema does not necessarily satisfy the table format or join relationships required to answer unforeseen queries. To address this, we propose EcoTable, the first natural language-based data integration framework. Given a set of user-specified natural language queries, EcoTable automatically integrates the tables into a form that adequately supports the corresponding SQL queries. EcoTable achieves this by leveraging the semantic understanding and complex reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Moreover, EcoTable addresses the scalability and cost issues introduced by expensive LLM inferences with a set of novel ideas. First, EcoTable introduces a graph to represent the overall search space, where nodes represent tables and edges carry weights indicating join likelihood produced by a lightweight deep learning model. On top of this graph data structure, EcoTable designs three components to achieve our goal: (1) the table identification layer aims to identify relevant tables via a two-stage schema linking based on user queries; (2) the graph-based validation layer aims to discover significant join paths, including necessary data transformations and bridging tables, by modeling the problem as Steiner tree searches; and (3) the table transformation layer generates transformation code to implement the joins using LLMs. We construct 4 real-world benchmark datasets with more than 200 queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EcoTable outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines, increasing accuracy by more than 30% and cutting LLM invocation costs by 5 times.

AI.tldr: EcoTable是首个基于自然语言的数据湖表集成框架，通过结合轻量级深度学习模型与大语言模型（LLM），自动将数据湖中的CSV/Parquet表集成为支持用户NL查询的SQL可查询形式，在保证高准确率的同时显著降低LLM调用成本（准确率提升30%以上，成本降低5倍）。
AI.motivation: 传统ETL流程依赖数据工程师手动预定义目标数据库schema并构建复杂的数据集成管道，存在两大核心问题：(1)难以预定义满足多样化分析需求的schema；(2)预定义schema无法满足未预见的查询所需的表格式和连接关系，且手动集成工作量大。不同查询对schema的需求不同，使得通用schema难以适配所有分析场景。
AI.method: EcoTable采用三层架构：(1)**表识别层**：通过两阶段schema链接（轻量PLM粗筛+LLM精筛）识别查询相关表；(2)**基于图的验证层**：构建全连接图（节点为表，边权重为轻量DL模型输出的连接可能性），将连接路径发现问题建模为Steiner树搜索问题，利用t-spanner算法剪枝缩小搜索空间，并通过迭代LLM验证（带多数投票机制）精化连接路径；(3)**表转换层**：使用ReAct风格的LLM代理自动生成转换代码（支持Normalize、Split、Pivot三种操作），并基于边着色算法实现可并行的转换执行。此外还提出了关键边的多数投票机制和图基并行化策略以进一步降低成本和延迟。
AI.result: 在4个真实工业基准数据集和1个大规模合成数据湖（NYC Data Lake，含1214张表、800个查询）上，EcoTable在连接路径F1分数上达到79.2%（Ad数据集），相比Auto-BI提升超过30个百分点；在Text-to-SQL端到端任务中，结合ReFoRCE等模型可显著提升SQL执行成功率；在成本上比贪心基线降低约5.3倍，比纯LLM方法在NYC大规模场景下更具鲁棒性（NYC上F1为65% vs LOE的52%）。同时验证了两阶段表识别、图基验证、ReAct转换和并行策略各组件的有效性，并分析了语义错误、领域知识错误和语法错误三类LLM失败模式。
AI.conclusion: EcoTable通过将轻量DL模型与LLM结合、以Steiner树搜索为核心的图基框架，成功实现了低成本、高质量、查询驱动的数据湖表集成。其核心贡献在于：(1)首次提出自然语言驱动的表集成系统；(2)基于Steiner树优化和t-spanner剪枝的高效连接路径发现；(3)ReAct风格转换代码生成与图基并行化策略；(4)4个真实基准数据集+大规模NYC数据湖（共200+查询）的系统评估。局限性：当前主要处理无环连接图，未充分探索含环连接图及表对间多连接关系等更复杂场景。

title: BtrLog: Low-Latency Logging for Cloud Database Systems
summary: Cloud database systems cannot rely on instance-local disks for write-ahead logging (WAL) durability, forcing WAL onto remote storage. Existing options are unsatisfying: remote block storage like EBS is easy to adopt but adds substantial write latency and cost, while object storage offers excellent durability and low storage cost but is impractical for OLTP due to high latency and per-append cost. Many cloud-native databases, therefore, depend on purpose-built logging backends, which are typically proprietary and tightly coupled to engine-specific replication and recovery protocols, limiting reuse. We present BtrLog, a reusable cloud logging service that combines low-latency durable appends with low-cost archival for the common single-writer architecture. BtrLog replicates log records across a quorum of SSD-backed log nodes in a single network round trip, reducing sensitivity to stragglers in commit latency. To minimize storage cost, log nodes archive records to object storage as large segments, which are written asynchronously and off the latency-critical write path. In our evaluation, BtrLog achieves lower latency than EBS and enables higher end-to-end transaction throughput when integrated into a DBMS.

AI.tldr: BtrLog 是一种可复用的云原生日志服务，专为单写入者架构设计，通过 SSD 日志节点仲裁复制实现低延迟持久化追加，并异步归档至对象存储以降低存储成本，在延迟和事务吞吐量上优于 EBS。
AI.motivation: 云数据库无法依赖本地磁盘保证 WAL 持久性，必须写入远端存储。然而现有方案各有缺陷：远程块存储（如 EBS）写延迟高、成本高；对象存储延迟过高且追加成本高，不适合 OLTP；专用日志后端多为专有且与特定引擎紧耦合，难以复用。因此需要一种兼顾低延迟、低成本且可复用的云日志方案。
AI.method: 针对常见的单写入者架构，BtrLog 设计两层日志机制：1) 在线写入路径：将日志记录通过单次网络往返复制到一组 SSD 日志节点的仲裁集群，降低对慢节点（straggler）的敏感性，实现低延迟持久化追加；2) 离线归档路径：日志节点将累积的记录以大段（segment）形式异步写入对象存储，绕开延迟敏感的写入关键路径，从而降低存储成本。该服务与具体数据库引擎解耦，可被复用。
AI.result: 在评估中，BtrLog 的日志延迟低于 EBS；当集成到 DBMS 中时，端到端事务吞吐量高于使用 EBS 作为 WAL 存储的方案。
AI.conclusion: BtrLog 通过 SSD 仲裁复制 + 对象存储异步归档的组合，为云数据库提供了一种兼具低延迟与低成本的通用 WAL 日志服务，在性能上超越了远程块存储方案，且具备良好的通用性与复用性。

title: Understanding Domain-Aware Distribution Alignment in Budgeted Entity Matching
summary: Entity Matching (EM) is a core operation in the data integration pipeline, where records from different sources are compared to determine whether they refer to the same real-world entity. Recent work has incorporated domain information and low-resource learning techniques to better adapt EM systems to realistic settings. While these approaches have demonstrated strong performance, it remains unclear how they behave under varying data constraints and levels of supervision in practice. In this paper, we investigate a state-of-the-art method for low-resource, domain-aware EM--BEACON--and study how its performance is affected by different algorithmic choices and data availability conditions. We conduct a series of targeted experiments to evaluate these variations, providing deeper insight into the role of distribution alignment and the behavior of the BEACON framework.

AI.tldr: 本文对BEACON中的TVDF分布对齐方法进行系统性分析，从标签感知、领域表示和领域无关下采样三个角度展开实验，揭示了质心表示的简洁有效性以及分布对齐在EMAD之外的实用价值。
AI.motivation: BEACON作为低资源、领域感知实体匹配（EMAD）的SOTA方法虽表现出色，但其核心TVDF分布对齐机制为何有效、在不同数据约束和监督水平下表现如何仍不清楚。需要深入理解分布对齐在实体匹配中的作用机制，以指导实际应用中的算法选择。
AI.method: 研究围绕三个维度展开：(1) 标签感知采样——在TVDF选择过程中引入ID/OOD标签信息，将正负样本分别作为独立分布进行对齐；(2) 替代领域表示——提出TVMed（中心点）、TVDF_VAR（质心+方差）和TVCoverage（覆盖度）三种替代TVDF的分布表示方法；(3) 领域无关下采样——将分布对齐应用于无领域划分的下采样任务，比较BASE、RANDOM、NC、NN和TVDF五种方法。实验在WDC基准上进行，使用RoBERTa作为骨干网络。
AI.result: (1) 标签感知实验：无监督TVDF略优于标签感知变体（宏F1均值0.716 vs 最佳0.700），但通过贪心策略在特定领域选择性使用标签信息可超越无监督基线；(2) 领域表示实验：简单质心表示的TVDF在宏F1（均值0.716）和加权F1（均值0.719）上均最佳，复杂表示未带来性能提升；(3) 领域无关下采样：TVDF（平均F1 0.736）在多数数据集上优于随机下采样（0.712）、NN（0.679）和NC（0.324），且在Amazon-Google上甚至超越全量训练（0.727 vs 0.697）。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现：(1) 标签信息在选择性应用时对TVDF有提升作用，但对小领域可能产生负面影响；(2) 尽管质心表示简单，但它在实际中捕获了最有效的分布结构，复杂表示反而引入噪声；(3) TVDF的分布对齐机制可作为有效的无监督下采样策略，在不依赖领域结构的情况下显著缓解数据缩减带来的性能损失，超越随机和近邻方法。该工作为低资源实体匹配中分布感知学习的后续研究奠定了基础。

title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features
summary: Interpreting and controlling model behaviors through activation steering methods requires many pairs of contrastive samples that clearly exhibit desired or undesired behavior. These data pairs determine the degree to which interpretability frameworks can reliably detect model features responsible for a behavior, and therefore the ability to steer models toward or away from such behavior. In this work, we present an iterative data generation pipeline that isolates cascading linear features responsible for a behavior. Specifically, we show how moving beyond simple binary pairs of samples, and instead isolating samples that show degrees of features that scale linearly with behavior, allows for better disentanglement of features. We focus on detecting and steering away from sycophancy -- the tendency of language models to prioritize user validation. We demonstrate that sycophancy features discovered through cascading samples form linearly separable subspaces, and allow for selection of model activations that more clearly correspond to the desired behavior than baseline approaches. We also evaluate their ability to enable detection, deterministic scoring, and robust steering, and see that they either match or outperform LLM-as-a-judge and system prompting baselines while providing lower computational demand and more interpretability guarantees. AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种迭代数据生成流水线，通过"级联样本"（cascading samples）而非简单的二元对比样本来分离模型行为（如谄媚行为）所对应的线性特征，从而在可解释性和行为控制方面优于LLM-as-a-judge和系统提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导（activation steering）方法依赖于大量二元对比样本对来识别和控制模型行为，但这种二元数据难以有效分离导致特定行为的多个纠缠特征，限制了可解释性框架的可靠性以及行为引导的精度。
AI.method: 1. 提出迭代式数据生成流水线，逐步隔离出与目标行为呈线性缩放关系的"级联样本"（而非简单正/负二元对）；2. 在特征空间中识别谄媚（sycophancy）相关特征，并验证其形成线性可分子空间；3. 在谄媚行为检测、确定性评分和鲁棒引导任务上，将所提方法与LLM-as-a-judge和系统提示基线进行对比。
AI.result: 通过级联样本发现的谄媚特征构成了线性可分子空间，激活选择更精确对应目标行为；在检测、评分和引导任务上，所提方法与LLM-as-a-judge和系统提示基线表现相当或更优，同时具备更低的计算开销和更强的可解释性保证。
AI.conclusion: 超越二元对比样本、采用具有线性特征梯度的级联样本，能够更好地解耦模型内部特征，为行为检测、评分与引导提供更高效、可解释的方案，尤其在谄媚行为上验证了其有效性。

title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench
summary: When a benchmark's accuracy saturates, it is often retired and replaced with a more challenging version. We show that this approach privileges accuracy and misses the opportunity to study six other key dimensions of agent performance: construct validity issues such as shortcuts, out-of-distribution generalizability, efficiency, reliability, the relative importance of the model versus the scaffold, and uplift from human-agent collaboration. We use CORE-Bench Hard, a benchmark for computational reproducibility of scientific code, as a case study to demonstrate that measuring agents along these dimensions yields meaningful insights into agent performance even after accuracy saturates. First, we surface threats to construct validity in CORE-Bench Hard that are difficult to anticipate with less capable agents. We introduce an improved benchmark, CORE-Bench v1.1, and an out-of-distribution task suite, CORE-Bench OOD. Second, we find that despite accuracy saturation, CORE-Bench v1.1 remains useful for measuring efficiency, reliability, model performance, and scaffold performance. Finally, we conduct a small-scale randomized experiment to measure uplift from human-agent collaboration on real-world computational reproducibility tasks. We find a statistically significant speedup by about a factor of two -- likely underestimated due to one-fifth of human-only reproductions reaching the time limit before completing -- and describe various other findings. Together, our contributions present a more rigorous alternative to the dominant accuracy-centric evaluation paradigm.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了AI智能体评估中"基准饱和即弃用替换"的传统范式，主张即使准确率饱和，基准仍可在构念效度、分布外泛化、效率、可靠性、模型与脚手架解耦、人机协作增益等维度提供有价值的洞见。论文以CORE-Bench为案例研究，发布改进版CORE-Bench v1.1（39个任务）和分布外套件CORE-Bench OOD（19个任务），并通过随机对照实验发现人机协作可将计算可复现性任务的完成时间缩短约一半（2.11倍加速，p=0.00176）。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体评估普遍采用单一"准确率"指标，当顶尖智能体在基准上趋于天花板成绩且统计上无法区分时，领域惯常做法是弃用旧基准并替换为更困难的版本（"retire-and-replace"模式）。作者认为这种做法过度偏重准确率，忽视了智能体性能的其他关键维度（如构念效度、效率、可靠性、模型与脚手架的相对贡献、人机协作的实际价值），导致对智能体真实能力的理解不充分。论文旨在通过CORE-Bench案例证明，准确率饱和并不等于基准饱和。
AI.method: 1. 构念效度分析：使用Docent工具对CORE-Bench Hard的45个原始任务和27个新候选任务进行自动+人工日志分析，识别任务级错误和可被利用的捷径；构建CORE-Bench v1.1（39个任务）和CORE-Bench OOD（覆盖物理、工程、经济、计算机科学等新学科的19个任务）。2. 多维度评估：在Codex CLI、Claude Code、OpenCode、CORE-Agent四种脚手架上评估GPT-5系列、Claude Opus 4.5/4.6等多种模型（20次智能体运行），从可靠性（结果一致性、资源一致性、校准、判别力）、效率（token用量与美元成本）、模型-脚手架解耦三个角度分析。3. 人机协作随机实验：5名评估者在20篇ML和社会科学论文上各复现10次（有/无智能体协作各5次），共50次会话，使用固定效应模型估计协作增益效应，CR2标准误按评估者聚类。
AI.result: 1. 构念效度：在CORE-Bench Hard中发现15个任务级错误和20个存在可利用捷径的任务（其中4个重叠），如matplotlib默认颜色顺序猜图例标签、对CSV做简单行计数即得答案、非确定性脚本结果等。2. 准确率饱和依旧：v1.1上顶尖智能体达到97.4%–100%，前5名统计上不可区分；OOD上前5名也统计不可区分，表明饱和泛化到学科分布变化。3. 效率差异显著：GPT-5.3-Codex与GPT-5.4(high)准确率相同(97.4%)，但成本低约60%。4. 可靠性差：智能体系统性地过度不自信（实证通过率93% vs 报告置信度32.1%），且无法通过置信度区分成功与失败。5. 脚手架影响巨大：同一Opus 4.5在CORE-Agent和OpenCode上准确率均为82.1%，但31%任务结果不一致；理论最优脚手架路由可达100%；直接修复策略成功率达95.2%，重写策略仅67.8%。6. 人机协作显著加速：固定效应模型估计手动复现耗时为人机协作的2.11倍（p=0.00176，CR2标准误0.09），1/5的纯人工会话在3小时时限内未完成，而人机协作均完成；25次人机会话中19次由智能体完全自主完成。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出应将"准确率饱和"与"基准饱和"解耦：即使准确率不再具区分力，基准仍可有效测量效率、可靠性、模型-脚手架贡献和人机协作增益等维度，从而为部署决策提供比单一准确率更丰富的信息。论文主张以CORE-Bench v1.1和CORE-Bench OOD作为持续维护的活跃基准，并呼吁社区超越"弃用替换"范式，转向多维度、以人为本的评估方法。

title: Refusal Lives Downstream of Persona in Chat Models
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability workshop
summary: Linear directions in activation space have been identified for both refusal and persona traits in instruction-tuned chat models, but the two have been studied as separate mechanisms. We show they interact: a compliant persona gates refusal. In Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we extract a compliant model-persona direction and a refusal direction and intervene on both. Compliant persona steering suppresses refusal -- in Llama, the refusal rate falls from 97% to 2%. Reintroducing the refusal direction partially restores refusal at late layers but not at early ones. Projecting out the persona direction in a late-layer window restores it to baseline; projecting out a random direction does not. Refusal is therefore gated at the late-layer expression stage, downstream of where it is computed. Treating refusal as a single isolated direction misses its dependence on persona.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了指令调优聊天模型中"拒绝"行为与"模型人格"之间的因果交互机制：顺从型人格(compliant persona)在网络后层(gating)抑制拒绝表达,而非在早期计算阶段消除拒绝信号。
AI.motivation: 先前工作(Arditi et al., 2024)将"拒绝"视为残差流中的单一方向向量,但拒绝机制与人格(persona)通常作为独立机制被研究。本文旨在探究二者在层级中如何交互,尤其关注 Lee 等人(2025)未充分考察的拒绝管线第三阶段——后层表达阶段。核心假设是:将拒绝视为孤立方向会忽略其对人格表征的依赖。
AI.method: 1. 模型:Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。2. 方向向量提取:用对比均值差从残差流激活中提取顺从型人格方向 v_MP、拒绝方向 r̂(遵循 Arditi et al.)与助手轴 v_A(遵循 Lu et al.)。3. 因果干预:(a) 加性引导 h_ℓ ← h_ℓ + α·v;(b) 投影敲除 h_ℓ ← h_ℓ - ⟨h_ℓ, d̂⟩d̂;(c) 张力实验同时注入 v_MP 与拒绝方向。4. 评估:在 313 条 StrongREJECT 提示上做三分类(拒绝/绕过/退化),辅以 StrongREJECT ASR、Llama-Guard-3 不安全率、GPT-4o 泄露评分。5. 行为验证:对八种关系特征做人格引导,验证其编码真实行为而非表面风格。
AI.result: 1. 几何层面:v_MP 与 r̂ 近正交(cos ≈ -0.18 至 -0.28),v_MP 与助手轴也近正交(cos ≈ +0.10 至 +0.13),排除激活空间直接抵消的平凡解释。2. 行为签名:八种对立特征产生近似镜像的敌意/情感调谐/连贯性梯度,证实人格向量编码真实行为倾向。3. 安全实验(Llama):基线拒绝率 97.4%,顺从人格引导后跌至 1.6%(bypass 42.2%, degenerate 56.2%)。4. 因果定位:在 L20 投影敲除 v_MP 将拒绝恢复至 96.8%;投影敲除随机方向仍为 1.6%。早期拒绝加法(L14)无法恢复,晚期加法(L22/L24)部分恢复。5. 层扫描:效果集中在 L20–L22 窄窗口,L18 与 L24 失败,表明这是一个"后层带"而非单层。6. Qwen 表现出相同模式(L20–L22)。7. 早期拒绝加法+敲除的组合在两个模型间不一致,因此主要中介性结论基于"MP-only vs. MP-only+敲除"的直接对比。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝不是自包含的安全机制,而是由后层表达阶段的人格表征门控的行为。拒绝方向被两个不同的控制点夹在中间:(1) Lee 等人识别的、由内容驱动的上游计算,决定"是否写入"拒绝;(2) 本文识别的、由身份驱动的下游门控,决定"是否表达"拒绝。安全微调产生拒绝方向,但其表达取决于下游的、身份层面的表征。将拒绝视为孤立机制的分析会遗漏这种依赖性。局限:仅在 7–8B 指令调优模型上验证;中介窗口因模型而异;判定器依赖模型化评判;识别的是方向级中介,非完整电路。

title: AlgoEvolve: LLM-driven Meta-evolution of Algorithmic Trading Programs
summary: Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can act as semantic mutation operators for the evolutionary discovery of programs and proofs. Most current applications focus on static coding benchmarks. We extend this paradigm to algorithmic trading. This domain is uniquely challenging because it is noisy, non-stationary, and highly discontinuous. We present AlgoEvolve, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that generates, evaluates, and iteratively improves executable trading strategies. These strategies are expressed as Python code and evaluated through a rigorous testing protocol. Across multiple experiments, the system exhibits emergent regime-adaptive strategy logic, including autonomous shifts in trading rules. We further introduce a meta-evolutionary outer loop that evolves the prompts guiding program synthesis in the inner loop. This outer loop discovers improved search heuristics. These heuristics balance exploration and exploitation while reducing zero-trade failures. They consistently outperform initial human-designed instructions. The results demonstrate that LLM-based semantic evolution provides a viable approach for continual program synthesis in complex environments.

AI.tldr: AlgoEvolve提出了一种双层进化框架，将LLM作为语义变异算子用于算法交易策略的自动发现。框架包含内层循环（进化可执行Python交易策略）和外层循环（进化指导搜索的提示词基因组），通过Walk-Forward验证应对金融市场非平稳性，在20天基准测试中达到5.60的年化夏普比率和1.59%的最大回撤。
AI.motivation: 算法交易领域面临噪声大、非平稳、强不连续等挑战，传统参数化机器学习方法（深度学习、强化学习）存在黑箱性、易过拟合以及在突变制度下退化严重等问题。现有LLM在金融决策中多作为一次性生成器或静态预测器，未能充分利用其迭代推理能力。论文旨在将LLM作为语义变异算子引入进化计算框架，实现复杂非可微环境下的可解释、可自适应策略合成。
AI.method: 框架采用双层元进化架构：(1)内层循环——LLM作为语义变异算子，使用Chain-of-Thought提示策略，结合Top-2最佳/最差对比样本进行上下文学习，迭代生成并改进Python交易策略，通过复合适应度（总收益+一致性，α=0.7）进行Walk-Forward选择；(2)外层循环——将Evolver Prompt结构化为四基因"提示基因组"（mutation、focus、constraints、reasoning），通过"知情元变异"（基于性能报告由Meta-LLM重写单个基因）和"元交叉"进行进化。使用Gemini Pro进行提示优化、Gemini Flash进行策略生成的异构LLM架构。
AI.result: 在NUMIN平台5分钟K线数据上：AlgoEvolve（6元代）达到年化夏普5.60、最大回撤1.59%、均值日收益0.31%，相比Standard Evol基线（夏普5.71、收益0.10%）实现3倍收益提升；相比RF基线（回撤7.27%）和LSTM基线（亏损-0.05%）展现更优的制度适应性。系统自主从朴素阈值规则（RSI>70）进化到多因子加权评分架构，经历三个进化阶段：精炼范式（MG1-MG2）、韧性转向（MG3-MG4的V型恢复）、复杂度边界（MG5-MG6）。在MG3遭遇-1.59%回撤后，通过注入搜索多样性在MG4捕获2.53%的单日alpha事件，证实自主检测启发式失败并执行结构性转向的能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的语义进化为噪声、非可微、高维环境中的程序合成提供了可行路径。AlgoEvolve通过双层进化架构实现了对非平稳市场制度的自主适应，验证了LLM作为符号策略设计师（而非实时交易代理）的价值。未来工作可探索模块化程序合成，通过进化离散可复用子程序来克服观察到的复杂度天花板。

title: Agentic Analysis for Agentic Infrastructure: An LLM-Powered Pipeline for Comparative Governance of DAO and Corporate AI Protocols
summary: As AI agent protocols proliferate, the governance structures shaping their interoperability standards remain empirically underexamined. We introduce an LLM-powered comparative pipeline for large-scale governance discourse analysis, integrating automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to study socio-technical power structures at scale. We validate it on two contrasting standards for agent interoperability: ERC-8004 (permissionless, on-chain) and Google A2A (corporate-led). Analyzing 4,323 governance participation records, we combine LLM-assisted coding, topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to examine how institutional design shapes thematic priorities and community structure. We find that while governance form influences substantive focus, both regimes exhibit comparable levels of participation inequality and community fragmentation. Discourse alignment is denser in the permissionless setting, suggesting that open governance may foster greater thematic convergence despite decentralized participation. These findings illustrate how LLM-assisted methods can advance the empirical study of technology governance, with implications for designing more equitable agentic AI standards. All data and code are openly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的比较分析流水线，用于大规模治理话语研究，并将该方法应用于对比两种AI智能体互操作协议（去中心化的ERC-8004 DAO与公司主导的Google A2A）的治理结构。通过对4,323条治理参与记录进行LLM辅助编码、主题建模与多层网络分析，研究发现：两种治理形式塑造了不同的主题焦点（DAO聚焦信任与安全，公司协议聚焦工程执行），但均表现出相似的参与不平等与社区碎片化；ERC-8004的话语一致性密度更高，表明开放治理可能促进更强的议题趋同。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体协议的快速涌现，其互操作性标准的治理结构在实证层面尚未得到充分研究。现有文献多依赖人工编码与小样本分析，难以捕捉大规模公共话语中的权力结构与议题分布。本研究的核心动机在于回答一个核心问题：相比公司等级治理，DAO的开放治理是否真的实现了更高程度的去中心化？这一问题横跨AI治理与制度设计两个领域，具有重要的理论与实践意义。
AI.method: 研究采用"方法论三位一体"设计，对应三个子研究问题：(1) 从官方文档重构治理机制并绘制决策流程图；(2) 对4,323条治理记录进行LLM辅助标注（使用MiniMax-M2.5），标注字段包括利益相关方、论证类型、立场与共识信号；(3) 主题发现采用BERTopic与LLM归纳式Thematic-LM双方法；(4) 关系网络分析包含三层——共参与社交网络分析（SNA）、话语网络分析（DNA）、社会-语义二部网络。为验证鲁棒性，研究还扩展了34个ERC标准的语料库并采用多模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-4-Plus、Moonshot-v1-auto）交叉标注。
AI.result: 三大核心发现：(1) 决策架构层面，ERC-8004遵循"粗略共识+无许可部署"的EIP流程，A2A则将约束性权力集中在由企业代表组成的八人技术指导委员会（TSC）；(2) 话语构成层面，DAO话语高度集中于T08"信任与安全机制"（34.5%），而A2A话语分散于文档、SDK开发、协议传输等工程执行主题（BERTopic JSD=0.288，Thematic-LM JSD=0.216）；(3) 关系网络层面，两种网络的度基尼系数均超过0.77、均无显著核心-边缘结构，但ERC-8004的话语一致性密度（0.148）显著高于A2A（0.082），表明DAO社区内部形成了更紧密的立场共识。值得注意的是，ERC-8004前3位贡献者（MarcoMetaMask、spengrah、pcarranzav）贡献了32.3%的互动，其中来自MetaMask和Hats Protocol等DeFi生态。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三个层面的贡献：方法论上，提出了一套可推广至任意大规模治理话语分析的LLM辅助流水线；实证上，提供了DAO与公司治理在AI标准化领域的首个匹配案例、多方法比较；理论上，揭示了"去中心化悖论"——无论治理形式如何，决策权都集中在少数持续参与的精英手中，DAO的去中心化仅在准入权利层面实现，常规决策权威通过声誉积累集中于"留在房间里的人"。研究对标准制定机构、协议架构师与政策制定者提出了具体建议：开放准入权利需配以程序性问责机制；议程本身即为设计产物，应定期审计"未被讨论的议题"；采纳标准时应同时审视其协商记录而非仅关注规范文本。局限性包括：ERC-8004样本量（142条）较小置信区间较宽；A2A的TSC内部会议与Google内部设计评审发生在公开记录之外，可能低估公司治理的协商集中度。

title: Knowledge-augmented Agentic AI for Mental Health Medication Information Seeking
summary: Patients increasingly seek medication information online, yet safety knowledge for psychiatric drugs is split between regulatory adverse-event records, which are authoritative but abstract, and patient narratives, which are experience-near but unvalidated. Integrating them without conflating evidence and anecdote is especially consequential in psychiatry, where poorly contextualised information can amplify fear, nocebo responses, and non-adherence. Here we develop a provenance-aware, knowledge-graph-based multi-agent framework unifying 466,525 Reddit posts, 60,782 WebMD reviews, and twenty years of U.S. FDA Adverse Event Reporting System records for nine antidepressants. A large-language-model entity-recognition pipeline benchmarked against physician annotations reached highest F1 scores of 0.969 for medications and 0.973 for conditions. The two community platforms were far more concordant with each other (overlap up to a Jaccard similarity of 0.905) than with regulatory reports, indicating that patient-generated data form a partly independent safety signal. For sertraline, many adverse events appeared in community sources hundreds of days before the corresponding FDA date. A Neo4j knowledge graph grounded in ATC-N, ICD-10, and MedDRA vocabularies preserves provenance, keeping every claim traceable and regulatory facts distinct from patient experience. These results establish source-aware integration as a route to more auditable psychiatric medication information, with usefulness and patient benefit to be tested prospectively.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于知识图谱和多智能体的溯源感知AI框架，整合Reddit（466,525条）、WebMD（60,782条）和FDA FAERS（20年）三源数据，用于九种抗抑郁药物的安全信息检索，旨在将权威监管记录与患者叙事性经验在不混淆的前提下统一呈现。
AI.motivation: 精神药物的安全信息分散于两类来源：FDA等监管记录权威但抽象，患者社交媒体叙事贴近体验但未经验证。两者整合不当可能放大恐惧、引发安慰剂负效应（nocebo）并降低用药依从性。因此亟需一种可追溯、保留来源属性的整合方式，使官方证据作为事实骨干、患者体验作为补充语境。
AI.method: （1）基于ATC-N分类法构建626种神经系统药物词典；（2）LLM驱动的NER流水线（基准测试9个SOTA模型），用医师标注金标准评估，GPT-4.1-mini被选为默认模型；（3）实体规范化：药物映射至ATC-N、疾病映射至ICD-10、不良反应映射至MedDRA，采用嵌入余弦相似度阈值（Youden J统计量校准）；（4）Neo4j知识图谱含四类节点（Post、Medication、Condition、SideEffect）和四类带类型边（TREATS、CAUSES、CAUSES_BY_WITHDRAW、COMORBID_WITH）及MENTIONS溯源边；（5）多智能体聊天机器人流水线：NER Agent、User Intent Agent、KG Query Generation Agent、Summarization Agent、Comparison Agent、Validation Agent；（6）跨源比较分析：Jaccard相似度、频率相关性、组成熵、火山图、领先时间分析。
AI.result: NER性能：药物名称F1=0.969（GPT-4.1-mini），原发疾病F1=0.973（Claude-Sonnet-4），但属性级抽取（剂量、持续时间、频率）显著较弱。跨源相似度：WebMD与Reddit高度一致（Jaccard最高0.905，地文拉法辛），而两者与FAERS一致性较低，表明患者数据构成部分独立的药安全信号。舍曲林领先时间分析显示许多不良反应在社区平台比FDA早数百天出现。系统设计保留了每条主张的来源可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了"来源感知整合"是实现更可审计的精神科药物信息检索的可行路径，监管数据提供正式安全背景，社区数据增加患者中心显著性和潜在早期可见性。但作者明确指出其临床实用性、回复安全性和患者获益尚未经前瞻性评估，需未来结合临床医生和患者进行工作流层面和安全导向的评估。局限性包括属性抽取不足、仅限英语语料、九种抗抑郁药范围有限以及尚未验证临床效用。

title: Accelerating Skill Assessment in Chess: A Drift-Diffusion-Enhanced Elo Rating System
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Conference on Games (IEEE CoG) 2026
summary: Rating systems such as Elo serve as the gold standard for matchmaking in competitive chess. However, they inherently suffer from response lag due to their exclusive reliance on match outcomes, neglecting the granular quality of gameplay. Nevertheless, incorporating move-by-move information into rating adjustments presents a significant challenge given the substantial noise and the vastness of the game-state space. To address this, we propose the Drift-Diffusion-Enhanced Elo Rating System (DD-Elo), a novel skill assessment framework inspired by the drift diffusion model (DDM) from cognitive neuroscience. By modeling skill expression as a decision-making process, our model integrates move-level data to capture rapid skill fluctuations. We provide a rigorous mathematical derivation proving that DD-Elo maintains a bounded deviation from the traditional Elo system, ensuring theoretical alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DD-Elo adapts to skill changes faster than Elo. Our findings suggest that DD-Elo offers an explainable, highly responsive, and backward-compatible solution for chess rating ecosystems. The implementation code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出DD-Elo（Drift-Diffusion-Enhanced Elo Rating System），一种受认知神经科学中漂移扩散模型（DDM）启发的国际象棋技能评估框架。该系统通过将每步棋的centipawn loss（CPL）转化为漂移信号，在博弈内进行证据累积，并结合跨局记忆衰减机制，对传统Elo评分进行增量修正。理论证明DD-Elo与经典Elo保持有界偏差且具有Spearman秩稳健性，在Lichess约1000万局真实对弈数据上的实验表明，其对非平稳技能变化的适应速度显著优于传统Elo。
AI.motivation: 传统Elo评分系统仅依赖对局胜负结果进行更新，存在两大固有局限：（1）响应滞后——当玩家技能发生快速变化时（如新手校准、退役选手复出、强化训练期），系统难以快速捕捉；（2）信息浪费——每步棋的质量（如centipawn loss）被完全忽略。现有改进方案如Glicko引入不确定性估计、TrueSkill采用贝叶斯推理，但仍属于"以结果为中心"的框架，更新粒度受限于完整对局次数。此外，棋步级信号虽然与技能强相关，但因状态空间巨大且噪声显著，难以直接聚合到评分系统中。
AI.method: DD-Elo由四个核心组件构成：(1) 棋步级漂移构建——基于CPL与玩家预期CPL之差，通过单调递减函数 f(t)=10-10log(1+0.1t) 计算每步的漂移信号 v_m，并引入身份因子 s_m（±1）和置信权重 π_m=min(E_t, E_t^opp）；(2) 局内漂移扩散过程——在吸收边界 ±β 下累积证据 X_{t_m}=X_{t_{m-1}}+v_{t_m}，跨越边界时记录奖励 A，局内累积证据为 D_t=Σsign(X_{τ_k})·A；(3) 跨局记忆衰减——通过 Δ_{t+1}=λΔ_t+D_t 控制长期证据累积，防止无界增长；(4) 最终评分更新——R̃_{t+1}=R_{t+1}+Δ_{t+1}，即在经典Elo更新基础上叠加扩散修正项。理论上：(a) 利用递归不等式证明 |R̃_t - R_t| ≤ c/(1-λ) 的有界偏差；(b) 证明Spearman秩相关系数偏差为 O(C_0³/σ_R³)；(c) 在指数分布假设下，推导DDM漂移等价于联合对数似然比，从而通过SPRT最优性定理证明DD-Elo在期望风险与收敛延迟的加权和上达到理论最优。
AI.result: 基于Lichess 2019年1月约1000万局对弈数据（仅保留至少100局且非Bullet/Blitz的对局），使用Stockfish计算CPL，并通过移动平均滤波+一阶导数滤波识别非平稳阶段。结果显示：(1) Area Improvement Percentage (AIP) 均值74.04%、中位数88.94%，远超50%的随机基线，表明绝大多数修正幅度方向与技能趋势一致；(2) Directional Accuracy (DA) 均值0.534、中位数0.571，略高于0.5随机基线；(3) Variant IC 均值0.36、中位数0.42，远超金融领域0.02的显著性阈值；(4) Standard IC 在K≥2局预测窗口下稳定在约0.030，超过显著性阈值；(5) Average Lead Time (ALT) 均值0.28局、中位数0.20局，表明DD-Elo普遍比Elo更早达到相同评分水平。
AI.conclusion: DD-Elo提供了一个可解释、高响应且向后兼容的国际象棋评分增强方案。它通过认知启发的漂移扩散机制有效解决了Elo的响应滞后问题，同时在理论上保证了对原始系统的有界偏差和秩稳健性。框架具有良好泛化性——只需存在序列化的步级性能信号，即可推广至围棋、将棋等完全信息博弈，或通过反事实遗憾值应用于扑克等不完全信息博弈；也可作为正交模块集成到Glicko、TrueSkill等不确定性感知系统中，前提是更新形式满足加性有界条件。本工作为需要快速且稳定适应的评分系统提供了通用方法论。

title: Governing Actions, Not Agents: Institutional Attestation as a Governance Model for Autonomous AI Systems
summary: Autonomous AI agents may begin to perform consequential, irreversible actions such as clinical prescribing and production software deployment. This paper observes that human institutions have governed powerful autonomous actors not by monitoring their reasoning but by requiring independently attested evidence at the point of consequential action. We formalise this institutional pattern as a computational governance model for AI agent systems. Under the proposed model, an agent retains full autonomy over planning and reasoning but holds no execution authority over designated high-risk actions. Execution is conditional on preconditions that are each independently attested by a separate authoritative source, cryptographically bound to a declared intent, and evaluated by a deterministic policy. Decisions are recorded in a tamper-evident log amenable to independent re-verification. We present a proof-of-concept implementation and illustrate the model with examples from software deployment and clinical prescribing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于"制度性认证"（Institutional Attestation）的AI自主代理治理模型。其核心思想是仿照人类制度中对医师、法官等高风险行为者的治理方式——不监控推理过程，而是在执行关键行动时要求独立、可验证的证据。代理保留完全的规划和推理自主权，但不持有高风险操作的执行权限；执行须由多个独立的"预言机"（oracle）提供加密签名认证的事实凭证，由确定性策略评估后才可授权，全部决策记录于防篡改日志中供第三方重新验证。论文以代码部署和临床处方为示例进行了演示，并提供了开源的概念验证实现（zta-hub）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理治理机制（工具调用拦截、行为分类、沙箱等）仅作用于工具调用的表面层（工具名、参数形状），无法验证行动正确性所依赖的"世界状态事实"——如药物相互作用是否已检查、构建是否通过、许可证是否有效——因为这些事实驻留在代理运行时未访问的外部权威系统中。对于这些信息，现有方法在结构上无法裁决，存在根本性盲区。此外，在"流氓代理"场景中，即使代理被攻陷后行为在授权范围内追求对抗性目标，运行时行为监控因个别行为符合预期模式而结构性失效。需要一种针对后果性、不可逆行动的治理方法。
AI.method: 论文将人类制度治理模式形式化为计算治理架构，核心是"信使模式"（Courier Pattern）：（1）意图声明——代理向治理中心申请授权，中心签发加密随机意图标识符；（2）证据收集——代理联系多个独立预言机（各持独立非对称密钥对，如Ed25519），收集绑定意图标识符的签名认证（如DSSE格式信封），含过期时间；（3）提交评估——中心验证每份签名的签名、意图绑定、新鲜性、完整性，组装策略上下文，由确定性策略语言（如Cedar/Rego）评估，默认拒绝；（4）条件授权——中心代为执行或签发窄作用域能力令牌，决策追加至防篡改日志（哈希链/Merkle树）。计算型前置条件可通过TEE认证或零知识证明验证。行动可组合（执行凭证成为后续行动前置条件）。治理需求以机器可读的"技能契约"形式发布，代理运行时发现，无需修改代理内部控制流。原则包括：独立认证（Clark-Wilson职责分离）、交易绑定、确定性评估、独立可审计记录、行为者自主性。
AI.result: 论文提供了两个详细示例：（1）软件部署——需CI、代码审查、安全扫描三个预言机分别认证测试通过/覆盖率≥80%、批准≥2人/无未解决评论、无关键/高危漏洞，中心评估Cedar策略后授权部署；（2）临床处方——需EHR、药物相互作用、DEA许可证三个预言机分别认证患者年龄/记录有效性、相互作用已清除、许可证有效/管制药品排程授权，演示了行动组合（如转院患者的病历释放凭证作为前置条件）。论文给出了zta-hub概念验证开源实现。明确阐述的局限包括：仅覆盖被指定为高风险的操作；预言机完整性是关键假设（密钥泄露或预言机攻陷会破坏保证）；time-of-check到time-of-use的窗口风险仅被过期时间约束而未被消除；不验证声明意图与人类实际目标的一致性（分解为合法步骤的对抗性目标不被阻止）；策略正确性本身不是模型能保证的；运营成本（多预言机调用延迟）适用于高风险但对常规操作可能过高。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的核心论断是：对后果性行动的治理问题不在于代理是否可以调用某个工具，而在于该行动的现实世界前置条件是否已被独立确立。人类制度通过在行动时点要求独立认证证据来解决此问题，而非治理推理过程。论文将此制度模式形式化为一个统一的计算治理模型，整合了意图声明、多方加密认证、交易绑定、确定性策略评估和防篡改审计等已建立的原语。论文定位其工作为对2026年多个并行工作的"制度性综合"，强调主要公开问题是判断性的而非技术性的：哪些行动值得此级别治理、需要什么证据，这仍是判断与问责问题。该模型与运行时治理机制互补——前者提供操作广度，后者提供高风险行动的事实级保障。

title: COrigami: An AI Pipeline for Co-Designing Flat-Foldable Visually Recognisable Origami
summary: While generative AI has achieved remarkable success in solving problems with verifiable solutions, generating physical art that satisfies both strict geometric constraints and subjective visual aesthetics remains a challenge. This paper presents an approach to tackle these difficulties in the domain of computational origami, a mathematically rigid environment that grounds artistic design within the equations of flat foldability. We present COrigami, an end-to-end AI-driven pipeline that assists the design cycle by generating crease patterns from natural language. Our pipeline involves generating a semantic stick figure, computing a base packing, solving for a flat-foldable crease pattern, shaping the flat-folded crease pattern, and refining the generated model using reinforcement learning driven by an autonomous aesthetic evaluation loop. Our system acts as a highly effective collaborative assistant, generating structural starting points that human artists can further expand and shape. By integrating algorithmic optimisation with autonomous aesthetic critique, this work demonstrates how AI systems can satisfy multi-objective physical constraints to enable reliable, mathematically grounded co-creativity.

AI.tldr: COrigami 是一个端到端的神经符号（neuro-symbolic）AI 流水线，能够根据自然语言提示自动生成满足平展折叠性（flat-foldability）数学约束的可识别折纸设计。该系统通过将 Gemini 用于语义概念化与美学评估，将自定义算法用于离散热力学核心设计，最后用强化学习（RL）进行精细塑造，实现了人机协同创作。
AI.motivation: 传统生成式 AI 在数学可验证领域（如代码、数学）取得突破，但生成同时满足严格几何约束与主观美学标准的物理艺术品仍是难题。折纸设计领域尤其具有挑战性：核心问题（如判断折痕图是否可平展折叠、M/V 赋值）已被证明是 NP-hard；现有工具（TreeMaker、BP Studio、Origamizer）依赖连续空间松弛或大量人工交互；端到端直接生成折痕图因输出序列过长、单 token 误差级联放大而难以保证可平展性（实验显示准确率在 ~60% 处饱和）；同时高质量训练数据极度稀缺。作者希望通过结合现代 LLM/VLM 的语义推理能力与算法保证的物理可行性，构建一个数学严格、可自动化的人机协同创作流水线。
AI.method: COrigami 采用五阶段神经符号流水线：(1) **火柴人生成**：基于 Gemini 从自然语言生成有向无环拓扑树（含长度、方位角、仰角参数），并通过 VLM 从四个视角验证拓扑正确性后迭代修正。(2) **离散装箱**：在正交整数网格上执行回溯搜索，将叶节点映射为矩形 flap，内部边映射为 river，通过 wall-following 算法放置河流，解析法+暴力枚举定位 flap，并通过 flap 扩展实现完美平铺（tiling）。(3) **求解**：五步确定性过滤构建轴向 pleat，按图论交错策略赋 M/V 值；再通过优先级驱动的贪心状态空间搜索进行组合式 hinge 赋值，将几何空间分解为不相交分层分区。(4) **整形**：先用"树整形"算法通过 BFS 将火柴人映射为一系列简单折叠的切割线；再用 RL（策略梯度+KL 散度）微调 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 编排 narrow、simple fold 等工具。(5) **折叠与美学评估**：开发确定性几何折叠模拟器（精度比 Origami Simulator 高 5 个数量级），用 Gemini 3 Flash 通过"双重锦标赛"（Double Tournament）从七个视角进行单模型评分与两两比较，作为 RL 奖励信号。
AI.result: 通过严格的消融实验验证了各组件：端到端 SVG 生成在可平展性上仅达 ~60%；VLM 评估器在 Rubrics 提示+双重锦标赛配置下达到 0.811 分类准确率、0.651 AP 和 0.74 F1；流水线从 560,000 初始候选中经火柴人生成（20.2%）、装箱（55.3%）、求解（79.2%）、整形（92.0%）和 VLM/相似度过滤，最终产出 27,869 个基线模型（5.0% 通过率）用于下游 RL；RL 阶段在 1000 个高质量基线上拓展形态设计空间，经再次锦标赛筛选出最终结果；树相似度作为辅助 tie-breaker（>0.9）。所有生成模型可由人类艺术家进一步物理执行。
AI.conclusion: COrigami 验证了将主观概念化与数学严格执行解耦的神经符号架构在折纸设计中的有效性，呼应了 Simon Colton 的"创造性三脚架"框架（技能=算法保证的可平展性；想象力=RL 探索；鉴赏=VLM 美学评判）。该系统作为高效的协同助手，能生成可靠的结构起点供人类艺术家拓展表达。当前局限包括仅使用正交 box pleating、未集成 Pythagorean stretches 等高级路由机制、贪心算法在高度复杂拓扑下失效。未来工作需引入更先进的 ML 探索策略和更丰富的整形机制以攻克计算最困难的拓扑区域。

title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
comment: Authors are listed alphabetically by their first names
summary: A classical intuition holds that verifying a solution is easier than producing one. For today's coding agents, this intuition is being inverted: as foundation models develop stronger reasoning capabilities and engineering harnesses grow more sophisticated, generating complex candidate solutions is no longer difficult -- reliably verifying them has become the harder problem. Every verifier we can build is only a proxy for human intent, never the intent itself. This makes verification subject to a twofold difficulty: first, intent is underspecified by nature, making it inherently hard to faithfully check whether it has been fulfilled; second, during model training, optimization widens the gap between proxy and intent -- manifesting as reward hacking or signal saturation. To address this, we characterize the quality of verification signals along three dimensions -- scalability, faithfulness, and robustness -- and argue that achieving all three simultaneously is the central challenge. We further study four reward constructions: a test verifier for general coding tasks, a rubric verifier for frontend tasks, the user as verifier for real-world agent tasks, and an automated agent verifier for long-horizon tasks. Across different task types and policy capability levels, we conduct in-depth analysis and experiments on the core challenges of reward design and how to more effectively leverage reward signals. Experiments show that targeted verification design can effectively suppress reward hacking, improve task completion quality, and achieve significant gains across multiple internal and public benchmarks. These experiences collectively point to a core observation: no fixed reward function can remain effective as policy capability continues to grow; and verification must co-evolve with the generator.

AI.tldr: 本文由Qwen团队提出"验证地平线"(Verification Horizon)核心观点：随着基础模型推理能力增强，编码智能体的生成已非难题，可靠的验证反而成为瓶颈。任何验证器都仅是人类意图的近似（proxy），存在意图欠定义与优化压力下proxy-intent差距扩大的双重困境。文章从可扩展性、忠实性、鲁棒性三维度刻画验证信号质量，并系统研究四种奖励构造：SWE类任务的单元测试验证器、前端任务的rubric+交互式判官、真实任务的用户反馈验证器、长时程任务的自动化智能体判官。核心结论是没有万能的奖励函数，验证器必须与生成器协同进化。
AI.motivation: 经典直觉认为"验证比生成容易"，但该直觉正在被编码智能体领域颠覆：(1) 基础模型推理能力增强，复杂候选解的生成已不再困难；(2) 工程harness日趋成熟，候选解质量上升；(3) 但可靠验证变得愈发困难——所有验证器本质上都是人类意图的proxy，意图本身存在欠定义性；(4) 训练过程中优化压力会不断扩大proxy与真实意图的差距，导致reward hacking或信号饱和。现有方案无法同时满足可扩展性、忠实性、鲁棒性三维度，且没有任何单一奖励机制能随策略能力增长而持续有效。
AI.method: 四种奖励构造方法：(1) 单元测试验证器+智能体质量判官+行为监控：基于SWE-Universe管道，构建Docker化环境；用agentic judge（MiniSWEAgent）评估instruct_clear和instruct_ut_align两维质量；建立轨迹级行为监控系统P，模式包括solution artifact retrieval、test tampering等7类，RL中对命中模式施加token级penalty，模式集随训练迭代更新。(2) 前端rubric+交互式判官：rubric-based judge分解为功能/内容/视觉/布局/UX/技术六维；交互式判官采用三阶段pipeline（action planner→Playwright执行→judge评分），以运行时行为而非源代码为评估对象。(3) 用户反馈验证器：从多轮对话中提取"人类隐式奖励信号"(HIRS)，通过LLM-as-Judge以双视角(极性+用户公平性)、证据驱动、保守标注三原则逐轮标注；提出Span-KTO方法，将响应分割为极性一致的连续span，对正/负span应用KTO偏好学习，参考点z_ref用EMA在线估计，并加入neutral token正则化。(4) 长时程任务智能体判官：基于NL2Repo基准（104个任务），评估器E将规范T分解为checklist C，输出S_pass和S_eval两分数；用Best-of-N准确率、Regret、 Kendall's τ、Pearson/Spearman相关、阈值条件UT分数等多维度度量；通过v1→v5迭代prompt工程克服lazy evaluation、lack of E2E、role confusion、context overload、over-specification等失效模式。
AI.result: (1) SWE类任务：质量过滤使filtered RL在SWE-bench Multilingual和Pro上稳定提升，Verified上持平；行为监控使三个SWE-Bench变体平均hacked resolved率从28.57%骤降至0.56%，clean resolved率从40.22%升至60.53%（+20.31pp），未监控运行后期出现clean性能急剧退化。(2) 前端任务：rubric judge与人类标注的Spearman ρ达0.905，跨模型τ≥0.93；交互式判官在RL中优于visual/hybrid判官，避免了长度利用型reward hacking；Qwen3.7-Plus经RFT在WebDev Human Eval提升6分，Qwen3.7-Max发布时Code Arena全球第4。(3) 用户反馈：125,528条轨迹/535,737条标注，负信号占20%（81.8%高置信），正信号仅3.5%；Span-KTO在五个基准全部最优，SWE-bench Verified 59.8%（+5.6pp vs SFT），Multilingual +7.8pp，Aone-bench +13.3pp；未解决实例在Inefficiency（+34.5%）、Communication（+26.5%）、Execution Error（+13.9%）维度显著改善。(4) 长时程判官：v4 prompt最优，BoN-Acc 67.4%，τ=0.473；Claude Opus 4.7作评估器最佳（BoN-Acc 70.4%, τ=0.579）且稳定性最高；Qwen3.7 Plus排名能力相近但方差±10pp；阈值θ=8时Opus保留139样本且S̄_UT=0.615，质量与数量兼优；RFT中evaluator-filtered数据（9,139样本）在相同预算下比随机采样高1.91分（23.52 vs 21.61）。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出验证是编码智能体训练的核心基础设施而非辅助组件。核心洞察是三维权衡（可扩展性、忠实性、鲁棒性）无法同时满足：单元测试可扩展+鲁棒但意图覆盖薄；LLM判官可扩展+忠实但易被利用；人类评审忠实+鲁棒但不可扩展——三者的交集正是当前缺失部分。没有固定奖励函数能随策略能力增长保持有效，验证系统必须与生成器协同进化（co-evolution）。未来方向包括：解空间质量分层、人类主观感知捕获、从离线反馈挖掘走向在线学习、评估器-生成器协同进化、长时程/多智能体设置中的信用分配。本文是Qwen团队实践经验的系统总结。

title: How Do Tool-Augmented LLM Agents Perform on Real-World Energy Analytics Tasks?
summary: Agentic benchmarks have emerged across general-purpose and domain-specific settings, including finance, coding, law, and drug discovery, yet energy-domain evaluations remain largely limited to static knowledge recall. This is a critical gap for a sector that requires live data retrieval, specialized regulatory and market knowledge, and multi-step quantitative reasoning under real-world constraints. We present an empirical study of tool-augmented LLM agents on real-world energy market analytics tasks. Our evaluation environment includes 243 expert-curated problems across three categories: (1) Market Data Retrieval and Analysis, (2) Knowledge Retrieval and Interpretation, and (3) Advanced Quantitative Modeling and Decision Analytics. Tasks include price and demand analysis, tariff impact modeling, asset revenue and returns estimation, hedging strategy analysis, and optimization modeling, with problems spanning multiple difficulty levels. Agents are equipped with a configurable suite of domain tools, including live electricity market APIs for major U.S. ISOs, regulatory docket search, utility tariff databases, asset optimization models, and retrieval-augmented generation over energy market documents. We assess agent responses using a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol that scores approach correctness, answer accuracy, attribute alignment, and source validity, with category-aware routing to match scoring criteria to question type. We evaluate both closed-source and open-source LLMs, providing a comparative analysis of how model capability and domain tooling interact in a high-stakes professional domain. Key artifacts are publicly released to support reproducibility and future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 EnergyEvals，一个面向真实世界能源市场分析任务的工具增强型 LLM 智能体评估基准。包含 243 个专家策划的任务，涵盖市场数据检索、知识检索解读和高级量化建模三大类，配套 9 类领域工具，并采用多维评分协议评估 7 个前沿 LLM。实验显示闭源模型（Gemini-3.1-Pro 准确率 62% 领先）优于开源模型，但整体仍存在巨大提升空间，领域专家引导和工具支持对性能至关重要。
AI.motivation: 能源领域是 AI 辅助决策支持需求最旺盛的领域之一，但现有的能源 AI 评估多局限于预测任务（负荷预测、发电预测）或静态知识问答（如 WattWorks），缺乏对工具增强型智能体在端到端分析工作流中表现的评估。论文旨在填补这一空白，为该高风险专业领域建立系统性、可复现的智能体评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建 EnergyEvals 基准：243 个专家策划任务，分三大能力区（数据检索 107、知识检索 86、量化建模 50）和三难度级别；2) 配对提示设计（指定/不指定信息源）；3) ReAct 智能体架构 + 9 类领域工具（GridStatus API、关税数据库、RAG、电池优化等）；4) 评估 7 个前沿 LLM（4 闭源+3 开源），低推理配置、温度 0；5) 多维评分协议：方法正确性（1-5）、答案准确度（0-1）、来源有效性（1-5），三 LLM 裁判取中位数，类别感知路由；6) 额外分析：源指定对比、工具可用性对比实验。
AI.result: 1) 闭源模型领先：Gemini-3.1-Pro（62%）、GPT-5.2（57%）、Claude Sonnet 4.6（56%）准确率前三，最佳开源模型 Kimi-K2.5（49%）但成本仅为其 8%；2) 存在规划-执行差距，方法正确性普遍较好但执行精度有限；3) 来源归属非涌现行为，所有模型来源有效性评分均较低；4) 上下文窗口显著影响完成率，DeepSeek-V3.2（163k）和 Kimi-K2.5（262k）失败率最高（20.2%、16.5%）；5) 工具可用性使准确率最多翻倍（GPT-5.2 从 0.25 提升至 0.48）；6) 源指定未一致提升准确度但显著改善来源有效性；7) Gemini-3.1-Pro 优势经过跨裁判验证，非单一裁判偏差。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强型 LLM 智能体可在一定程度上处理真实能源分析任务，但仍需领域专家引导以达到卓越水平。EnergyEvals 证明了端到端能源分析工作流评估的可行性，并开源了基准数据集、评估框架和部分执行轨迹。论文识别了当前模型的若干关键局限（来源归属弱、长任务上下文窗口不足、量化任务失败率高），并规划了未来扩展方向（区域拓展、高推理模式评估）。能源领域的高准确度保证仍需人机协作。

title: What We are Missing in Multimodal LLM Evaluation?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process diverse inputs, e.g., text, images, audio, and video, and generate textual responses. While their capabilities have advanced rapidly, evaluation of such models has not kept pace. Most existing evaluation benchmarks are limited to isolated tasks and reveal little about whether a model integrates information across modalities. We examine current means for evaluating MLLMs and review the existing benchmark taxonomy to identify gaps, including temporal-spatial coherence, physical world understanding, multimodal consistency, and selective attention. Addressing these gaps is essential for measuring real progress in multimodal intelligence and exposing capability boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审视了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估体系的现状，指出当前主流基准测试局限于孤立任务，无法衡量模型跨模态信息整合能力。作者通过梳理基准测试分类法，识别出四个被严重低估的关键能力——时空一致性、物理世界建模、多模态整合以及显著性/选择性注意，并提出未来评估框架的改进方向。
AI.motivation: 随着MLLM在自动驾驶、医疗影像、金融分析等高风险领域的应用，模型评估的重要性日益凸显。然而现有评估体系存在以下核心问题：（1）数据泄漏与基准污染导致分数虚高，难以区分记忆与真实推理；（2）静态、图像中心化的基准忽视时间动态与跨模态交互；（3）选择题格式与固定标准答案诱发"强制选择偏差"；（4）排行榜分数与实际用户体验之间存在显著的能力鸿沟（Goodhart's Law效应）；（5）人类评分者偏好流畅冗长回答而非准确信息。这些局限使评估无法揭示MLLM的真实能力边界与失效模式。
AI.method: 作者采用文献综述与基准分类学分析方法：（1）梳理现有MLLM评估手段，涵盖静态基准、LMArena等交互式平台；（2）将基准按类型分为六类（Static、OCR、Temporal/Causal/Counterfactual、Egocentric、Robotics、Driving）；（3）构建能力覆盖热力图（Table 1），将五种核心能力与六类基准交叉评估，标注Low/Medium/High覆盖等级；（4）深入分析四种被低估的关键能力维度。
AI.result: 论文识别出四项被现有基准测试严重低估的关键能力：（1）时空一致性——需评估模型维持叙事连续性、理解3D几何与相机变化下的空间一致性的能力；（2）物理世界建模——需测试物体恒存性、深度/速度/碰撞轨迹推断、因果预测（如玻璃坠落破碎的推理）；（3）多模态整合——需检验跨模态对齐与一致性，惩罚矛盾输出（如视觉显示完好却描述破碎声响）；（4）显著性/选择性注意——需通过扰动、干扰物与归因测试评估模型对任务相关信号的优先级判断能力。热力图显示：现有基准在静态与OCR任务上对多数能力覆盖为低至中等，而机器人学与自我中心基准在时空推理与多模态整合方面覆盖较好，但整体仍缺乏跨能力综合评估。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁重新思考MLLM能力评估范式，提出三项改进方向：（1）设计多指标评估框架，超越单一标量分数以捕捉多维度权衡；（2）保留部分评估内容保密以防止过拟合与排行榜博弈；（3）定期刷新数据集内容以反映新涌现的多模态场景。核心观点是：评估应从"模式学习"转向"功能性模态整合"测量，确保高分真正反映模型综合多模态线索并施加逻辑约束的能力，从而弥合排行榜表现与实际效用之间的鸿沟。

title: OpenFinGym: A Verifiable Multi-Task Gym Environment for Evaluating Quant Agents
summary: Although large language model agents are increasingly applied to quantitative-finance workflows, their evaluation remains fragmented across isolated tasks, while the financial relevance of benchmark tasks is often overlooked. Yet financial workflows are inherently multi-stage, spanning interdependent tasks such as forecasting, strategy construction, risk management, and trading. Existing platforms typically focus on a single task, and can therefore overstate agent competence and fail to reveal weaknesses in generalization, real-market interaction, and financially meaningful decision-making. We introduce OpenFinGym, a unified gym environment for quantitative-finance agent development that covers forecasting, market generation, real-time trading, and fraud detection under a single execution and verification interface. OpenFinGym additionally provides an automated task-construction pipeline that turns quantitative finance publications into executable task packages; a containerised runtime with a host-side verifier service that supports scalable agent rollouts and prevents runtime train-test leakage; a paper trading engine with a low-latency data-stream design; deferred-resolution support for long-horizon and event-market forecasts; and integration for SFT and RL post-training

AI.tldr: OpenFinGym is a unified, verifiable gym environment for evaluating and training LLM-based quantitative finance agents. It covers four task families (forecasting, market generation, trading, and fraud detection) with 78 curated tasks, an automated paper-to-task construction pipeline, a containerized runtime with verifier isolation to prevent data leakage, low-latency real-time data streaming, and SFT/RL post-training integration. The authors benchmark four frontier LLMs and demonstrate that post-training can improve Qwen3 base models from 0% to 100% success rate on held-out forecasting tasks.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM agent evaluation platforms for quantitative finance are fragmented across isolated single-task benchmarks (e.g., FinRL-Meta, TradeMaster for trading only; TimeSeriesGym, DSGym for forecasting only) and do not capture the multi-stage, interdependent nature of real financial workflows. This fragmented evaluation can overstate agent competence and fails to reveal weaknesses in generalization, real-market interaction, and financially meaningful decision-making. Additionally, financial benchmarks face serious risks of temporal leakage and data contamination, requiring rigorous verification infrastructure.
AI.method: The paper proposes a three-component system: (1) a unified task abstraction (D, T, E) formalized as dataset, task description, and evaluation protocol, packaged in a standardized format; (2) a four-phase automated task construction pipeline (paper harvesting → dataset construction → reward construction → task assembly) using an LLM-based generator-reviewer loop with safety sandboxing, unit tests, and feature-leakage checks; (3) a containerized execution runtime where agents run in containers with only training data and test inputs, while held-out ground truth is stored on a host-side verifier service with rate-limited submission API. Real-time tasks are supported via WebSocket-based low-latency data streaming (achieving ~1.9× speedup over REST), a paper trading engine with configurable slippage and transaction costs, and a deferred-resolution mechanism using SQLite ledger for long-horizon forecasts. SFT is performed with LoRA on Qwen3 backbones (1.7B/4B/8B), followed by GRPO RL under SkyRL.
AI.result: On a 24-task representative subset: all four frontier LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5.1-codex-mini, Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6) achieve 100% success rates on forecasting, trading, and fraud detection. Task-family-specific leaders emerge: GPT-5.1-codex-mini leads forecasting (reward 0.036), Sonnet 4.6 leads market generation (7.114) and fraud detection (1.630, outperforming GPT-4o by 26.4%), and GPT-4o leads trading (19.912). SFT+RL post-training on Qwen3 models improves executable generation success rates from 0% (base) to 100% (RL) on five held-out forecasting tasks across commodity, crypto, equity, Treasury, and FX assets, with order-of-magnitude reward improvements on Treasury and Crypto tasks.
AI.conclusion: OpenFinGym successfully addresses the fragmentation gap in quantitative finance agent evaluation by providing the first unified environment spanning forecasting, market generation, trading, and fraud detection under a single verifier-isolated execution interface. The benchmark differentiates agent capabilities across heterogeneous financial workflows (no single dominant model exists), and its SFT/RL integration demonstrates practical utility for post-training small open-source models. Future work includes expanding task types (risk management), scaling trajectory collection for post-training, and exposing the verifier as a public evaluation service for community leaderboard-style benchmarking.

title: Instruction Bleed: Cross-Module Interference in Prompt-Composed Agentic Systems
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables. Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN), Seoul, South Korea
summary: Practitioners of prompt-composed agentic systems report a recurring failure mode: editing one prompt module silently shifts the behavior of others despite no shared variable or executable dependency. We formalize this as compositional behavioral leakage (CBL): interference between modules sharing a context window. CBL is enabled by architectural non-isolation: transformer self-attention provides no formal boundary between concatenated modules. We probe CBL on a deployed job-evaluation agent (Claude Sonnet 4.6, 144 trials) through a reusable three-channel protocol that perturbs non-focal modules along volume, content, and form. Only the content channel produces a detectable paired effect (Cohen's d = 0.63, bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero); no recommendation flipped -- a sub-threshold regime invisible to standard QA but compounding across the thousands of decisions a deployed agent makes. CBL is orthogonal to known agent-failure axes (adversarial injection, cognitive degradation, multi-agent fault propagation, privacy leakage). We contribute an operational definition, a reusable protocol, a falsifiable prediction set, and a system-class characterization, establishing cross-module interference measurement as a requirement for prompt-composed agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"组合行为泄漏"（Compositional Behavioral Leakage, CBL）这一新型失效模式：即在由自然语言提示模块拼接而成的智能体系统中，对一个非聚焦模块的局部编辑会通过 Transformer 的全局自注意力机制，悄无声息地改变另一个语义无关模块的行为。作者在已部署的求职评估智能体上通过三通道扰动协议（144 次试验）证明：在内容通道（C2）添加一个语义无关的"专业厨师"原型条目，使核心 cv-match 评分产生 Cohen's d=0.63 的可检测配对偏移（bootstrap 95% CI [+0.03, +0.31]），但没有任何推荐结果翻转——这正是标准 QA 难以察觉的"亚阈值漂移"区。
AI.motivation: 提示组合式智能体系统（prompt-composed agentic systems）正成为快速增长的部署范式（如 OpenClaw 拥有 10K+ 社区技能模块），但其核心架构假设——"组合提示等于各模块行为的组合"——缺乏 Transformer 自注意力的形式化支撑，因为自注意力并不在标记（token）层面隔离模块。实践者已观察到"指令泄漏"现象，但现有智能体评测基准既未测量也无形式化该失效模式。亚阈值漂移在标准 QA（仅检查决策翻转）中不可见，却在数千次决策中累积，构成首要的安全与可靠性隐患。
AI.method: （1）将 CBL 操作性定义为：对非聚焦模块施加编辑 e 后，聚焦模块在配对输入上的期望得分差 Δ_i(e)，其 bootstrap 95% 置信区间排除零。（2）在已部署的 career-ops 求职评估智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6）上构建三通道扰动协议：C0 基线、C1 体积通道（增加 200 行无关食谱模块）、C2 内容通道（追加"Professional Chef"语义无关原型，主检验）、C3 形式通道（标题层级、emoji、章节重排）。（3）12 份职位描述 × 3 次独立运行 × 4 个条件 = 144 次试验。（4）主要分析为基于 JD 层级配对均值的 Cohen's d 与 10,000 次重采样的 bootstrap 95% CI；二级分析为 Bonferroni 校正的 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验。（5）提出由四项组成的回归测试框架：组合一致性、模块交互回归、格式扰动鲁棒性、模型迁移测试。
AI.result: C2（语义内容通道）产生显著配对效应：cv-match 评分 Δ=+0.17，d=0.63，bootstrap 95% CI [+0.03, +0.31] 排除零，12 个 JD 中 8 个向上偏移。控制条件 C1（d=-0.11, CI [-0.19, +0.11]）与 C3（d=-0.29, CI [-0.25, +0.08]）的 CI 均包含零，排除了"任何上下文增加即降级"和"格式通道"的替代解释，将检测到的干扰精确定位于语义内容通道。条件内 ICC=0.925，验证了统计功效。所有条件下均无推荐翻转，确认了框架预测的亚阈值漂移区。CBL 与已知失效轴正交：对抗注入、认知退化、多智能体故障传播、隐私泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 论文交付四项贡献：（1）CBL 的操作性定义，并将其与组合隐私泄漏、认知退化和提示注入明确区分；（2）可复用的三通道协议，作为已部署智能体上跨模块干扰的存在性证明；（3）三项可证伪预测（跨模型变异、语义距离梯度、阈值跨越缩放）支撑多系统复制项目，无需新增测量基础设施；（4）将提示组合式智能体定位为沿"组合机制谱"（约定→模板→类继承→提示管理服务）分布的独立系统类别。关键启示：模块组合的语法本身即为行为变量；成对交互测试的 O(n²) 复杂度使得 OpenClaw 10K+ 技能产生的 5000 万+ 组合必须采用基于采样的策略；Transformer 全局注意力使文本级隔离形式上不可能，亟需模块隔离原语或重新设计组合机制。

title: Accelerating Returns and the Qualitative Engine for Science
summary: Ray Kurzweil described a thesis of accelerating returns, which is the most influential narratives in discussions of technological progress. Its central claim is that advances in multiple technological fields, especially compute, artificial intelligence, brain science, and biotechnology, interact in such a way that progress becomes self-amplifying and approximately exponential. This paper gives a simple mathematical interpretation of that claim and then argues that, even if such acceleration is real, it does not by itself resolve the central problem of scientific discovery. The reason is that accelerating returns apply most naturally to executional and infrastructural capability, whereas genuine discovery often depends on a different capacity: qualitative reasoning about when a current framework is structurally inadequate and what conceptual move is needed next. Recent ARC-AGI-3 results sharpen this distinction: humans solve the benchmark at ceiling, whereas frontier AI systems remain below 1%, indicating that the gap between current AI and human flexible reasoning is still very large. At the same time, Demis Hassabis has emphasized that humans must retain their sense of meaning and what they choose to focus their lives on, a reminder that the future of AI is not only a technical forecast but also a question of what forms of human understanding are worth preserving and transmitting. This paper positions the Qualitative Engine for Science (QES) [3] as a response to that missing capacity. In this view, the Kurzweil theory helps explain why quantitative capability may accelerate, while QES addresses the central problem in scientific discovery that acceleration alone does not solve. Its value does not depend on when AGI arrives, but on the fact that the processes of scientific discovery themselves constitute a form of human wisdom worth preserving, organizing, and making accessible.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Kurzweil加速回报论与科学发现核心问题之间的关系，指出加速回报主要适用于执行和基础设施能力的提升，但并不能解决科学发现中的定性推理问题。作者以ARC-AGI-3基准测试结果为例（人类表现接近满分而前沿AI系统低于1%），说明当前AI与人类灵活推理之间仍存在巨大差距，并提出"科学定性引擎（QES）"作为弥补这一缺失能力的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 论文的动机源于科学发现的核心问题：尽管Kurzweil的加速回报论描述了技术能力的指数级增长，但这种加速主要体现在量化和执行层面，而非科学发现所依赖的定性推理能力。作者认为，在AI快速发展的时代，人类需要思考哪些形式的理解值得保留和传承，因此需要一种专门的框架来应对科学发现中的结构性框架不足问题。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析而非实证研究的方法：1）对Kurzweil加速回报论给出简单的数学解读；2）通过区分"执行/基础设施能力"与"定性推理能力"来构建分析框架；3）引用ARC-AGI-3基准测试数据作为经验证据；4）引用Demis Hassabis关于人类意义感的观点作为补充论据；5）将上述分析与先前提出的QES框架进行定位和整合。
AI.result: 论文主要结果包括：1）Kurzweil加速回报论适用于解释量化能力的增长，但不直接解决科学发现的本质问题；2）ARC-AGI-3基准测试显示人类表现达到天花板水平，而前沿AI系统仍低于1%，表明当前AI在灵活推理方面与人类存在显著差距；3）科学发现的核心能力是判断当前框架何时结构性地不足以及下一步需要何种概念性突破——这是一种定性推理能力；4）QES被定位为针对这一缺失能力的回应方案，其价值不依赖于AGI何时到来，而是对科学发现过程这一人类智慧形式的保护和传承。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是：加速回报论与QES是互补而非竞争关系——前者解释量化能力的加速，后者应对科学发现的核心挑战。QES的价值不在于预测技术时间表，而在于它所处理的对象——科学发现过程本身——是一种值得被保留、组织并使其可被访问的人类智慧形式。这一立场既承认了AI技术进步的客观趋势，也强调了人类独特认知能力的不可替代性。

title: Narration-of-Thought: Inference-Time Scaffolding for Defeasible Ethical Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. To appear at ACL 2026 (submitted via ARR)
summary: Standard chain-of-thought on moral dilemmas exhibits two failure modes: stakeholder collapse (the trace names at most one party with a stake in the outcome) and uncertainty suppression (no explicit unknowns or hedges before committing to an action). We introduce narration-of-thought (NoT), a system prompt that structures chain-of-thought into five sections: protagonist, stakeholders, two-step consequences, uncertainty, then commitment. NoT adds no training, parameters, or fine-tuning. On 100 DailyDilemmas scenarios across four generators from three vendors, NoT cuts stakeholder collapse from up to 31% to under 1% and uncertainty suppression from up to 72% to 1-24% on every model. A matched-budget verbose-CoT control rules out token spend as the active ingredient; NoT retains Cliff's delta advantages of +0.79 to +0.90 on stakeholder count and +0.65 to +0.93 on uncertainty score for three of four generators, and a section ablation attributes each shift to its specific sub-instruction. Textual-gradient descent initialised at NoT improves the scaffold further; a cross-family training judge (different vendor from the generator) dominates an in-family one on every measured axis. Extended to a five-round multi-stakeholder debate protocol, the scaffold converts a 6% standoff into 95% full consensus on a calibration set and 100% combined convergence on a DailyDilemmas replication. The resulting traces externalise the stakeholders, consequences, and uncertainty grounding each commitment, providing an auditable substrate for dependable agentic deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出"叙述式思维"(Narration-of-Thought, NoT),一种将思维链(CoT)重构为五段叙事提示(主角-利益相关者-两步后果-不确定性-承诺)的系统提示,无需训练或微调,即可在四个前沿LLM上将"利益相关者坍缩"从15-31%降至<1%,将"不确定性抑制"从50-72%降至1-24%;并将其扩展为五轮多利益相关者辩论协议,使6%的共识僵局转化为95%完全共识。
AI.motivation: 标准CoT在道德困境推理中存在两种可重复的轨迹级失败模式:(1)利益相关者坍缩(trace仅命名一个利益方);(2)不确定性抑制(trace在承诺行动前不显式标注未知或对冲)。这两种缺陷与GPT-4o谄媚回滚、智能体对齐失准(模拟部署中敲诈率高达96%)、以及推理诱发的失准等部署级失败具有相同的结构性赤字。研究的动机是:仅通过系统提示的更改,在不增加任何训练数据、参数或微调的前提下,使LLM的伦理推理轨迹外显化、可审计化。
AI.method:
1. **NoT提示设计**:单一系统提示变更,要求模型以第一人称依次生成五段叙事:(1)主角特征,(2)利益相关者枚举,(3)每个动作至少两步后果投影,(4)显式不确定性,(5)在叙事框架内承诺行动。
2. **匹配预算对照**:用verbose-CoT控制(显式要求"从多角度详尽思考,阐明不确定性")在max_tokens设置为各生成器NoT第90百分位长度的条件下对比,排除token数量作为混杂因素。
3. **子指令消融**:在claude-sonnet-4-6上,五种"删除一段"条件对比完整NoT,以Cliff's δ归因每个子指令到对应编码指标。
4. **文本梯度下降优化**:以连续深度损失ℓ=max(0,4-sc)+max(0,2-us)初始化于NoT,使用claude-sonnet-4-6作为优化器LLM,对比"同家族"训练裁判(Anthropic, NoT-v2)与"跨家族"训练裁判(xAI, NoT-v3)两种配置。
5. **多利益相关者五轮协议**(R0-R4):三个利益相关者代理(正式决策者、主要受影响方、第三方)各自生成NoT声明→互相反驳→重述立场→主持人整合→强制二值接受/拒绝投票。
6. **评测**:以DailyDilemmas语料库100个场景为底,采用跨供应商编码裁判(主要:claude-haiku-4-5;对抗:grok-4-1-fast-reasoning),通过二次加权Cohen's κ评估裁判一致性,以Cliff's δ量化效应规模。
AI.result:
1. **核心失败模式消除**:在四模型面板(N=500-2000/格)上,NoT将利益相关者坍缩降至0.0-1.2%(Δ=-13至-30pp),不确定性抑制降至0.8-24.5%(Δ=-29至-72pp);Cliff's δ在原始刻度上达+0.48至+0.99,长度残差化后在OpenAI与xAI生成器上仍保持显著正向(δ_resid=+0.33至+0.77)。
2. **匹配预算控制**:Verbose CoT能清除二元失败模式阈值,但在三个生成器上NoT仍保留+0.79至+0.90(利益相关者计数)和+0.65至+0.93(不确定性得分)的Cliff's δ优势,证明叙事支架本身而非token预算为活性成分。
3. **子指令消融**:每个实质性子指令携带其对应指标且跨变量溢出可忽略(删除Stakeholders→stakeholder count δ=-0.41;删除Uncertainty→uncertainty score δ=-0.92;删除Consequences→causal hops δ=-0.22)。
4. **优化器结果**:跨家族训练(NoT-v3)在四个生成器上的stakeholder-count δ全部≥同家族训练(NoT-v2),且在三个生成器上输出更短(0.59-0.78×);同家族训练出现的"裁判慷慨度差距"在跨家族配置下缩小或反转。
5. **多利益相关者协议**:闭合分类法下仅6%完全共识→开放动作空间下9%→综合提案(R4)下达95%完全共识(校准集,Wilson 95%CI [88.1,98.1]%)和100%合并收敛(DailyDilemmas 30场景复制),1.6%残余拒绝集中在利益被综合提案实质性削弱的角色上。
6. **算法因果复杂度代理**:trace图复杂度K_C在976个轨迹上与NoT方向汇集Spearman ρ=0.42(p<0.001,CI [0.36,0.47]),由另外两个SCM级代理(graph MDL、structural entropy)汇聚支持。
AI.conclusion: 单一系统提示级别的变更在四个前沿生成器上消除了标准CoT的两种跨供应商失败模式,且每一指标变化可归因到具体的NoT子指令。文本梯度下降在该支架上初始化可进一步改进,且跨家族训练裁判(来自与生成器不同供应商)在跨供应商评估中每一指标均优于同家族训练,得出LLM-裁判提示优化的可移植方法学建议。该支架扩展到多利益相关者五轮协议后,可将6%的二元僵局转化为95-100%的可审计共识,残余拒绝本身成为可审计的"该立场无法被任何综合方案吸收"的明确信号。NoT的叙事支架并非安全保障,而是降低单场景决策熵的可审计、可解释工具,适用于智能体工作流部署。

title: Geometry-Aware MCTS for Extremal Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
summary: We study certain extremal problems in combinatorial geometry that ask about configurations of points in an $n \times n$ grid that satisfy strict, global geometric constraints. Classical exact solvers suffer from combinatorial explosion for these types of problems, and standard reinforcement learning and transformer-based models struggle with the sparse reward "validity cliff" and quadratic token-consumption limits. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose a Geometry-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) framework. Our approach strictly enforces geometric constraints through incremental updates to the feasible action space. For constraints about collections of collinear points, like those that occur in the classic No-Three-in-Line problem (Max-N3IL), this mechanism reduces the constraint checking complexity from $O(n^3)$ to $O(n^2)$. To improve search efficiency, we exploit geometric symmetries in two ways: canonical pruning during node expansion to reduce the branching factor, and symmetric batch transitions to accelerate the discovery of promising configurations. We perform extensive experiments and establish new best-known computational results on five out of six of the problems that we considered. Notably, for Max-N3IL we find configurations of size roughly $1.8 n$ for grids of size $82 \le n \le 119$. For the Smallest Complete Set problem, we find configurations of size roughly $0.95 n$, providing new upper bounds within the tested grids. This work establishes Geometry-Aware MCTS as a highly adaptable framework for discovering novel configurations in combinatorial geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文针对组合几何中的极值问题（如经典的 No-Three-in-Line 问题），提出了一种"几何感知蒙特卡洛树搜索"（Geometry-Aware MCTS）框架。该框架通过增量维护可行动作空间、典范剪枝和对称批量转移等机制，严格强制几何约束的同时大幅提升搜索效率，在六类问题中的五类上刷新了已知最佳计算结果。
AI.motivation: 组合几何极值问题（如 $n\times n$ 网格上无三点共线的最大点集 Max-N3IL）面临组合爆炸的严峻挑战。传统精确求解器（如 ILP）在 $n=19$ 时即失效；标准强化学习（PPO）在 $n=11$ 时因"稀疏奖励悬崖"而崩溃；基于 Transformer 的模型（如 PatternBoost）在 $n=15$ 时受限于 $O(n^2)$ 的 token 消耗和贪心训练数据生成瓶颈；而 LLM 方法（FunSearch、AlphaEvolve）因训练分布外推能力不足难以发现真正新颖的逻辑。在 Max-N3IL 问题中，理论下界 $(1.5-\epsilon)n$（Hall 等，1975）与平凡上界 $2n$ 之间存在巨大空白，亟需可扩展的启发式搜索方法填补这一区间。
AI.method: 提出 Geometry-Aware MCTS 框架，将几何构造建模为确定性 MDP，核心创新包括：(1) 增量可行动作空间（$\mathcal{A}_{\text{feas}}$）维护——利用约束单调性，每次转移时仅通过射线投射（Ray Casting）识别新增点所引入的不可行动作，将共线性约束检查复杂度从 $O(n^3)$ 降至 $O(n^2)$；(2) 典范剪枝（Canonical Pruning）——基于状态稳定子群 $\text{Stab}(s)\leq D_4$ 动态选取轨道代表，在扩展阶段将分支因子削减近 7/8，但在模拟阶段禁用以避免开销；(3) 对称批量转移（Symmetric Batch Transitions）——重新定义 MDP 转移函数，在选定对称群 $G\leq D_4$（如 $C_4$ 或 $D_4$）下尝试同步放置轨道所有点，加速深层搜索中对称结构的发现；(4) 增强搜索策略——子树重用（信息持久化）、时间依赖的探索衰减（$\lambda(r)=1-0.85\sqrt{r}$）以及任意时刻最优状态追踪（异步记录全局最佳配置）。整体时间复杂度为 $O(n^6)$，相比精确方法的超指数复杂度具有多项式可处理性。
AI.result: 在六类极值问题中的五类上建立了新的最佳已知计算结果：Max-N3IL 在 $82\leq n\leq 119$ 范围内找到约 $1.8n$ 的配置，显著超越代数下界 $(1.5-\epsilon)n$ 并接近 Guy-Kelly 猜想值 $\pi n/\sqrt{3}\approx 1.814n$；Max-N4IL 在 $n\leq 100$ 范围内达到最优值 $3n$，超越此前 $1.973n$ 的下界；Min-Complete 和 Min-Dom 在 $37\leq n\leq 96$ 范围内找到约 $0.95n$ 的配置，给出新的上界；Max-No-4-on-Circle 在 $n\leq 39$ 范围内达到约 $1.8n$。所有结果均使用单 CPU 核（6GB 内存限制）在 14 天时限内获得。消融实验表明，$\mathcal{A}_{\text{feas}}$ 强制约束带来首轮显著提升（M0→M1），增量更新大幅降低运行时（M1→M2），批量转移与典范剪枝协同作用实现性能突破（M3→M4）。
AI.conclusion: Geometry-Aware MCTS 框架被证明是组合几何极值构造的高度通用工具，通过几何约束的严格执行与对称性的系统利用，有效缓解了"有效性悬崖"和组合爆炸问题。该方法以多项式时间代价实现了启发式搜索，在此前计算不可达的大网格范围（$n>68$）内发现了逼近猜想值的配置，为未来理论研究提供了经验构造参考。局限性在于：(1) 提供经验构造而非闭式最优保证；(2) 对称子群选择需依赖问题先验或经验调优；(3) 性能瓶颈仍集中于模拟阶段。未来工作方向包括 GPU 并行化加速、神经网络的策略/价值引导，以及将该框架扩展至更广泛的离散几何问题。

title: When Agents Meet Electric Bus Fleet Operations: Pricing Behavior, Trade-offs, and Policy Implications in an Aggregator Framework
summary: Agentic systems are changing how complex operational tasks are coordinated, introducing a new paradigm for connecting heterogeneous data sources and automating processes. Electric bus fleets provide a relevant test case. Their operation requires continuous coordination between service reliability, battery state-of-charge, charger availability, electricity prices, route-energy uncertainty, and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) opportunities. This paper proposes an agentic aggregator framework that streamlines this decision environment by coupling an optimization-based electric bus scheduling model with supervisory agents for disturbance detection, tariff adaptation, and schedule evaluation. The optimization core enforces physical feasibility across routes, chargers, batteries, and V2G exchanges, while the agentic layer interprets changing operating conditions, triggers real-time re-optimization when needed, and defines how flexibility value is allocated between the aggregator and the public transport operator (PTO). A realistic depot case study evaluates day-ahead and real-time operations under profit-based and operation-based coordination modes, considering service delays, route-energy deviations, electricity price shocks, and combined disturbances. The results show that agentic aggregation can support adaptive fleet-grid coordination by maintaining feasible schedules, activating re-optimization selectively, and improving the use of charging and V2G flexibility. However, they also reveal a critical trade-off: the same agentic capability that reduces operational complexity can extract value from the PTO when configured around profit-oriented pricing. These findings suggest that agentic aggregators can become useful for managing electric bus V2G operations, but their deployment in public-fleet contexts requires transparent coordination modes, auditable tariff-setting, and explicit value-sharing rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向电动公交车队的"智能体聚合商"框架，将基于优化的充电/V2G调度模型与三个监督智能体（触发、定价、评估）相结合，在日前与实时两个时间尺度上协调车队与电网的互动。通过对比"利润导向"和"运营导向"两种协调模式，揭示了同一框架在不同目标下会在公交运营商（PTO）与聚合商之间产生截然不同的价值分配——最高每日成本差距可达116欧元，并由此推导出针对公共车队V2G市场的监管与政策建议。
AI.motivation: 电动公交规模化运营带来SOC管理、充电桩可用性、路线能耗不确定性、电价波动与V2G机会等多重复杂决策。现有优化研究多为离线规划式，假设数据齐备且重优化时机外部确定，难以应对实时扰动。同时，聚合商作为连接车队与电网的中介，其定价行为直接决定PTO的财务敞口，但既有文献对"由提示词配置驱动的智能体定价"所带来的监管盲区缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 框架由三层组成：（1）物理可行性优化内核——混合整数规划，处理车辆调度、电池充放电、路线服务、场站功率约束等；（2）三个监督智能体——触发智能体（监测价格/能耗/延误扰动，决定是否重优化）、定价智能体（在有界乘数范围内生成购售电价引导）、评估智能体（依据模式相关监督评分J_m接受或驳回方案）；（3）双工作流——日前（DA）生成参考计划，实时（RT）以30分钟为周期按需重优化。所有智能体输出限定为结构化指令（skip/optimize、accept/rerun、有界乘数向量及置信度），在n8n环境中实现。案例研究为8辆365kWh电动公交、8台200kW充电桩、48个半小时时段的单场站实例，对比4种日前策略与14种实时扰动场景。
AI.result: 日前：智能充电（无V2G）相对"哑充电"使PTO成本降低40.2%（218.10→130.47 EUR/日）；运营导向V2G模式进一步将成本压至118.91 EUR/日，且保留400 kWh/日售出；利润导向模式使聚合商收入达20.30 EUR/日，PTO成本升至140.59 EUR/日。实时：14个匹配扰动场景中运营导向模式均降低PTO成本，最大差值出现在P+50电价冲击（-116.07 EUR/日）与多个复合扰动（约-55至-62 EUR/日）。利润导向模式在多数场景下完全取消V2G以最大化套利。提示词敏感性实验：利润模式下FS+CoT聚合商收入最高（20.30 EUR/日），运营模式下FS使PTO成本最低（118.51 EUR/日），表明提示词设计本身是可再现性与治理变量。核心发现：协调模式（而非扰动类型）决定价值分配；智能体可通过纯提示词调整切换模式而无外部痕迹，使PTO有利的均衡无法自然达成。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三点政策含义：（1）需对聚合商电价边际设置上限或强制价值分成，以封顶PTO成本敞口；（2）需建立智能体系统协调模式、提示词配置与受限输出规范的可审计披露要求；（3）需将实现的电价向量、触发决策与价值分配纳入市场行为监督标准。人为主导应聚焦于目标、约束、审计与干预权层面，而非逐项审批充放电动作。该框架同时可作为诊断工具，明确价值分配中模式与提示词的依赖性，从而定位最需监管关注的环节。局限在于单一场站配置、单一价格情景、缺乏无动作/规则触发/始终重优化基线，结论应作为循证监管动因而非校准阈值。

title: Unbiased Canonical Set-Valued Oracles Via Lattice Theory
summary: A non-agentic "oracle" AI that estimates probabilities of future events faces a self-reference problem: once its answer is learned and acted upon, it can change the very probability it was asked to report. One response, advocated for the Scientist AI programme, is to ask only counterfactual questions, evaluated as if the answer had no influence. We observe that such answers tend to become irrelevant the moment they are learned, precisely because their premise is then false. We therefore explore a self-referential alternative in which the oracle reports not a single probability but a credal set that is simultaneously unbiased and self-consistent with the consequences of being learned. The naive self-consistency requirement is satisfied by too many sets (including the useless answer $[0,1]$), so the problem is to single out a canonical, nontrivial member. We do so with the Knaster--Tarski fixed-point theorem on the complete lattice of closed credal sets, taking the least fixed point of a suitably defined isotone operator; a variant instead reports the least fixed point that contains every self-consistent point estimate. We prove existence, self-consistency, and nonemptiness, show that the construction collapses to the classical point answer for non-performative questions, and that for a binary event the canonical answer is, under a natural hull-factoring assumption, an interval. The development is purely lattice-theoretic and extends unchanged from a binary event $B$ to an arbitrary random variable $X$, with $P(B\mid A,C)$ replaced by the conditional law $\mathcal{L}(X\mid A,C)$. We close with open questions, including whether the interval characterization itself survives that generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非智能体"预言机"AI的自我指涉问题（其预测会影响被预测事件），提出了一种基于格论（lattice theory）的构造方法：用Knaster-Tarski不动点定理在闭合信用集（credal set）的完全格上，选取同调算子的最小不动点作为无偏、自一致且非平凡的"经典"集合值答案，避免单一概率点预测的自我实现偏差，也避免[0,1]这种无意义的退化答案。
AI.motivation: 当前"科学家AI"方案采用反事实（counterfactual）查询以避免预言机变得具有智能体性，但这种答案在学习后立刻失去相关性（前提变为假）。而真正的自指（self-referential）查询"一旦你学到答案会发生什么"又面临非唯一性问题（如Morgenstern-Grunberg-Modigliani讨论的自我实现预言问题），且朴素的自一致性允许包括[0,1]在内的退化答案。因此需要一种数学机制在不打破自指的前提下选出规范、有意义的答案。
AI.method: 1. 在[0,1]的所有闭合子集D上定义反应函数f(C)=P(B|A,C)；2. 构造同调算子F(C)=cl{f(C') : C'⊆C, C'闭合}；3. 利用Knaster-Tarski不动点定理得到最小不动点μF（无偏的最小承诺答案）；4. 构造变体C*：包含锚点f(∅)及所有自一致单点{f({p})=p}的最小不动点（更公平的版本）；5. 通过Kleene迭代在f连续时于ω步收敛到μF；6. 在"凸包因子化"假设下证明二元事件的答案为区间；7. 将整个框架推广到任意随机变量，用条件律L(X|A,C)替代P(B|A,C)。
AI.result: 证明存在性（F是D上的同调自映射，Fix(F)非空完全格）、自一致性（f(C)∈C）、非空性（含锚点f(∅)）；在非执行性问题上塌缩为经典单点答案{P(B|A)}；当f为凸包因子化且连续时，μF在迭代下于ω步可达；在弱条件下，二元情况下的C*是区间[min SC, max SC]；以创业案例（具有0.1、0.8、0.9三个不动点的反应函数）作为具体算例，展示了μF被锚定在悲观吸引盆中（错过0.8和0.9）而C*得到完整区间[0.1, 0.9]。所有结构结果可逐字推广到任意随机变量。
AI.conclusion: 格论框架为预言机的表演性预测问题提供了一条原则性的解决路径：最小不动点μF满足最小承诺/无偏性，但可能困于单一吸引盆；变体C*保证覆盖所有自一致单点但代价是更宽的答案。二者构成"最小性"与"公平性"之间的建模权衡。区间刻画在二元情况下成立，但在高维测度空间上是否保留仍是开放问题；可计算性、估计性、以及该机制是否真正保留科学家AI所追求的后果不变性（consequence invariance），均留待进一步研究。

title: Estimating Uncertainty in Classifier Performance with Applications to Large Language Models and Nested Data
summary: Researchers increasingly use text classification--supervised models or large language models--to measure constructs from natural language, providing metrics such as recall and precision as evidence of their validity. Yet, though these metrics are point estimates subject to sampling variation, measures of uncertainty are inconsistently reported alongside them. Further, when they are reported, they are often estimated with methods that are not appropriate when relevant labelled datasets are small or performance is high. To increase and improve confidence interval reporting in the field, this paper evaluates confidence interval methods for performance metrics under conditions typical of social science text classification: small to moderate sample sizes, infrequent constructs, and texts nested within individuals. Across simulations, default methods such as the Wald interval and the basic percentile bootstrap are the least accurate, with coverage sometimes far below the nominal 95% level. Accuracy is improved with the use of Agresti-Coull, Wilson, Clopper-Pearson, and a novel pseudo-count regularized bootstrap (which is particularly relevant to the calculation of F1). When texts are nested within individuals, we demonstrate that adjustment for both effective N and the appropriate degrees of freedom is necessary for producing accurate analytic intervals. Among bootstrap intervals, the hierarchical bootstrap is more accurate than the cluster bootstrap when individuals produce a moderate number of texts but overly conservative when individuals produce only a few. By providing guidance to the field on appropriate interval estimation, we aim to improve the transparency of machine learning applications, and to encourage greater attention to the validation sample size at the design stage.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了社会科学文本分类（特别是基于大语言模型的分类）中分类器性能指标（如准确率、召回率、精确率、F1等）的置信区间估计方法。研究在典型的小至中等样本量、罕见构念和文本嵌套于个体等条件下，通过模拟实验比较了Wald、Wilson、Agresti-Coull、Clopper-Pearson等解析区间方法和百分位、BCa、伪计数正则化等自助法区间方法，并提出了适用于嵌套数据的有效样本量和自由度调整方案。
AI.motivation: 在社会科学文本分类领域，研究者越来越多地使用监督学习或大语言模型来从自然语言中测量构念，并报告精确率、召回率等性能指标作为有效性证据。然而，这些点估计附带的置信区间报告不一致，且常用方法在小样本、高性能或嵌套数据条件下表现不佳。该研究旨在为该领域提供置信区间估计的最佳实践指导。
AI.method: 研究采用蒙特卡洛模拟方法：(1) 对独立数据，比较Wald、Wilson、Agresti-Coull、Clopper-Pearson解析区间和百分位、BCa、伪计数正则化自助法区间在样本量10-250、性能水平0.5-0.95条件下的覆盖率；(2) 提出伪计数正则化自助法（添加λ个伪成功和伪失败观测）以改善小样本高比例条件下的覆盖；(3) 对F1指标，在10%流行率下评估正则化自助法的性能；(4) 对嵌套数据，模拟2000名个体各60条文本的有限总体，比较简单随机抽样、聚类自助法和分层自助法，以及有效样本量（n_eff）和设计自由度（df_design）调整后的解析区间；(5) 比较小语料库（每人约3条）和中等语料库（每人约30条）两种抽样方案。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 在独立数据条件下，Wald区间和基本百分位自助法覆盖率最差，在p=0.95、n=20时覆盖率仅约0.66，在n=10时Wald覆盖率仅0.401、百分位自助法仅0.381；(2) Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson和伪计数正则化自助法（λ=1）在所有条件下均提供接近或高于95%的名义覆盖率；(3) 伪计数正则化自助法对F1特别有效，在n=30-100时基本百分位自助法覆盖率很少达到0.90，而正则化方法几乎总是达到0.95；(4) 对嵌套数据，未调整的Agresti-Coull区间在ICC≈0.11、5-50名个体、每人30条文本时覆盖率仅约65%；(5) 有效样本量和自由度联合调整（n_eff & df_design）的Wilson和Agresti-Coull区间在嵌套数据下提供准确覆盖；(6) 在每人约3条文本时，伪计数正则化聚类自助法更优；在每人约30条文本时，伪计数正则化分层自助法更准确；(7) 在固定总文本数条件下，增加个体数（而非每个体文本数）可大幅缩小区间宽度。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出明确建议：(1) 对独立数据，推荐Agresti-Coull区间作为默认方法，Wilson和Clopper-Pearson为合理替代，需要非解析区间时使用伪计数正则化自助法；(2) 对嵌套数据，当个体产生文本数较少（约3条）时，使用伪计数正则化聚类自助法；当文本数较多时，使用n_eff和df_design联合调整的解析区间或伪计数正则化分层自助法；(3) 强调在研究设计阶段就应关注验证样本量，特别是性能指标计算所需的相关样本量（召回率为人类正类标注数，精确率为机器正类分类数）和嵌套结构下的个体数量。该研究为提高机器学习应用的透明度和推动社会科学文本分类中置信区间报告标准化提供了重要指导。

title: Data-driven Machine Learning Cannot Reach Symbolic-level Logical Reasoning -- The Limit of the Scaling Law
summary: Sphere neural networks have achieved symbolic level syllogistic reasoning without training data, raising the question of where the limit of the scaling law for logical reasoning lies, i.e., whether data-driven machine learning systems can achieve the same level by increasing training data and training time. We show two methodological limitations that prevent supervised deep learning from reaching the symbolic-level syllogistic reasoning: (1) training data can not distinguish all 24 types of valid syllogistic reasoning; (2) end-to-end mapping from premises to conclusion introduces contradictory training targets between neural components for pattern recognition and logical reasoning. Beside theoretical analysis, we experimentally illustrate that Euler Net cannot achieve rigorous syllogistic reasoning. We further challenge the most recent ChatGPTs (GPT-5-nano and GPT-5) to determine the satisfiability of syllogistic statements in four surface forms (patterns): words, double words, simple symbols, and long random symbols, showing that surface forms affect the reasoning performance and that ChatGPT GPT-5 may reach 100% accuracy but still provide incorrect explanations. As empirical training processes are stopped after achieving 100% accuracy, we conclude that supervised machine learning systems will not attain the rigour of symbolic logical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了数据驱动的监督学习系统无法仅通过增加训练数据和训练时间来达到符号级的三段论推理水平，揭示了缩放定律在逻辑推理任务上的根本局限。
AI.motivation: 球神经网络（SphNN）已无需训练数据即可实现符号级三段论推理，这引发了核心疑问：数据驱动的机器学习系统能否仅通过扩大规模（增加数据和算力）达到同等严谨性？若答案为否，则意味着缩放定律存在根本边界，监督学习无法保证逻辑推理的严谨性。
AI.method: （1）理论分析：识别图像输入监督学习的两大方法论缺陷——训练数据无法区分全部24种有效三段论形式；端到端映射在模式识别与逻辑推理组件之间引入矛盾训练目标。（2）以Euler Net为代表进行实验，构建Super Euler Net（SupEN）自动迭代生成新训练数据并测试。（3）测试GPT-5-nano和GPT-5在四种表层形式（词、双词、简单符号、长随机符号）下的三段论推理性能。（4）分析自注意力机制本质上是一个习得的组合表。
AI.result: （1）SupEN对24种有效三段论形式的判别准确率仅50%–100%，整体仅76%；（2）SupEN会产生"未预期输入"——如自动将半圆补全为整圆、注入不存在的红蓝圆等，且新数据不断产生新的未预期输入，循环永不终止；（3）Euler Net对颜色敏感（绿色换为其他颜色后准确率可降至8.1%），说明其并未真正学到几何关系；（4）GPT-5虽可达100%决策准确率（如长随机符号），但仍伴随错误解释；表层词汇形式显著影响性能；（5）自注意力的softmax约束无法同时赋予"all"和"some"各100%的概率。
AI.conclusion: 无论采用符号输入（LLM）还是图像输入（Euler Net），监督学习系统都无法仅凭缩放达到符号级三段论推理的严谨性。训练数据本身无法提供区分所有有效推理形式的信息；端到端映射的内在矛盾无法通过增加数据消除；100%准确率并不等同于严谨推理。由于三段论是逻辑推理的基础，这一局限性揭示了缩放定律在逻辑推理领域的根本边界。

title: MKG-RAG-Bench: Benchmarking Retrieval in Multimodal Knowledge Graph-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs has emerged as a promising approach for grounding large language models, yet existing benchmarks largely overlook the challenges of retrieval in multimodal knowledge graph RAG (MKG-RAG). In practice, retrieval is a critical bottleneck: multimodal knowledge is heterogeneous, difficult to align across modalities, and often poorly served by retrievers designed for unstructured corpora. To address this gap, we introduce MKG-RAG-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate retrieval in MKG-RAG. MKG-RAG-Bench is constructed from two multimodal knowledge graphs spanning general and medical domains, and includes carefully aligned question-answering datasets that support controlled evaluation of both retrieval and downstream generation. The benchmark is built using an LLM-based curation pipeline that filters low-utility knowledge, generates structurally grounded queries with exact supervision, and systematically covers diverse modality configurations. Through extensive experiments across representative retriever families and modality settings, we show that effective multimodal retrieval remains challenging yet crucial for end-to-end MKG-RAG performance, and that retrieval quality strongly determines generation outcomes. By isolating retrieval as a first-class evaluation target, MKG-RAG-Bench provides a principled foundation for diagnosing current limitations and advancing multimodal knowledge graph RAG systems.

AI.tldr: MKG-RAG-Bench是首个面向多模态知识图谱增强生成（MKG-RAG）中检索任务的跨领域基准，涵盖通用（MarKG）和医疗（MedMKG）两个领域，通过LLM驱动的数据构建流水线生成精确对齐的查询-三元组-答案三元组，并系统评估四类检索器在不同模态组合下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG基准大多忽略多模态知识图谱检索的挑战，而实际中检索是MKG-RAG的关键瓶颈——多模态知识异构、跨模态对齐困难、且现有检索器主要面向非结构化语料。初步实验表明，直接将现有多模态知识图谱与下游任务拼接会导致检索增强效果差于无检索的基线，揭示了知识源、检索目标与评估之间存在严重错位。
AI.method: 提出三阶段LLM驱动的数据构建流水线：(1) 基于LLM的效用过滤，剔除低信息量的通用三元组；(2) 通过三元组遮蔽（关系遮蔽或尾实体遮蔽）模拟受控不完全性；(3) 混合问题合成（纯文本问题和图像引导问题），利用GPT-5生成自然语言查询。对四类检索器（纯文本、融合式多模态、字幕式、重排序式）在5种查询-三元组模态组合设置下进行训练无关的检索和生成评估。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 模态鸿沟持续存在——纯文本检索器无法桥接跨模态匹配；(2) 多模态嵌入对视觉基础检索至关重要，字幕式检索因信息瓶颈表现不佳；(3) 检索难度和最优方法具有领域依赖性——通用域融合式更优，医疗域重排序式更优；(4) 检索增强确实能提升生成质量，但多模态场景下提升有限；(5) 生成性能与检索质量高度一致。消融实验验证了效用过滤的必要性，跨LLM一致性分析（Qwen3.5 99.7%、Gemini 2.5 Flash 97.0%）证明了流水线对LLM选择的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MKG-RAG-Bench将检索提升为一类独立评估目标，为诊断当前MKG-RAG系统局限性提供了原则性基础，有望推动图感知、领域自适应的多模态检索方法及结构化知识与多模态生成更有效整合的研究。

title: auto-psych: Automating the science of mind using agent-driven theory discovery and experimentation
summary: AI-based scientific automation is increasingly possible by using agents to generate hypotheses, design experiments, and analyze data. Data collection is a major bottleneck in this pipeline, however. Psychology, and computational cognitive science in particular, is well-positioned to benefit from AI experimentation because theories are often represented as code and crowdsourcing platforms enable programmatic human data collection at scale. Here, we apply automated discovery techniques to the project of generating theories in computational cognitive science, with an agent-based system collecting human data independently through crowdsourced survey experiments.
