As a testbed, we use a classic case study from cognitive psychology: judging which sequences of coin flips seem subjectively more random. Our system, auto-psych, uses nested agent-based discovery loops to generate explanatory theories of human behavior. The inner loop conjectures, fits, and critiques probabilistic cognitive models; the outer loop designs experiments to test these models, launches them online, and analyzes the data. This system can quickly and reliably recover ground-truth theories from synthetic data via systematic experimentation, but the nested structure is critical to model performance. Further, in three independent sequences of human experiments, the system finds theories that fit the data better than theories generated from the scientific literature. This work thus demonstrates the feasibility of automated data collection and theory discovery in computational cognitive science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 auto-psych 框架，利用基于 LLM 的智能体系统自动化计算认知科学中的完整科学发现循环（假设生成→实验设计→人类数据采集→模型批评与修正），以"主观随机性判断"为测试任务，通过嵌套的双环结构（内环为 Box's loop 式的模型批评与改进，外环为实验设计与人类数据采集），证明了该系统能从合成数据中可靠恢复真实模型，并在真实人类实验中发现优于文献种子模型的新理论。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI 辅助科学研究多停留在"使用已有数据集进行模型发现"（Box's loop），但完整科学发现需要"实验室在环"（lab-in-the-loop），即针对特定假设设计新实验并采集新数据。计算认知科学因其理论以概率编程代码形式表达、且可通过众包平台（如 Prolific）程序化地大规模采集人类数据，成为 AI 自动化科学发现的理想领域。然而，以往自动化认知建模工作尚未整合到完整的人类实验循环中。
AI.method: 采用基于 LLM（gemini-3.1-pro-preview，运行于 OpenCode 框架）的多智能体系统实现嵌套双环结构：(1) 外环——理论家智能体以"假设搜索"框架方式（先自然语言描述假设，再翻译为 PyMC 概率程序）提出新模型；设计智能体生成 100-300 个候选刺激并按预期信息增益（EIG）贪心选择；实现智能体用 jsPsych 模板构建实验并通过 Firebase 部署、Prolific API 招募参与者（N=40/轮）。(2) 内环（Box's loop）——批评家智能体基于 CriticAL 框架提出 8 个检验统计量并进行后验预测检验；理论家智能体针对统计量显著差异提出新模型。使用 MCMC 拟合模型，以 ELPD-LOO 加代码长度复杂度惩罚作为评分标准。测试任务为"主观随机性判断"——被试在两个硬币翻转序列中选择更"随机"的那个；四个种子模型源自文献（编码可压缩性、贝叶斯诊断性、窗口典型性、原型相似性）。
AI.result: (1) 模型恢复：auto-psych 能可靠地从合成数据中恢复作为地面真实的种子模型及心理上不合理的"外星"模型（RMSE 持续低于最优种子模型），且消融实验证明嵌套结构至关重要（去掉内环后恢复性能显著下降）。(2) 人类实验：三次独立运行（每轮 9 次实验，262 个独特刺激对，~11k 试次）均发现优于种子的模型；最佳模型"Minkowski 典型性模型"在 ELPD-LOO、RMSE 和 R² 上均显著优于所有种子模型（解释约 83% 的可解释方差，信度上限 0.80），且在跨数据集（留出本轮数据）测试中仍保持优势，未出现过拟合。三轮分别发现了概念上不同但行为预测相似的原型比较类、证据累积类和贝叶斯诊断性变体模型。
AI.conclusion: auto-psych 是首个实现完整自动化迭代心理学循环的框架，AI 智能体独立设计实验并采集真实人类数据。该系统在主观随机性这一经典案例上证明了自动化数据采集与理论发现在计算认知科学中的可行性，能发现比文献种子模型更优的理论，且嵌套双环结构不可或缺。局限包括仅单一案例研究、刺激空间受限、继承传统计算认知科学的局限（抽象刺激、WEIRD 样本、平均化分析）。论文同时讨论了自动化科学发现的潜在风险（理论同质化、同行评审压力、科学家技能退化），主张将此类系统定位为增强而非取代科学家的工具。

title: Clinical Harness for Governable Medical AI Skill Ecosystems
summary: Medical AI remains organized around isolated models, whereas clinical care requires accountable capabilities that persist across time. We propose clinical AI skills and the Clinical Harness: a runtime governance architecture for registering, orchestrating, guarding and monitoring AI-enabled clinical capabilities. Using osteoporosis as an exemplar, we show how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care under runtime governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"临床AI技能"概念及"临床管理框架(Clinical Harness)"，这是一种运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、保护和监控AI赋能的临床能力，并以骨质疏松症为例进行验证。
AI.motivation: 当前医疗AI仍以孤立模型为中心，而临床护理需要的是可问责的、能跨时间持续存在的能力。作者旨在弥合这一差距，将AI能力从孤立的模型转向可持续治理的临床技能。
AI.method: 提出"临床AI技能"概念与"临床管理框架"运行时治理架构，涵盖注册、编排、保护和监控四个功能；融合知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强三类技能，并以骨质疏松症的全生命周期护理作为应用范例进行验证。
AI.result: （仅提供摘要）展示了如何通过运行时治理架构将多种AI技能整合，支持骨质疏松症全生命周期护理，验证了该框架的可行性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过临床管理框架和临床AI技能概念，可实现AI赋能的临床能力的可问责、可持续治理，超越传统孤立模型范式，推动医疗AI向面向真实临床场景的能力导向转变。

title: Humans Disengage, Reasoning Models Persist: Separating Difficulty Registration from Deliberation Allocation
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) take longer on harder problems, just as humans do. This surface similarity hides an opposite pattern within items. When an LRM gets a problem wrong, it spends more tokens than when it gets the same problem right; humans do the reverse, spending less time on the trials they get wrong. We separate two levels of deliberation: how response time tracks difficulty across items (registration), and, with item identity held fixed, whether an agent spends more on its own failures or successes (allocation). On a public matched human-LRM corpus, humans and all five thinking LRMs reproduce the known cross-item alignment (registration) but diverge within items (allocation): every LRM shows a large wrong-vs-right effect (Cohen's d = 1.47-3.13 on H-ARC) while humans show the opposite sign. The comparison stays inside each agent's own scale; we never put seconds and tokens on one axis. The dissociation holds under item fixed effects, replicates across datasets, and is absent in a non-thinking baseline. We read the human pattern as engagement versus abandonment: people stay on items they expect to solve and give up on the rest. We read the LRM pattern as length driven by uncertainty: chains grow when the model is unsure, which is exactly when it tends to fail. Both policies produce the same cross-item correlation with difficulty, so they look aligned on the measure prior work has used; the divergence shows up only once item identity is fixed. Under resource-rational metareasoning, the split is between two stopping policies that share a difficulty signal but implement opposite control; trace length captures the signal and misses the control.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比人类与大型推理模型(LRM)在相同推理任务上的"审议分配"行为,发现二者虽在跨项目难度登记上一致(都认为难题耗时更长),但在项目内部分配上呈现相反模式:人类在答错的题目上花的时间更少(放弃/脱离),而LRM则在答错的题目上生成更多推理token(持续推演)。这种分离通过项目固定效应(item fixed effects)在H-ARC、INTUIT、Cortes三个范式上得到验证,并通过追踪内容特征(自我怀疑标记、词汇重复率)与人类动作计数得到机制层面的佐证。论文提出"登记vs分配"两层诊断框架,认为当前LRM的监测(monitoring)与控制(stopping)耦合较弱,并建议以受控截断实验作为下一步判别性检验。
AI.motivation: de Varda等(2025)报告LRM推理token长度与人类反应时在跨项目层面高度相关,被解读为"人类-模型审议对齐"的证据。但该发现仅证明双方对难度的"登记"(registration)一致,无法说明二者是否在"分配"(allocation)——即面对同一项目时如何决定继续思考还是放弃——上使用相同的控制规则。已有评论(Vankov、Dujmović、Hu)均呼吁提供更精细的诊断。本研究填补这一空缺:提出项目内部、受结果调节(outcome-conditioned)的分配诊断,检验同一项目上答对与答错的审议量是否在不同智能体间呈现一致模式。
AI.method: 二次分析公开数据(de Varda等2025 OSF发布):三个范式——H-ARC(视觉抽象,主范式,n=4091人类/1637 LRM)、INTUIT(直觉物理,跨范式复制)、Cortes(二元关系推理,边界情况)。六个开源思维LRM(DeepSeek-R1、Qwen-QwQ-32B、Qwen3-235B-Thinking、GLM-4.5-Air-FP8、gpt-oss-20b/120b)加DeepSeek-V3非思维对照。核心指标:每个智能体自身的Cohen's d(log deliberation, wrong-right);跨智能体比较保留在各自原生单位(秒vs token不直接比较)。主要估计量:组合项目固定效应回归 log t = α + βc + β_LRM(c × LRM) + δ_agent + γ_item + ε,聚类稳健SE按项目;辅以Mundlak(1978)within-between分解、leave-one-out难度控制、追踪内容特征(自我怀疑标记密度、5-gram重复率、TTR)回归。人类侧利用H-ARC的每试次动作计数(网格编辑数)分解投入/脱离。
AI.result: H-ARC上:四个良效LRM的Cohen's d范围1.47-3.13(均在错误试次上花更多token);匹配人类样本d=-0.10(错误试次时间更短)。项目FE主估计量β_LRM=-0.66,p<10^-16,CI[-0.81,-0.50];五种规范下点估计-0.66至-0.94且CI严格小于零。Mundlak分解:人类within-item斜率+0.24、between-item斜率-0.54(提示跨项目脱离模式)。人类动作计数作为协变量将人类within斜率从+0.24降至+0.12(48%缩减),证实脱离成分。INTUIT跨范式复制成功(β_LRM=-0.41,p<.001);Cortes边界案例:LRM单项within斜率翻为+0.31,但人类更强正斜率使agent-type分离仍显著(β_LRM=-0.97,p<.001)。追踪特征:错误链中H-ARC自我怀疑标记密度高0.43/1000字符(β=-0.435,p=7e-4);Cortes错误链5-gram重复率高7.4%且TTR低4.1个百分点。跨范式模型等级稳定(Spearman ρ=0.77-0.89)。
AI.conclusion: 登记与分配可解耦:人类和思维LRM对项目难度的排序一致,但面对同一困难项目时使用相反的停止规则。人类模式契合资源理性(resource-rational)框架下的"投入vs脱离"调度——成功预期高时坚持,否则放弃;LRM模式则表现为"长度跟踪不确定性"——不确定时生成长链,而长链恰落在最终失败的试次上,揭示其监测(monitoring,自我怀疑标记在错误时升高)与控制(stopping)耦合较弱。该结论不否定de Varda等的跨项目对齐发现,但主张任何"审议对齐"的机制论断必须配以项目内、受结果调节的分配诊断。论文呼吁以受控截断实验(f∈(0,1)固定token预算)在f≈0.5-0.8区段区分"有用搜索"(后期陡升)与"长度跟踪不确定性"(早期平台)两种预测,并以此判定额外token是否承载任务相关计算价值。

title: NeuraDock Visual Cognitive Load Agent Tutorial: A Quality-Gated Open-Source EEG Workflow for Alpha Dynamics and Real-Time Applications
summary: This tutorial paper provides a step-by-step, reproducible walkthrough of NeuraDock Agent, an open-source EEG agent focused on Alpha dynamics and visual cognitive-load analysis. The goal is practical: a reader should be able to install the agent, run EEG preprocessing and quality control, generate Alpha dynamics figures, perform within-subject Rest/Task visual cognitive-load comparison, run the public mini-dataset analyses and compare them with the reference validation summary, start an online dashboard, call the real-time API from an external application, and use the LLM interpretation layer to explain quality risks. Existing EEG toolkits provide excellent offline analysis, but assembling a real-time, quality-gated cognitive-load pipeline often requires manually bridging acquisition, custom QC, Alpha feature extraction, and a web API; this tutorial closes that offline-to-online gap. The tutorial uses a quality-gated workflow: downstream Alpha and workload metrics are computed only after preprocessing and QC gating rather than directly from raw EEG. In the included mini-dataset validation, the agent processed 18 recordings, generated 10 within-subject comparisons, observed task-related posterior Alpha suppression in 7 of 10 contrasts, estimated initial evidence of within-subject repeatability, and benchmarked local online API latency. The tutorial is intended for researchers, developers, and applied teams who want a transparent path from EEG files to real-time visual cognitive-load prototypes.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇教程型论文，系统介绍了开源EEG工具NeuraDock Agent的完整使用流程。该工具专注于Alpha动力学和视觉认知负荷分析，提供从离线预处理、质控门控、Alpha特征提取到在线实时API的端到端工作流，填补了现有通用EEG工具包在"离线到在线"部署之间的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG工具（如MNE-Python、EEGLAB、BrainFlow）功能强大但偏通用，商业SDK（如Emotiv、Neurosity）支持实时但不开源且不专注于认知负荷。研究者往往能完成离线分析，却难以将同一套逻辑部署为其他应用可持续调用的实时服务。该教程旨在搭建一条从EEG文件到实时API的可审计、可复现路径。
AI.method: 1. 七通道NeuraDock专用电极配置（CP5/CP6/PO3/PO4/O1/Oz/O2），250 Hz采样，针对后部Alpha设计；2. 质控门控工作流——下游Alpha与认知负荷指标仅在预处理和分段质控通过后才计算；3. Alpha动力学分析（时域、频域、时频）+ 弱/基线/强Alpha分类 + 峰频 + 右-左不对称；4. 被试内Rest/Task离线对比（Task-Rest后部log Alpha差值）；5. 在线模式：硬件TCP流→滚动4 s窗口→HTTP dashboard + /api/status接口；6. LLM解释层仅接收白名单摘要，不接触原始EEG。
AI.result: 在公开小型数据集（18条记录）上，生成10组被试内对比，10组中有7组观察到任务相关的后部Alpha抑制（方向符合预期）。最显著案例：xzy Game vs Rest的对数Alpha差为-0.303，功率比0.50；ljw Chat vs Rest差值为-0.283，比值0.52。基线重测（S01-S03 Rest session 1 vs 2）Pearson r=0.803，ICC(C,1)=0.765，提示被试内可重复性的初步证据。本地在线处理核心中位延迟1.89 ms（p95=2.66 ms），HTTP端点中位15.15 ms（p95=27.18 ms）。
AI.conclusion: NeuraDock Agent是一个聚焦视觉认知负荷的硬件调优、可复现开源工作流。其核心设计原则是"质控门控优先于负荷估计"——下游指标必须来自QC通过的数据，且必须伴随质量状态报告。教程形式使读者能运行命令、检查生成的图表，并将实时API集成到自定义应用中。论文明确声明该系统不用于临床、注意、疲劳或认知能力诊断。局限在于：小型数据集验证、在线基准基于本地回放而非真实无线硬件、工作负荷估计尚未融合行为指标、瞳孔或多模态生理信号。

title: Boundary-Aware Context Grounding for A Low-Channel EEG Agent
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can make scientific software easier to use. However, a general model does not automatically know which measurements a particular sensor can support, which algorithms are implemented in the current software, or which conclusions are justified by a computed result. These distinctions are especially important for low-channel electroencephalography (EEG), where sparse spatial coverage and variable signal quality make plausible but unsupported interpretations easy to produce. We present NeuraDock Agent, an open-source architecture that separates a deterministic local EEG engine from a hardware-aware language layer. The numerical engine parses recordings, performs quality control, executes reviewed spectral workflows, and writes machine-readable artifacts. The LLM receives only a compact, allowlisted summary and a versioned context pack. The context describes the seven-channel hardware, reviewed workflows, result fields, implementation boundaries, scientific limits, and reference cases. Raw EEG and dense per-sample arrays remain local We evaluate the system at three levels. First, 12 recordings produced identical structured results over ten numerical repetitions, and a complete Rest/Task run produced identical result, report, and figure hashes over three repetitions. Second, request-capture and failure-injection experiments confirmed the tested data boundary and preservation of local artifacts under HTTP, malformed-output, and connection failures. Third, a boundary-awareness benchmark tested 36 ordinary and adversarial questions under four context ablations and two LLMs, yielding 288 this http URL results support hardware- and implementation-aware grounding as a practical mechanism for calibrating what an EEG agent accepts, qualifies, or refuses; they do not establish clinical validity or a validated absolute cognitive-load index.

AI.tldr: NeuraDock Agent 是一个开源架构，将确定性的本地 EEG 计算引擎与硬件感知的语言层分离。LLM 仅接收经过白名单筛选的紧凑结果摘要和版本化上下文包（含七通道硬件、已审核工作流、结果字段、实现边界和科学限制），原始 EEG 始终留在本地。在 36 个案例、4 种上下文条件和 2 个模型的边界感知基准测试中，精确决策准确率从通用提示的 58.3% 提升至完整上下文的 79.2%，严格安全响应率从 26.4% 提升至 66.7%，可行请求的错误拒绝率从 27.8% 降至 8.3%。
AI.motivation: 将通用 LLM 直接用于 EEG 等科学软件存在严重的"类别错误"：模型的广博知识并不等于对特定设备、协议、软件版本和结果模式的了解。低通道 EEG 因空间采样稀疏，更容易产生解剖学上似乎合理但物理上无法支持的错误解读（例如将后部节律误标为额叶效应）。核心问题不在于事实回忆，而在于"边界意识"（boundary awareness）——区分物理边界（传感器能观察什么）、实现边界（软件实现了什么）、结果边界（输出字段实际报告什么）和科学边界（哪些推论可被支持）。此外，将随机性代码生成放入数值分析路径会带来额外变异性和责任风险。
AI.method: 系统采用三层架构：(1) 严格的 I/O 层和硬件配置文件（7 通道干电极，CP5/CP6/PO3/PO4/O1/Oz/O2，250 Hz）；(2) 确定性科学核心，执行已审核工作流（Signal Quality、PSD/Band Power、Visual Cognitive Load、Rest/Task Comparison、Device Doctor、Demonstration），输出 results.json、report.md 和图表；(3) LLM 规划与解释层，通过白名单投影接收紧凑摘要，附带版本化上下文包。Visual Cognitive Load 是一种记录内相对的后部 alpha 启发式方法，通过 zα、zf、z|A| 加权合成得分 q=0.65·clip(-zα)+0.15·clip(zf)+0.20·clip(z|A|)，按三分位分为低/中/高标签。评估分三层：(a) 确定性（12 个记录 × 10 次重复 + 端到端 3 次）；(b) 请求边界审计、路由与故障注入（HTTP 400/格式错误输出/连接拒绝）；(c) 边界感知基准（36 个案例 × 4 种上下文消融 × 2 个模型 = 288 个输出）。
AI.result: （1）可重复性：12 个记录在 10 次重复中产生相同的结构化哈希；端到端 Rest/Task 运行的 result/report/figure 哈希三次完全一致。（2）请求边界：原始记录 8.15 MB，planner 和解释请求仅 10.6 KB 和 23.3 KB，源路径、密集键、140 个原始值标记均缺席。（3）故障隔离：三种注入故障下本地 artifacts 全部保留。（4）边界基准：精确决策准确率从 Generic 58.3% → Hardware 70.8% → Hardware+Implementation 76.4% → Full Context 79.2%；严格安全响应率从 26.4% 升至 66.7%；可行请求拒绝率从 27.8% 降至 8.3%；不支持请求的接受率仅 1.4%。（5）关键发现：完整上下文并非在所有次要指标上最优——Hardware+Implementation 在安全响应率（68.1% vs 66.7%）上略胜。（6）质量缺陷：1-15 秒的平线信号丢失未被检测到。（7）失败分析：24 个未达标的全上下文输出中，15 个为四向决策错误（条件性语义保留困难），9 个为事实回忆不足，无匹配虚假声明。
AI.conclusion: 硬件和实现感知的上下文接地是校准 EEG 智能体行为（接受、限定或拒绝）的实用机制，但该研究并未确立临床有效性或绝对认知负荷指数。可信的 LLM 行为需要同时具备有用的拒绝和有用的接受；零不支持接受率与 27.8% 可行请求拒绝率并存表明单纯的拒绝并不等于专业能力。研究的可持续原则是：语言模型应在明确的、版本化的、可测试的科学边界内运行。"更多上下文"并不单调地带来质量提升——决策相关上下文的精选检索比最大化提示覆盖更可行。系统应记录缺失的上下文模块，因为基于不完整检索的自信回答本身就是一种边界失效。

title: Radical AI Interpretability
comment: Draft of manuscript to appear as Cambridge Element in the Philosophy of Artificial Intelligence
summary: We develop a framework for interpreting AI systems as agents, drawing on the philosophical tradition of radical interpretation and the tools of mechanistic interpretability. The core question is: given the computational facts about a system, how do we solve for its beliefs, desires, and meanings? This matters increasingly for safety. We want to be able to trust the systems we deploy, whether by understanding their goals or, more modestly, by reliably detecting deception. Interpretability researchers are building tools to read beliefs and desires off a model's internals, but there is no settled account of when such a tool has succeeded. This book supplies one. We propose criteria on both representationalist and interpretationist approaches, and tie each to tests current interpretability methods can carry out. A central lesson is that these attributions cannot be made piecemeal. Beliefs, desires, and the propositional structure they presuppose are jointly constrained, and a method that fixes one while measuring the others inherits whatever distortions that introduces. This holism becomes pressing for AI systems, which may not share the interpreter's concepts. However, it also provides leverage: a system's attitudes constrain its propositional structure, that structure constrains which attitudes can be attributed, and mechanistic interpretability can help us measure both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将AI系统视为智能体（agent）进行解释的框架，结合哲学中的"激进解释"（radical interpretation）传统和机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）工具，旨在解决如何从计算事实中推断AI系统的信念、欲望和意义，以应对AI安全中对目标理解和欺骗检测的需求。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统的部署，我们需要信任它们，这要求我们能够理解其目标或检测其欺骗行为。当前的可解释性研究虽然能够从模型内部读取信念和欲望，但缺乏一个判断"何时这种读取是成功的"的明确标准。AI系统可能不与解释者共享概念，这使得传统基于人类概念的解读方法面临根本性挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出一个融合"表征主义"（representationalist）和"解释主义"（interpretationist）两种哲学路径的框架：（1）借鉴Quine等人的激进解释传统——即从行为和计算事实出发，反向求解系统的信念、欲望和意义；（2）结合机制可解释性方法，将模型内部激活、电路等作为约束条件；（3）提出整体论（holism）方法论：信念、欲望及其预设的命题结构是联合约束的，不能逐个独立测量，必须同时考虑三者之间的相互制约关系；（4）为每种哲学立场配套设计可由现有可解释性方法执行的检验测试。
AI.result: 本文的核心成果/贡献是：（1）建立了一套判断可解释性工具是否成功读取了AI系统心理态度的判定标准；（2）论证了心理归因（信念、欲望、意义）必须以整体方式进行的核心理论立场；（3）展示了这种整体论既构成挑战（AI可能不共享人类概念），又提供了方法论上的"杠杆"——态度约束命题结构，命题结构约束可归因的态度，而机制可解释性可同时测量二者；（4）为表征主义和解释主义两种进路各自提供了可操作的检验标准。
AI.conclusion: 对AI系统的信念、欲望和意义不能进行零散（piecemeal）的归因；这些心理态度必须在整体论框架下被联合约束和测量。这一立场对AI安全具有直接意义，为目标理解和欺骗检测提供了更坚实的哲学基础和方法论指导。

title: PMDformer: Patch-Mean Decoupling Information Transformer for Long-term Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) plays a crucial role in fields such as energy management, finance, and traffic prediction. Transformer-based models have adopted patch-based strategies to capture long-range dependencies, but accurately modeling shape similarities across patches and variables remains challenging due to scale differences. To address this, we introduce patch-mean decoupling (PMD), which separates the trend and residual shape information by subtracting the mean of each patch, preserving the original structure and ensuring that the attention mechanism captures true shape similarities. Futhermore, to more effectively model long-range dependencies and capture cross-variable relationships, we propose Trend Restoration Attention (TRA) and Proximal Variable Attention (PVA). The former module reintegrates the decoupled trend from PMD while calculating attention output. And the latter focuses cross-variable attention on the most relevant, recent time segments to avoid overfitting on outdated correlations. Combining these components, we propose PMDformer, a model designed to effectively capture shape similarity in long-term forecasting scenarios. Extensive experiments indicate that PMDformer outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in stability and accuracy across multiple LTSF benchmarks. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PMDformer是一种用于长期时间序列预测（LTSF）的Transformer模型，通过引入补丁均值解耦（PMD）机制解决现有patch-based方法中由尺度差异导致的注意力权重偏差问题。其核心思想是将每个patch的均值（趋势信息）与残差形状信息分离，使注意力机制专注于真实的形状相似性。同时结合趋势恢复注意力（TRA）和近端变量注意力（PVA），分别在时间维度恢复全局趋势、在变量维度聚焦最近的patch进行建模。在8个LTSF基准测试中，PMDformer在7个数据集上取得最优，平均MSE较TimeBase降低5.68%，较TQNet降低8.62%，较iTransformer降低11.44%。
AI.motivation: 现有的patch-based Transformer模型在长期时间序列预测中存在两个关键问题：（1）由于时间序列的非平稳性，不同patch之间存在显著的尺度差异，导致注意力权重被均值（尺度）主导，无法反映真实的形状相似性。例如图1所示，形状相似的patch（P1,P2）反而获得较低的注意力权重，而尺度更大但形状差异显著的patch（P1,P3）获得更高权重。（2）传统的Patch Normalization方法（如减均值除以标准差）虽然能缓解尺度差异，但除以标准差会扭曲patch的原始形状信息，破坏形状相似性的识别。此外，现有的变量依赖（VD）方法在跨整个历史窗口建模变量关系时，容易过拟合于过时的、弱相关的历史依赖，限制了预测性能。
AI.method: PMDformer由四个协同模块组成：(1) **补丁均值解耦（PMD）**：将输入序列划分为N个非重叠patch，计算每个patch的均值μ和残差r=P−μ·1_S，仅对残差进行嵌入，保留均值作为趋势分量。这避免了除以标准差带来的形状扭曲。(2) **近端变量注意力（PVA）**：仅在最后一个（最近的）patch上对所有C个变量进行多头自注意力建模跨变量依赖，将复杂度从O(C²N)降至O(C²)，有效避免过时相关性的过拟合。(3) **趋势恢复注意力（TRA）**：在时间维度对各变量独立应用Transformer编码器，Q和K仅基于形状嵌入计算（保证形状相似性匹配），而V通路中显式注入patch均值μ以恢复全局趋势信息。(4) **投影层**：最终将趋势均值重新加入精炼后的形状嵌入，生成多步预测。论文还提供了理论分析（Proposition 1），证明了当patch均值较大时，注意力logit会被均值相关项主导，从而形式化地证明了尺度偏差的存在。
AI.result: 在8个公开LTSF基准数据集（ECL、Traffic、Weather、Solar、ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2）上，使用输入长度720和预测长度{96,192,336,720}进行评估。PMDformer在7/8数据集上取得最低MSE和MAE，平均MSE较TimeBase减少5.68%/MAE减少6.61%，较TQNet减少8.62%/9.96%，较iTransformer减少11.44%/12.38%。消融实验验证了：(a) PMD优于标准差归一化和SAN方法，在非平稳数据上保留形状信息更有效；(b) PVA仅取最近1个patch（k=1）性能最佳且最稳定，增加k会导致性能下降；(c) TRA替换为标准自注意力或移除PVA均导致显著性能下降，证实两模块的互补性；(d) 模块顺序敏感，先TRA后PVA会过早压缩patch信息。参数敏感性分析表明中等patch大小（24-72）效果最优。效率分析显示PMDformer在不同变量数和输入长度下GPU显存占用最低。合成数据实验直观展示了PMD使模型能够识别跨尺度patch的真实形状相似性。
AI.conclusion: PMDformer通过形状中心化的Transformer设计有效解决了长期时间序列预测中尺度偏差和过时依赖两大核心挑战。PMD模块以最小信息损失（仅减均值而非除标准差）实现了趋势-形状解耦，使注意力聚焦于真正的形状相似性；PVA通过限定在最近patch建模变量关系，兼顾了预测相关性和计算效率；TRA通过在V通路中恢复趋势，确保全局动态信息不丢失。论文的贡献在于：(1)提出了一种新颖的残差均值解耦机制用于注意力模块内的趋势-形状分离；(2)提出近端变量注意力以缓解过拟合；(3)在多个LTSF基准上验证了方法的优越性。未来方向包括扩展到高维多变量数据和多模态集成（如能源、金融、交通领域的应用）。

title: Explainable Ensemble-Based Machine Learning Models for Detecting the Presence of Cirrhosis in Hepatitis C Patients
summary: Hepatitis C is a liver infection caused by a virus, which results in mild to severe inflammation of the liver. Over many years, hepatitis C gradually damages the liver, often leading to permanent scarring, known as cirrhosis. Patients sometimes have moderate or no symptoms of liver illness for decades before developing cirrhosis. Cirrhosis typically worsens to the point of liver failure. Patients with cirrhosis may also experience brain and nerve system damage, as well as gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Treatment for cirrhosis focuses on preventing further progression of the disease. Detecting cirrhosis earlier is therefore crucial for avoiding complications. Machine learning (ML) has been shown to be effective at providing precise and accurate information for use in diagnosing several diseases. Despite this, no studies have so far used ML to detect cirrhosis in patients with hepatitis C. This study obtained a dataset consisting of 28 attributes of 2038 Egyptian patients from the ML Repository of the University of California at Irvine. Four ML algorithms were trained on the dataset to diagnose cirrhosis in hepatitis C patients: a Random Forest, a Gradient Boosting Machine, an Extreme Gradient Boosting, and an Extra Trees model. The Extra Trees model outperformed the other models achieving an accuracy of 96.92%, a recall of 94.00%, a precision of 99.81%, and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 96% using only 16 of the 28 features.

AI.tldr: 本文使用四种机器学习算法（随机森林、梯度提升机、极端梯度提升和极端随机树）检测丙型肝炎患者的肝硬化，其中极端随机树模型表现最佳，仅使用28个特征中的16个即达到96.92%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 丙型肝炎若不及时诊断会导致肝硬化甚至肝衰竭等严重并发症。由于肝硬化早期症状隐匿，传统诊断方法存在局限，因此需要利用机器学习技术实现早期精准检测，以避免疾病恶化。
AI.method: 研究采用UCI机器学习知识库中2038名埃及患者的28个属性数据集，训练并比较了四种机器学习模型：随机森林（RF）、梯度提升机（GBM）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和极端随机树（Extra Trees），并通过特征选择将特征数从28个缩减至16个进行建模。
AI.result: 极端随机树（Extra Trees）模型性能最优，准确率为96.92%，召回率为94.00%，精确率为99.81%，AUC值为96%。特征选择表明仅需16个关键特征即可实现高效诊断。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明机器学习（特别是Extra Trees算法）能够有效、准确地检测丙型肝炎患者的肝硬化，为临床早期诊断提供了一种可靠且高效的辅助工具。

title: EvoOptiGraph: Weakness-Driven Coevolution via Graph-Based Structural Generation for Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating optimization modeling from natural language with large language models (LLMs) faces two key challenges. First, training corpora lack structural diversity. Second, data generation pipelines remain static and decoupled from model learning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoOptiGraph, a novel framework where data and model co-evolve, driven by model weaknesses. EvoOptiGraph represents each mixed-integer linear program (MILP) as an attributed bipartite graph and applies validity-preserving evolutionary operators to generate structurally diverse instances. The evolved graphs are converted into solver code and natural language via deterministic compilation and verified back-translation. Training proceeds in two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on an initial dataset, followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where graph-derived weakness signals guide the generation of new instances targeting the model's failures. This forms a closed loop that continuously updates the training distribution. Empirical results on six public datasets show that EvoOptiGraph significantly outperforms larger generalist models, agentic methods, and specialized baselines in accuracy, executability, and generalization. These results demonstrate that targeted data-model coevolution is an effective strategy for improving LLMs on optimization modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: EvoOptiGraph提出了一种数据与模型协同进化的框架，通过将混合整数线性规划（MILP）建模为属性二部图并施加保有效性进化算子来生成结构多样化的训练实例，结合SFT与RLVR两阶段训练，以模型弱点信号驱动数据生成闭环，在六个公开数据集上显著超越通用大模型、Agent方法和专用基线。
AI.motivation: 基于自然语言的自动化优化建模面临两大核心挑战：（1）训练语料缺乏结构多样性，限制了模型对不同问题结构的泛化能力；（2）数据生成管线静态且与模型学习解耦，无法针对性地弥补模型薄弱环节。现有方法难以同时兼顾数据多样性与训练-生成的协同优化。
AI.method: 1）将每个MILP问题建模为属性二部图，统一表示变量、约束与目标函数之间的结构关系；2）设计保有效性进化算子（如同构变异、边增删等），在图空间中生成结构多样的新实例；3）通过确定性编译将进化图转换为求解器代码与自然语言描述，并利用回译验证（back-translation）保证语义一致性；4）训练采用两阶段范式：先在初始数据集上进行监督微调（SFT），再进入带可验证奖励的强化学习阶段（RLVR），其中图衍生的弱点信号识别模型失败模式，反向指导新实例的定向生成，形成"数据生成→模型训练→弱点分析→数据更新"的闭环。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上的实验表明，EvoOptiGraph在准确性（accuracy）、可执行性（executability）和泛化能力（generalization）三个维度上均显著优于：（a）参数量更大的通用大语言模型，（b）基于Agent的方法（如多步推理/工具调用方案），以及（c）面向优化建模的专用基线模型。消融实验验证了图表示、进化算子及闭环数据生成机制各自的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EvoOptiGraph证明了以模型弱点为驱动的数据-模型协同进化是提升LLM优化建模能力的有效策略。其核心贡献在于：首次将进化式数据生成与可验证奖励强化学习相结合，通过图结构空间的系统性探索突破了静态训练语料的多样性瓶颈，为结构化形式化任务的LLM训练提供了可推广的闭环范式。

title: A Multi-Level Validation and Traceability Framework for AI-Generated Telescope Scheduling Decisions
summary: With the gradual introduction of AI into telescope scheduling, AI-based decision-making has shown advantages in handling complex multi-constraint problems. However, its outputs often suffer from inconsistent data references, reasoning errors, and non-executable decisions, limiting applicability in high-reliability observational tasks. In this work, we propose a multi-level validation and traceable reasoning framework that performs systematic reliability verification of AI-generated decisions prior to execution, and enables explicit representation of the reasoning process to support traceable decision-making. The framework integrates data reference validation, logical consistency checks, and observational and instrumental constraint verification to filter and correct invalid decisions. It also introduces atomic reasoning units and their dependency relationships, representing scheduling decisions as a sequence of interconnected reasoning steps that support error localization and post hoc analysis. Experiments show that the framework improves executability and reliability of AI scheduling and reduces loss of transient opportunities. In particular, feedback correction and structured validation of reasoning steps enhance the ability to repair and block erroneous decisions, especially in complex scenarios. Compared with pure AI methods, the framework-enhanced approach maintains flexibility while substantially improving reliability and executability. These results demonstrate a feasible and verifiable pathway for applying AI to high-reliability astronomical observation scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多级验证与可追溯推理框架,用于解决AI生成望远镜调度决策中存在的可靠性问题。该框架通过整合数据引用验证、逻辑一致性检查以及天文与仪器约束验证,在执行前对AI决策进行系统性的可靠性验证,同时引入原子推理单元(ARU)及其依赖关系,实现推理过程的可追溯表示。实验在超过2000个测试用例和基于ZTF真实警报构建的360例基准上进行,验证了框架在提升AI调度决策可执行性和可靠性方面的显著效果。
AI.motivation: 随着AI逐渐应用于望远镜调度(尤其是时域天文学中的瞬变源快速跟进观测,如LSST每晚产生数百万警报、ZTF瞬变警报等场景),AI在处理复杂多约束问题方面展现出优势。然而,AI输出常存在数据引用不一致、推理错误和不可执行决策等问题(幻觉现象),限制了其在高可靠性观测任务中的应用。现有研究多关注模型本身能力提升,而对输出可靠性的验证关注不足。本文旨在弥补这一空白,解决AI驱动望远镜调度中的可靠性瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 框架定位在AI生成的调度提案与观测命令执行之间,作为独立的验证层,不干预AI的决策生成过程。核心方法包括:(1)结构化表征——将AI的自然语言调度决策转化为包含唯一标识符、调度指令、推理依据和支持数据的结构化表示;(2)原子推理单元(ARU)——定义为最小不可分因果推理单元,表示为元组⟨e_i, c_i⟩,其中e_i为支持结论的数据字段集合,c_i为原子结论(如在某时间窗口内对目标T执行动作A);(3)推理依赖DAG——将完整调度提案建模为有向无环图G=(V,E),其中V为ARU节点集合,E为有向依赖边,支持层次化验证和错误定位;(4)五级验证机制——包括仪器状态约束、天文知识约束、计算约束、原始数据真实性与可追溯性验证、决策表达与原始数据一致性;(5)闭环反馈机制——失败的结构化错误信息反馈到模型输入以触发修正,历史记录可作为模型微调的高质量数据集。系统采用预定义望远镜调度状态字典和JSON格式结构化输入,减少自然语言表达的多样性。
AI.result: 实验采用Phi-4(14B)和Qwen3(30B)两种模型,在六个代表性调度场景(S1-S6,涵盖单/多瞬变源、优先级冲突、多目标竞争、噪声干扰、复杂环境、物理约束越界)上进行评估,总计超过2433次初始验证测试。在不含反馈的基线配置下,Phi-4平均通过率为79.3%(1231例),Qwen3为84.5%(1202例),在S6异常场景中通过率最低(Phi-4约34%,Qwen3约20%)。引入验证框架后通过率提升18.1%,加入反馈机制再提升12.6%,加入ARU/DAG推理验证再提升16.8%,在复杂场景S4(31.35%)和S5(25%)中改善尤为显著。在基于ZTF真实警报构建的360例控制基准上,Qwen3+完整框架达到EER=1.000、RPA=0.944、RRS=0.983,远超纯Qwen3(EER=0.692、RPA=0.531、RRS=0.612),逼近ILP等确定性基线。推理复用方面,约300-320个高频ARU可实现约80%的平均复用率,超过7000条推理路径仅需从专家知识库激活104个ARU。消融实验显示验证恢复可执行性(EER=1.000),反馈机制带来最大决策质量提升(RPA从0.683提升至0.928),完整推理审计层进一步改善至0.944。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过解耦的确定性验证层(而非LLM自验证)实现了对AI调度提案的有效筛选和修正,在保持AI灵活性的同时显著提升了可执行性和可靠性。实验证明该框架为AI在高可靠性天文观测调度中的应用提供了可行且可验证的路径,尤其在嘈杂、异构的瞬变源环境中。当前LLM调度器的合理定位并非在干净环境中超越强确定性调度器,而是在噪声环境中提供灵活的提案生成,前提是由独立验证层强制执行安全性。框架还展现出良好的可扩展性,可推广至电力系统能源管理、医疗AI诊断等其他高可靠性领域。未来工作方向包括在真实观测系统中长期验证框架稳定性、评估静态离线夜间调度、进行传统与LLM调度的成本对比分析,以及测试更强大的前沿模型。

title: Content-Based Smart E-Mail Dispatcher Using Large Language Models
summary: Email communication has become an integral part of personal and professional life, but handling its vast volume is still a significant issue for large organisations. Manual perusal of emails and forwarding their contents and attachments to intended recipients using other instant messaging platforms has proved to be error-prone and time-consuming leading to losses in terms of productivity and creating undue stress. The main objective of this paper is to explore an alternative mechanism that is to automate the task of dispatching emails based on their contents to the respective WhatsApp groups of students of various semesters of programs in an engineering college, facilitating a smooth flow of information from one end to another end in an organisation. The dispatcher system is built using agents querying large language models (LLMs) to enable it to analyze the contents of emails and route them to the relevant groups of students for their information and consumption. The system harnesses the capabilities of LLMs in analysing the textual contents for decision-making. With a well-structured agent framework prompt that includes email content as input with instructions and context, the system figures out the relevant groups to which the email message is dispatched, thus providing the required information on time. The proposed system does not rely on labelled datasets and provides several benefits, including enhanced productivity and a reduction in the cognitive load associated with reading emails.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）代理的邮件自动分派系统，用于将邮件内容自动转发至工程学院各学期学生对应的 WhatsApp 群组，以解决人工处理邮件效率低、易出错的问题。
AI.motivation: 电子邮件在个人和职业生活中至关重要，但在大型组织中，海量邮件的手工查阅和转发耗时且易错，导致生产力下降和员工压力增加。亟需一种自动化机制来根据邮件内容将其精准分派至对应群组，实现信息高效流转。
AI.method: 构建基于 LLM 代理的分派系统（Dispatcher System）。通过结构化的智能体框架提示（agent framework prompt），将邮件内容、指令与上下文作为输入输入给 LLM，由 LLM 分析邮件文本内容并决策，将邮件自动路由至相关学生群组（如按学期、专业分类的 WhatsApp 群组）。系统无需依赖标注数据集。
AI.result: 该系统能够自动解析邮件内容，识别相关群组并将邮件及其附件及时分派至目标群体，减少了人工干预，提升了信息传递效率。论文强调其无需标注数据即可运行，并具备增强生产力和降低认知负荷的优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于 LLM 代理的邮件分派系统为大型组织（以工程学院学生信息传递场景为例）提供了一种可行的自动化邮件处理方案，能够在不依赖标注数据的情况下实现邮件内容的智能分析和精准路由，有效提升信息流通效率并减轻人员认知负担。

title: LLM-based Models for Detecting Emerging Topics in Service Feedback
summary: Enhancing the analysis of service feedback is essential for public sector organizations, particularly tax administrations, where trust and compliance depend on fair and effective service delivery. As feedback volumes grow, identifying emerging service quality issues and potential disparities across diverse populations becomes increasingly challenging. Traditional approaches often rely on manual review or static expert-defined indicators, limiting scalability and the ability to capture complex patterns in textual feedback. This paper presents a novel methodology that integrates large language models (LLMs), statistical techniques, and human-AI collaboration to improve multilingual customer feedback analysis. The primary objective is to detect emerging service quality topics that may also reveal potential inequities in service delivery. Our framework combines fine-tuned, quantized LLMs with expert oversight to produce accurate, computationally efficient, and context-aware analyses. The proposed approach was evaluated using similarity analysis and assessments from experienced tax officers, demonstrating stronger alignment with expert judgments than baseline models. By incorporating a human-in-the-loop framework, the methodology reduces LLM fabrication while improving the reliability and relevance of generated insights. The results demonstrate the practicality of combining LLMs with human expertise to support scalable, evidence-based decision-making in public sector organizations. This work contributes to the development of responsible AI systems that enhance service quality, responsiveness, fairness, and public trust through more effective analysis of multilingual customer feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合微调量化大语言模型(LLM)、统计趋势分析与人在回路验证的多语言税务反馈分析方法，用于检测公共服务中的新兴服务质量话题及跨人群的服务差异。该方法在多语言(英法双语)反馈数据上验证有效，显著优于基线预训练模型。
AI.motivation: 随着公共部门(尤其是税务机关)反馈数据量激增，传统的人工审查或静态专家指标方法难以规模化处理多语言文本数据，也无法有效捕捉跨人口群体(年龄、性别、语言)的细微服务差异与潜在不平等现象。现有LLM研究在多语言、领域特定微调与公共服务场景的应用仍存在空白，亟需一种可扩展、上下文感知且公平的多语言反馈分析方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心阶段：(1) 数据预处理：采用XLM-Roberta-Large NER模型与正则表达式相结合的混合方法对英法双语反馈进行去标识化处理；(2) 主题建模：基于LoRA+PEFT技术对Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2进行参数高效微调，并使用GPTQ进行4位量化以降低计算开销，将反馈分类至13个预定义的服务质量要素(SQE)；同时与基于Zephyr-7B-beta的提示工程方法对比；(3) 趋势检测：对两个时间段的反馈分别拟合多元逻辑回归模型，通过比较人口统计变量系数的自助法95%置信区间，将趋势分类为新兴、持续或消退。整个流程嵌入税务官员的专家验证环节。
AI.result: 数据集包含6,515条英语和1,646条法语反馈记录。核心结果包括：(1) 相似度方面：微调量化后的Mistral模型与专家标签的相似度达66.64%，显著优于预训练Zephyr模型的24.27%；(2) 统计检验：配对t检验显示模型评分与税务官员评分无显著差异(p=0.085, t=-1.968)；(3) 趋势检测：识别出多项有意义的趋势，例如19岁以下用户的可访问性投诉呈消退趋势，而60岁以上及19-60岁人群的清晰度问题呈新兴趋势，男女用户及英语偏好者的及时性反馈均呈上升趋势。模型在主题分布上能较好平衡专家偏好的"时效性"与其他SQE类别。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，针对特定组织语境进行微调与量化的LLM，结合人在回路框架与统计趋势分析，能够有效检测多语言反馈中的新兴服务质量话题，并揭示跨人群的服务差异。该框架在保持专家判断一致性的同时降低了计算成本，符合负责任AI的公平性、透明性、可解释性与问责性原则。局限在于仅使用单年数据、模型规模受限(限于≤13B参数)；未来工作应扩展多年数据集、增加语种、探索非线性建模与持续学习机制。研究为公共部门AI辅助反馈分析提供了可扩展的理论与实践路径。

title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD), ICML 2026
summary: Agent safety in high-stakes domains requires formal policy enforcement, but most existing approaches either rely on probabilistic guardrails (fine-tuned classifiers, prompt-based steering) that offer no formal guarantees, or on hand-coded symbolic enforcement that does not scale to the breadth of real policy specifications. We present an autoformalization pipeline that translates agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions, and natural language policy documents into formally verified policies using an LLM-based generator-critic loop. The resulting policies are written in the Cedar Policy Language. On the MedAgentBench benchmark, our autoformalized policies cover substantially more of the source natural-language specification than the hand-coded symbolic enforcement in prior work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将自然语言代理指令自动形式化为 Cedar 策略代码的管道，通过 LLM 生成器-评论家循环将代理提示、MCP 工具描述和自然语言策略文档转换为经过验证的 Cedar 策略。在 MedAgentBench 基准测试中，自动形式化策略比手工编码的符号执行覆盖了更多源策略规范。
AI.motivation: 在高风险领域，AI 代理需要提升权限来执行复杂任务，但这增加了攻击面。现有安全防护（微调分类器、提示词引导等概率性方法）缺乏形式化保证，而手工编写的符号执行又无法扩展到真实策略规范的广度。需要一种既能提供形式化保证、又能自动扩展到大规模策略规范的方法。
AI.method: 论文提出"验证三明治"分层架构：(1) 接地层：从 MCP 工具定义中提取实体、工具模式，定义主体-资源-动作本体论，生成 Cedar Schema；(2) 模型层：使用 LLM（Gemini 3 Pro）生成候选 Cedar 策略；(3) 安全层：硬评论家（Cedar 解析器检查语法、模式匹配、矛盾、空虚策略）+ 软评论家（LLM-as-judge 检查语义对齐）。采用生成器-评论家循环迭代优化，直到满足质量阈值。生成策略后由外部 Cedar 策略引擎在运行时强制执行，采用 fail-closed 机制。
AI.result: 在 MedAgentBench 基准测试上：(1) Original 数据集 Raw 条件下 Cedar 阻断率 30.3%，Baseline 条件下 57.7%，Guardrail 条件下 55.7%；(2) 对抗性数据集 Raw 条件下 72.0%，Baseline 条件下 82.0%，Guardrail 条件下 85.7%；(3) 分解到包含写操作的轨迹后，Original Guardrail 条件下阻断率达 98.8%，Adversarial 各条件下均为 100%；(4) Hong 等人手写 88 条规则中的 23 条符号防护，本文自动形式化覆盖范围更广；(5) 暴露了 Cedar 无状态设计的局限，无法处理多轮时序依赖。
AI.conclusion: 通过将策略逻辑外置到确定性 Cedar 策略引擎并采用 fail-closed 执行机制，可缓解越狱和间接提示注入风险；形式化策略可审计且人类可读；但存在摩擦-效用权衡问题，过于严格的策略会降低代理实用性；Cedar 无状态设计限制了多轮代理工作流的时序逻辑处理，未来工作将聚焦时序逻辑集成和记忆感知策略。

title: SKILL-DISCO: Distilling and Compiling Agent Traces into Reusable Procedural Skills
summary: Agents often repeatedly solve similar task instances from scratch, leading to unnecessary reasoning cost and long execution traces. Prior work has explored workflow reuse and executable skill induction, but it remains unclear which task scenarios admit procedural skills and how the shared procedural structure should be represented across successful traces. We study this problem in FSM-defined scenarios, where successful traces can be viewed as paths in an unknown transition graph, and formulate procedural skills as reusable parameterized control-flow subgraphs. Based on this view, we introduce SkillDisCo, a distillation-and-compilation framework that distills reusable PFSM subgraphs from successful traces and compiles them into callable, executable, and verifiable procedural skills. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebArena show that SkillDisCo improves success rates and reduces agent turns across benchmarks and model scales, demonstrating the benefits of representing shared experience as reusable execution structures.

AI.tldr: Skill-DisCo 提出了一种"蒸馏-编译"框架，从成功的智能体执行轨迹中提炼可复用的过程性技能。它将技能形式化为有限状态机(FSM)定义场景中参数化控制流子图(PFSM)，通过轨迹归一化、子目标操作提取、技能聚类合并等蒸馏步骤，以及技能规范定义、代码合成与验证等编译步骤，生成可调用、可执行、可验证的 Python 技能库。实验在 ALFWorld 和 WebArena 上验证了该方法能提升任务成功率、减少执行轮次，并支持跨模型规模和家族的技能迁移。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在交互任务中常常从零开始重复解决相似任务实例，导致不必要的推理开销和过长的执行轨迹。现有工作（工作流复用、可执行技能归纳）缺乏对"何种任务场景适合过程性技能"以及"共享过程结构应如何跨轨迹表示"的明确定义，导致生成的技能库碎片化、冗余且偏向轨迹特定的表面模式。
AI.method: Skill-DisCo 采用两阶段框架：**(1) 蒸馏阶段**——首先将原始轨迹归一化为保留控制流的 Python 中间程序；然后提取子目标级操作序列（多步、连贯）；最后通过语义聚类合并跨轨迹共享的参数化控制流模式，估计技能的可复用性分数。**(2) 编译阶段**——为每个高覆盖率聚类构建包含签名、描述、前后置条件和元数据的技能规范；然后合成 Python 实现并在留出任务集上验证（运行时正确性、后置条件满足、动作节省），最多 R 次重试，失败者被丢弃。理论形式化基于 FSM-定义场景和参数化有限状态机(PFSM)，将技能视为在参数绑定下匹配多个成功轨迹的 PFSM 子图。
AI.result: **端到端性能(表1)**：在 ALFWorld 上，Skill-DisCo+CodeAct(GPT-4o)达到 99.3% SR(基线 96.3%)，平均轮次从 3.6 降至 3.2；Skill-DisCo+ReAct SR 从 82.0% 提升至 92.4%，轮次减少 54.5%。在 WebArena 上，Skill-DisCo+ReAct SR 从 23.9% 提升至 29.1%。**跨模型迁移(表2)**：GPT-4o 归纳的技能库无需修改即可迁移至 Qwen3.5-4B/9B、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5-chat/mini 等模型。Qwen3.5-9B 在 ALFWorld 上从 54.5% 跃升至 98.5%(+80.8%)，Qwen3.5-4B 在 WebArena 上从 10.1% 提升至 18.7%(+85.3%)。**技能使用统计(表3)**：Skill-DisCo 仅用 5/20 个技能（ALFWorld/WebArena），远少于 ASI 的 110/146 个；执行错误率从 75.3%/33.9% 降至 0.0%/21.5%。**消融(表4)**：去除蒸馏阶段 SR 降至 53.0%（技能数膨胀至 43），去除编译阶段 SR 略降至 97.0% 但 token 开销显著增加。**成本**：多数设置下推理成本降低（ALFWorld 上 Qwen3.5-9B 成本降低 41%）。
AI.conclusion: Skill-DisCo 通过将共享执行结构显式形式化为 PFSM 子图，从成功轨迹中提炼出紧凑、高覆盖、可验证的可执行过程性技能库。实验证明这种结构化技能表示能提升任务成功率、减少执行轮次、压缩技能库规模、降低执行错误，并支持跨模型家族的程序性知识蒸馏与迁移。该工作为智能体经验复用提供了基于有限状态机语义的坚实基础。

title: NebulaExp-8B: An Empirical Post-Training Pipeline via Full-Scale Ablation Research
summary: Post-training alignment determines the reasoning and human preference following capabilities of large language models, yet most existing works withhold detailed data construction, filtering rules and training recipes, which hinders community reproducibility and lightweight model optimization. This work presents NebulaExp, a fully transparent, ablation-driven post-training pipeline built on Qwen3-8B-base, covering two orthogonal model branches: general instruct model and complex reasoning-specialized model. We curate a raw corpus of 3.84M multi-source SFT samples and a 200K verifiable RL candidate pool, and design an end-to-end data processing stack including response distillation, multi-dimensional cross-verification filtering, fine-grained difficulty grading, task classification and diversity-aware sampling. For the Instruct branch, our three-stage optimized supervised fine-tuning approach NebulaExp-Ins-SFT improves the average benchmark score from the 55.01 baseline of Qwen3-8B-nothink to 60.99. GRPO reinforcement learning then further elevates the average score to 61.85. For the Reasoning branch, medium-difficulty GRPO RL improves average reasoning score from 73.88 to 75.17. To address RL's dependency on task verifiers, we systematically investigate single-teacher and multi-teacher OPD (MOPD): utilizing merely 4K instruction-following samples and outperforms RL baseline by 3.26 points on IFEval with +4.43 average overall gain; MOPD fuses four domain-specialist teachers with merely 10K samples, lifting average performance by 4.18 over the base model. This report provides a fully reproducible empirical post-training recipe for 8B-scale LLMs, and comprehensively dissects the capability trade-offs among instruction adherence, mathematical reasoning, code generation and general knowledge.

AI.tldr: NebulaExp-8B 是中兴基于 Qwen3-8B-base 提出的完全透明、基于消融实验驱动的 8B 规模 LLM 后训练流水线，包含通用指令模型和复杂推理模型两个分支，覆盖 SFT、GRPO 强化学习及 On-Policy Distillation (OPD/MOPD) 三个阶段，并提出完整的数据构建、过滤、难度分级、任务分类和多样性采样处理栈。
AI.motivation: 当前主流大模型后训练工作普遍不公开数据构建细节、过滤规则和训练配方，导致社区难以复现和针对轻量模型进行优化；同时在 SFT 数据选择、RL 样本难度控制、蒸馏教师选择等关键决策上缺乏系统性的消融依据。NebulaExp 旨在通过全流程消融研究，揭示后训练各环节的内在机制与能力权衡，而非单纯追求 SOTA 排行榜名次。
AI.method: 1) 数据侧：构建 3.84M 多源 SFT 语料（Nemotron-cascade、ODA-math、Nemotron-Math-V2、AM-Thinking、Dolci-Instruct-SFT 等）与 200K 可验证 RL 候选池；采用 Qwen3-235B/397B 教师进行响应风格蒸馏；通过规则过滤 + 模型评分 + 任务特定验证（math_verify、代码单元测试、54 条 IF 规则检查器）三级过滤；按 pass@4 进行三档难度分级；用 Qwen3-1.7B 分类器进行任务标注；采用聚类与多样性采样。2) Instruct SFT：建立 Length/Entropy/Loss/IFD 四维质量指标体系，采用"域内自适应采样→跨域收益加权混合→最终模型"三阶段流水线，最优配比为 Math 44K/Code 17K/Other 89K。3) Instruct RL：基于 GRPO，在 53K 样本（去除 pass_rate∈{0,1}）上训练，rollout=5，保留 KL 损失。4) Reasoning SFT：采用回归模型驱动的混合比搜索（math:code:science=0.6:0.2:0.2），短到长课程学习，stage-2 紧凑高质量多 epoch 训练。5) Reasoning RL：在 8K 中等难度样本上 GRPO 训练 2 epoch。6) OPD：单教师 OPD 使用学生自生成序列、teacher top-64 token 提供反向 KL 监督；多教师 OPD (MOPD) 按领域路由融合 4 个领域专家教师（math/code/science/IF），domain weight 按数据量比例分配。
AI.result: Instruct 分支：平均分从 Qwen3-8B-nothink 基线 55.01 提升至 NebulaExp-Ins-SFT 60.99（+5.98），RL 后进一步至 61.85；AIME'24 +15.00、ZebraLogic +35.90、IFEval +3.88（RL 后）。Reasoning 分支：medium-difficulty GRPO RL 将平均推理分从 73.88 提升至 75.17；AIME'25 +1.67、GPQA-Diamond +4.55。单教师 OPD（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 教师，仅 4K IF 样本）以 IFEval 83.40 超越 RL 基线 80.14 +3.26 点，平均分 74.34 vs 70.18（+4.43）。MOPD（4 个 8B 领域专家教师，10K 样本，1 epoch）将平均分从 72.42 提升至 76.60（+4.18），并在 AIME'25（75.83 vs 75.42）和 MATH-500（97.25 vs 96.97）上超越单教师上界，验证跨教师知识重组效应。
AI.conclusion: 核心发现：① 数据正确性过滤是一阶优化因素，采样策略是二阶优化（在已验证数据上的精调）；② 数学与代码对数据分布偏好相反（数学偏好高 entropy/高 IFD，代码偏好低 entropy/低 IFD），8B 规模下存在零和容量冲突；③ 长篇通用文本可向形式逻辑推理任务迁移（ZebraLogic +38.5 不依赖数学训练数据）；④ RL 中 hard-only 训练在 8B 规模优于课程学习；⑤ 教师分布兼容性（同 base、同词表）比模型规模更决定蒸馏效果，Qwen3-8B 教师优于 235B-A22B 教师；⑥ 多教师 OPD 可通过跨教师知识重组使学生模型超越任何单一教师的能力边界。该工作为 8B 规模 LLM 提供了完全可复现的后训练经验配方，并系统揭示了指令遵循、数学推理、代码生成与通用知识之间的能力权衡机制；局限在于仅在 8B 规模验证，未覆盖 MoE 架构、开放式任务与智能体训练。

title: Do Safety Guardrails Need to Reason? LeanGuard: A Fast and Light Approach for Robust Moderation
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this https URL ; code and models: this https URL
summary: In order to screen a prompt or a response, the recent guardrail methods generate a chain-of-thought (CoT) before they issue a verdict. This design follows a common belief that step-by-step reasoning improves a decision. However, CoT also makes the guard heavy and slow, because the model must generate many tokens before it decides. This may not match how guardrails are actually deployed. A guardrail sometimes should not be heavy and slow, and it often runs on-device, for example on an embodied robot. In this paper, we pose a question whether a safety guardrail really needs to reason. To answer this question, we train a lightweight bidirectional encoder and a reasoning guard on the same corpus, and we then remove only the reasoning while we keep everything else fixed. With this controlled same-base comparison, we show that the chain does not improve moderation accuracy. We name the resulting guard LeanGuard. A 395M label-only encoder reaches an average F1 of 82.90 $\pm$ 0.26 over public benchmarks. It matches a reasoning guard that is built on a much larger decoder, while it uses only a single forward pass over an input of at most 512 tokens. This is about a ~100x reduction in inference compute. We further show that this label-only encoder stays robust under training-label noise and retains far more recall at a strict false-positive rate than the reasoning guard, so a heavier reasoning guard is not the more robust choice either. Our finding suggests that the current guardrail benchmarks may not be hard enough to reward reasoning, and that the necessity of CoT for moderation is still not proven. We release all source codes and models including LeanGuard at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LeanGuard，一个 395M 参数的标签式双向编码器（ModernBERT-large），用于安全内容审核。它通过严格的同基（same-base）对比实验证明：链式思考（CoT）推理并不会提升安全护栏（guardrail）的判别准确率，且推理链多为"事后合理化"而非真正修正决策。同时，轻量级编码器在标签噪声鲁棒性和严格低误报率下的召回率方面均优于基于推理的大模型解码器。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的安全护栏方法（如 GuardReasoner、WildGuard 等）均采用大型解码器模型，并先进行链式思考（CoT）推理再给出裁决，假设"逐步推理能提升判断质量"。然而：(1) 这使模型变得庞大且推理缓慢，不适合在机器人等端侧设备上部署；(2) 内容审核本质上是一个有界标签分类任务，CoT 在此类任务上是否有效从未被严格验证；(3) 重型推理护栏是否更鲁棒也缺乏同基对比的检验。论文旨在回答"安全护栏是否真的需要推理"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 采用受控的同基对比（same-base ablation）方法：固定架构、规模、预训练和数据，仅改变监督目标（带 CoT vs. 仅标签）。具体地：(1) 主要模型：ModernBERT-large（395M），三个线性分类头，单次前向传播即可输出三部分标签（请求有害性、回复有害性、是否遵从）。(2) 对比基线：Llama-3.2-1B 解码器和 T5-base 编码-解码器，分别以 CoT 和仅标签两种模式训练，重型解码器使用 LoRA。(3) 使用 GuardReasoner 的 12.7 万条带 CoT 的训练语料。(4) 通过线性探针、思维链重采样（K-sample majority vote）测量推理的事后合理化程度。(5) 注入对称标签噪声测量鲁棒性。(6) 测量严格 FPR 下的 TPR 作为操作点指标。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 在同一 Llama-3.2-1B 基座上，带 CoT 的 F1 为 81.35，仅标签为 81.42，CoT 几乎无增益；在 T5 上 CoT 反而降低 7.05 F1（80.02 vs. 72.97）。(2) LeanGuard-395M 达到 82.90 ± 0.26 平均 F1，匹配甚至超过 GuardReasoner-1B（82.05）和 3B（82.50），但在 13 个基准中胜出 9 个，推理成本降低约 100 倍。(3) 重采样推理链时，仅约 5.08% 的输入最终裁决改变；线性探针显示隐藏状态在生成链之前就已稳定落入有害区域，证明推理为"事后合理化"。(4) 在 30% 训练标签噪声下，LeanGuard 仍达 80.56 F1，斜率仅为 -0.81/10%，而 T5 标签模式为 -1.55/10%。(5) 在 1% FPR 下，编码器召回率为 44.8%，而推理护栏仅 10.1%。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三个核心结论：(1) 在固定基座上 CoT 不提升审核准确率，当前基准可能难度不足以让推理发挥作用；(2) 推理多为事后合理化而非真正修正（仅 5% 推翻率）；(3) 重型推理护栏并非更鲁棒的选择——单次前向传播的双向编码器在标签噪声和严格 FPR 下均更稳健。因此，对于轻量级尤其是端侧部署场景，一个校准良好的标签式编码器是比 CoT 推理解码器更简单、更便宜且至少同等准确的默认选择。作者建议未来研究应报告同基对比消融以隔离推理链与架构、规模和数据的影响。LeanGuard 已开源（含 ONNX 导出）。

title: Kalman Prototypical Networks for Few-shot Fault Detection in Combined Cycle Gas Turbines
summary: Combined-cycle gas turbines (CCGTs) play a key role in modern power generation, offering both high efficiency and reduced environmental impact. However, their complex thermo-fluid and mechanical interactions complicate fault detection, particularly when labeled fault data are scarce. In this paper, we introduce the Kalman Prototypical Network (KPN), a metric-based few-shot learning (FSL) framework specifically tailored for CCGT fault diagnosis. We model the evolution of class prototypes as latent stochastic states in a dynamic system to reduce episodic variance and improve robustness in embedding representation. Synthetic data sets generated with a high-fidelity Modelica-based dynamic simulation of an offshore CCGT system were used, simulating both normal operation and progressive leak faults under transient conditions. Application of the proposed framework on simulated leak fault detection tasks demonstrate that KPN outperforms conventional FSL methods such as Matching Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML in both accuracy and stability under varying support and query configurations. The proposed framework significantly improves training convergence and generalization by stabilizing class representations, making it well-suited for real-world CCGT fault detection where labeled data is limited.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于联合循环燃气轮机(CCGT)少样本故障检测的卡尔曼原型网络(KPN),通过将卡尔曼滤波集成到原型网络中,对训练周期(episode)间的原型序列进行时序平滑,有效降低了少样本场景下因支持集随机采样导致的原型估计波动和分类不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 联合循环燃气轮机系统(CCGT)结构复杂且故障样本稀缺、标注成本高,导致基于监督学习的故障诊断方法难以部署。少样本学习方法(尤其是原型网络)虽具潜力,但由于每个episode从小型支持集计算的类原型存在显著的episodic方差和不稳定性,使其在真实工业故障检测场景中的鲁棒性受限,亟需一种能稳定类表示、提升泛化能力的改进框架。
AI.method: 将类原型在训练episode间的演化建模为线性高斯动态系统的隐状态,采用离散时间状态空间模型:状态转移方程 p̂_k^(t)=F·p̂_k^(t-1)+w_k^(t) 和观测方程 p_k^(t)=H·p̂_k^(t)+v_k^(t)。通过卡尔曼滤波的预测步与更新步递归地获得去噪、平滑后的"卡尔曼滤波原型"。其中F=H=I, Q=qI, R=rI为可调标量噪声协方差。分类时,查询样本的嵌入与滤波后的原型计算欧氏距离,经softmax转化为类别概率,以负对数似然作为损失进行训练。计算复杂度为O(Kd³)/episode,相对于嵌入计算可忽略。
AI.result: 在基于Modelica高保真动态仿真生成的海上CCGT泄漏故障合成数据集(2-way分类,正常 vs. 渐进泄漏)上,KPN在4-8 shot、5-25 query等不同配置下均优于Prototypical Network、Matching Network、Relation Network和MAML基线。4-shot下KPN达到90.51%±2.01%,较ProtoNet(85.57%±3.93%)提升约5%,较MatchingNet(89.16%±3.57%)提升约1.3%,且标准差显著降低;参数敏感性分析表明q=10⁻³、r=10⁻³为最优噪声配置(峰值精度91.09%/~91.25%);原型轨迹PCA可视化显示滤波后轨迹更平滑且类间分离更明显;训练损失曲线证明KPN收敛更快、振荡更小。
AI.conclusion: KPN通过卡尔曼滤波对原型进行时序正则化,有效缓解了少样本原型网络的episodic方差问题,显著提升了CCGT故障检测的准确率、稳定性与训练收敛速度,特别适用于低shot和低query等极端少样本场景。未来工作将探索自适应滤波策略、扩展至多类不平衡少样本场景,并研究滤波器参数与嵌入网络参数的联合优化。

title: LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography
comment: Correspondence to: Qi Sun <qisunchn \at zju \dot edu \dot cn>
summary: As semiconductor technology nodes scale, computational lithography is essential for ensuring yield and performance. However, lithography is a continuous physical process involving mask optimization, optical imaging, resist exposure, and development, which existing models fail to capture. To overcome this limitation, we present LithoDreamer, the first physics-informed World Model (WM) framework for computational lithography, which formulates the ``Layout-Mask-Resist Image-After Development Image (ADI)'' pipeline as a decision-driven multi-step evolution system. LithoDreamer captures feature changes between adjacent states to model stage-specific physics-informed latent spaces, in which it controls process intervention exploration and drives subsequent state transitions. To achieve interpretable intervention optimization without continuous supervision, we propose a contrastive variational optimization paradigm that contrasts the latent differences between intervention paths with variational evolution constraints, guiding the model to generate evolutions consistent with real lithography physics. Experiments show LithoDreamer achieves state-of-the-art performance in forward evolution and inverse planning. Our lithography dataset is publicly available at GitHub ( this https URL ).

AI.tldr: LithoDreamer是首个面向计算光刻的物理信息世界模型（WM），将"Layout-Mask-Resist Image-ADI"多阶段流水线建模为决策驱动的多步演化系统。通过Space Prior Approximation (SPA)构建阶段特定的物理信息潜空间，并提出对比变分优化范式，在无中间监督的情况下联合优化过程干预与状态演化，在正向演化与逆向规划任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 随着半导体工艺节点不断缩小，计算光刻成为保证良率与性能的关键。然而光刻是一个涉及掩模优化、光学成像、光刻胶曝光与显影的连续物理过程，现有模型将其视为静态点对点预测，无法显式建模连续过程干预驱动的多阶段状态演化，限制了多阶段优化场景中连续工艺调整的能力。World Model在自动驾驶和具身智能中已证明能有效捕捉决策干预下的状态轨迹变化，但直接应用于计算光刻面临多阶段动力学差异和细粒度干预无监督两大根本挑战。
AI.method: 1) **Space Prior Approximation (SPA)**：从相邻阶段状态对的统计变化中估计阶段特定的正交基矩阵B^(s)，张成物理信息潜空间S^(s)，将干预约束在物理一致的演化方向上；2) **Policy Model**：基于ViT+MLP的随机策略网络，在S^(s)内通过重参数化技巧采样干预系数，经可微映射得到物理可行的干预；3) **Transition Model**：以DiT为骨干网络配合阶段感知MLP头，预测干预驱动的下一状态，并通过梯度门控准则自适应判断阶段内收敛与跨阶段转移；4) **Contrastive Variational Optimization Paradigm**：变分推断+对比学习，仅依赖阶段终端监督，联合优化干预分布与状态演化，无需中间监督。
AI.result: 在55nm 280K样本数据集上，LithoDreamer在ID设置下Mask/Resist Image/ADI的EPE分别达到0.96/1.06（前向）和0.89/0.97（逆向规划），优于LMLitho、Unitho及DINO-WM/DriveDreamer-2/NWM等通用世界模型。LRC验证显示相对商业工具的平均偏差仅1.3%/7.4%/0.4%（Pinch/Bridge/EPE）。OOD测试（55nm未见工艺配置+28nm跨节点）上EPE分别为1.51/0.97/3.21nm和1.73/1.28nm，泛化能力优异。消融实验验证了SPA（k=8最佳）、对比约束、随机干预、过程参数条件、阶段感知头及梯度门控机制的必要性，且SPA可作为可迁移物理先验提升其他通用WM性能。
AI.conclusion: LithoDreamer成功将计算光刻建模为决策感知的物理演化过程，通过阶段特定潜空间与对比变分优化实现无中间监督的干预-状态联合学习，在ID和OOD场景下均展现出优越的精度与泛化能力，尤其在边缘放置精度（EPE）方面表现突出，为计算光刻的过程规划与多阶段优化提供了新的统一建模框架。

title: A Latent ODE Approach to Spatiotemporal Modeling of Cine Cardiac MRI
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) captures rich spatiotemporal information about ventricular structure and motion, but conventional risk models use only a few image-derived indices from selected cardiac phases. We present a latent dynamical model that encodes bi-ventricular anatomy and full-cycle cine motion as a continuous latent trajectory, using heart-rate-aware neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) dynamics and a graph-based mesh autoencoder to reconstruct anatomically consistent 3D+t ventricular motion. A covariate-conditioned prior defines the expected end-diastolic latent state, and a Cox proportional hazards model tests whether deviations from this prior predict incident heart failure. We studied 72,386 UK Biobank participants without baseline cardiovascular disease, including 367 incident heart failure events. In a held-out evaluation subset, adding the latent score to refitted pooled cohort equations improved the stratified C-index from 0.704 to 0.785, compared with 0.764 for seven established cardiac markers. Compared with non-graph and non-ODE approaches, the proposed model gave the best trade-off between reconstruction fidelity, generative realism, and downstream prognostic performance. These results suggest that continuous full-cycle modeling of ventricular motion provides informative cardiac phenotypes beyond conventional CMR summaries, while external validation in more representative patient cohorts is required before clinical risk-prediction use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于潜在ODE的时空建模框架，将心率感知的神经常微分方程（neural ODE）与基于图神经网络（GNN）的网格自编码器相结合，将双心室完整心动周期的电影心脏磁共振（cine CMR）运动编码为连续潜在轨迹，并通过协变量条件先验和Cox比例风险模型预测心力衰竭（HF）发病风险。
AI.motivation: 传统CMR风险模型仅使用少数选定心脏时相（如舒张末期和收缩末期）衍生的指标（如LVEF、心肌应变），对高维解剖信息进行了双重压缩，可能遗漏心脏收缩与舒张在时间、协同性和运动轨迹方面的细微异常，而这些异常可能携带重要的预后信号。此外，电影CMR的帧采样受心率影响，收缩期与舒张期在不同受试者间占比不同，而现有时空模型通常将时间视为归一化的离散序列，无法适应这种生理时相变化。作者利用UK Biobank大规模CMR数据集与纵向随访，期望通过连续时空建模挖掘超越传统静态指标的心脏表型信息。
AI.method: 1. **数据与预处理**：基于UK Biobank影像实例2的84,086名参与者，经质量控制和排除基线心血管疾病后，最终纳入72,386人（其中367例发生HF），按1:1分层随机划分为开发集和留出评估集。使用开源管道提取双心室3D+t网格（5,806个顶点，固定拓扑），并提取7项常规CMR指标。2. **模型架构**：在条件VAE框架下，(i) 每帧GNN编码网格序列，通过两层Transformer和注意力池化聚合得到近似后验z(0)；(ii) MLP基于协变量u（年龄、性别、BSA）参数化高斯先验；(iii) 学习式单调相位重参数化θ(t)实现心率感知的相位扭曲；(iv) 潜在ODE（3层MLP，tanh激活）以[sinθ, cosθ]为周期偏置演化z(t)；(v) 基于SpiralNet++的层次GNN解码器重建网格。3. **训练目标**：最大化ELBO，β=5.0，潜变量维度D=64。4. **风险评分**：将后验均值z̄(0)相对于先验进行标准化得到残差嵌入ẑ，通过自然三次样条（自由度3）展开后用惩罚Cox回归拟合得标量风险分数r_lat。
AI.result: 1. **主要终点（HF发病预测）**：在留出评估集中，分层C指数从PCP-HF的0.704提升至加入r_lat后的0.785，优于加入7项常规CMR指标的0.764；3年和5年AUROC同样以r_lat最高（0.778和0.751），E/O比更接近1。2. **架构对比**：GNN+ODE在重建精度（欧氏距离1.366mm）、角度误差（12.561°）、加速度误差和C指数（0.785）上均最优，显著优于Linear+ODE、GNN+Fourier、GNN+Transformer和MeshHeart。3. **生理真实性**：生成模型在按年龄和性别分层后，复现了已知的LVEF和室壁厚度变化趋势（如男性LVEF随年龄下降）。4. **可解释性**：高风险受试者的后验相对先验的偏离呈现两种典型重塑模式——保留射血分数者以室壁增厚和舒张功能障碍为主，降低射血分数者以心室扩张为主。5. **消融实验**：去除心率感知相位扭曲或仅使用舒张末期/收缩末期帧时，HF预测性能明显下降。6. **稳健性**：协变量条件先验显著提升跨种子潜变量一致性（Spearman r=0.977 vs 0.922），潜变量维度和β在D=64、β=5.0附近预测性能最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明，基于网格的连续全周期心室运动建模可提供超越常规CMR汇总指标和信息性心脏表型。潜在ODE框架在心率变异条件下保持时间一致性，协变量条件先验实现生理结构化表示并增强可重复性，残差嵌入捕捉了不同重塑路径下的心衰风险信号。然而，模型依赖上游网格提取管道、潜在ODE未显式强制周期性、且仅在UK Biobank相对健康的人群中验证（仅367例事件），尚需在更具代表性的疾病富集队列中进行外部验证、校准和临床效用评估，方可进入临床风险预测应用。

title: Socratic agents for autonomous scientific discovery in high-dimensional physical systems
summary: The automation of scientific discovery has reached an inflection point. While AI systems now operate instruments, optimize parameters and generate hypotheses, most remain procedural: they execute workflows fixed by human designers. True autonomous science demands epistemic autonomy--the capacity to construct, challenge and revise physical explanations in response to evidence. Here we introduce AHOIS, a multi-agent AI scientist that embeds Socratic midwifery into closed-loop experimentation. A physics-critic agent interrogates hypotheses through causal questioning, constraint checking, counterexample generation and falsification-criteria formulation. We evaluate AHOIS on a real multimode-fibre optical platform, a high-dimensional system with complex wave transformations, indirect detection, environmental drift and multi-modal acquisition. Without prior encoding schemes, classifiers or speckle models, the system autonomously proposed and validated a random-interference encoding hypothesis, discovered task-adaptive sparse-measurement strategies, diagnosed distinct failure modes (encoding instability, fluorescence contamination and detector noise) and translated a published imaging protocol into an executable workflow on a non-original configuration. The discovered encoding yielded 16x16 measurements with effective rank 56.9 and classification accuracies of 76.97% on MNIST and 83.17% on Fashion-MNIST. Ablations show that Socratic interrogation improves physical consistency, hypothesis completeness, uncertainty calibration and experimental-plan validity. These results establish a route from workflow automation towards evidence-grounded, self-correcting autonomous discovery in complex physical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AHOIS，一种将"苏格拉底助产术"嵌入闭环实验的多智能体AI科学家系统。该系统在真实多模光纤光学平台上实现了从假设提出、苏格拉底式物理质询、实验执行到结论修正的完整科学发现循环，并在背向散斑编码、自适应稀疏扫描、模态诊断及论文到平台复现等任务中验证了其"认知自主性"。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统虽能操控仪器、优化参数和生成假设，但多数仍执行人类设计的固定工作流，停留在"程序性自主"层面。真正的自主科学需要"认知自主性"——即根据证据构建、挑战和修正物理解释的能力。论文旨在弥合工作流自动化与基于证据的自我修正型科学发现之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 方法包含三大核心要素：(1) **五智能体架构**：Boxue（策略与假设生成）、Gewu（硬件抽象）、Mingde（系统完整性监控）、Qiushi（建模与定量分析）、Duzhi（苏格拉底式物理批评家）；(2) **苏格拉底助产术**：Duzhi通过四类结构化质询（澄清、物理约束检查、因果探询、反例生成）迫使Boxue将隐含推理显化为可检验、可修正的机制模型；(3) **实验平台**：基于多模光纤的高维光学系统，结合相干远场成像与荧光成像双模态，通过透射矩阵校准实现可编程波前整形。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) **背向散斑编码发现**：系统自主提出并验证随机干涉编码假设，16×16测量矩阵有效秩为56.9，MNIST分类准确率76.97%，Fashion-MNIST为83.17%；(2) **自适应稀疏扫描**：粗到细扫描策略在48.50 fps下实现ROI与内容识别，相比全扫描（0.47 fps）提速超两个数量级；(3) **模态特异性诊断**：自主区分相干散斑退化与荧光噪声退化，分别调用SCNet和MFNet处理；(4) **论文到平台复现**：自主解析已发表协议，在非原始配置上完成38步端到端执行轨迹；(5) **消融验证**：苏格拉底质询使物理一致性、假设完整性和不确定性校准三项评分从约2分提升至4.5分以上（5分制），因果探询贡献最大（效用值0.83）。
AI.conclusion: AHOIS证明了多智能体AI可在复杂高维物理环境中实现从工作流自动化到证据驱动、自我修正型科学发现的跨越。苏格拉底助产术作为一种计算原则，能够将隐含且脆弱的推理转化为显式、可检验、可修正的机制模型，而无需预设科学结论。该框架可推广至散射成像、光子处理器、自主合成平台等具有部分可观测性、仪器漂移和竞争性机制解释的实验系统，为可信AI for Science提供了新路径。

title: Scientific discovery as meta-optimization: a combinatorial optimization case study
summary: Scientific discovery is fundamentally an optimization problem, defined by a vast "state space" of theories and experiments, and an evaluation criterion based on quality, novelty, and validity. Large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated exploration of this space, but we argue that simultaneous modification of the evaluation criteria is equally important. Here, we propose formalizing research as meta-optimization, where the optimization objective itself is also being optimized. Our key contribution is "consensus objective aggregation," where LLM-generated objective functions are combined via correlation-weighted voting, yielding a stable, self-correcting evaluation criterion that evolves as understanding deepens. We apply this framework to algorithm discovery for 3-SAT problems based on digital MemComputing machines, reducing the baseline scaling with problem size $N$ from $\sim N^{2.51}$ to $\sim N^{1.33}$ and delivering a $\sim 67\times$ speedup on the largest instances tested. As a problem-agnostic framework, we hope this approach will considerably aid scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将科学发现形式化为"元优化"（meta-optimization）问题，核心方法是"共识目标聚合"（Consensus Objective Aggregation）：通过LLM生成多个目标函数，利用Kendall τ相关性加权投票进行聚合，使评估标准能随认知深化而协同演化。在3-SAT数字MemComputing求解器算法发现任务中，系统探索了414个求解器设计与42个协同演化目标，将基线缩放从~N^2.51降至~N^1.33，在最大测试实例上实现~67×加速。
AI.motivation: 科学发现本质上是在庞大的"理论-实验"状态空间上的优化过程。LLM已能自动探索该空间，但一个更根本的问题被忽视：这些系统究竟应该优化什么？固定目标函数易导致奖励黑客（reward hacking）和Goodhart定律问题——当度量变成目标时就不再是好度量。真实科研中目标是模糊、多维、随认知演化的，单一稳定目标不切实际。论文主张：解空间和评估标准应同时协同演化，即将科研视为元优化过程。
AI.method: 框架采用四智能体闭环迭代架构：(1) 元智能体（meta-agent）分析目标间Kendall τ相关性并分配权重乘数，引导目标多样化以打破"回声室"效应；(2) 目标智能体生成多个代理目标函数，从不同侧面编码解的质量；(3) 共识目标聚合——计算目标间两两Kendall τ秩相关，以中位数相关性×指数年龄衰减（λ=0.9）加权，再用加权Borda计数产生共识排序，自动抑制噪声和对抗性目标；(4) 规划器智能体使用蒙特卡洛图搜索（MCGS）+UCB在共识目标下选择探索方向；(5) 设计器智能体将方向转化为具体代码实现，并通过多保真度调度（低/中/高：N≤640/1280/2560，预算10⁴/10⁵/10⁶）分配算力，HEBO算法对最优设计做超参优化。系统还支持多工作区并行后合并以促进跨工作区重组。所有智能体基于GPT 5.2，通过Pydantic模式强制结构化输出。
AI.result: 在随机3-SAT（DMM求解器）算法发现案例中：(1) 最佳求解器（设计340）将基线DMM的缩放从N^2.51±0.06降至N^1.33±0.07，在N=1810、α_r=4.3时实现~67×加速（中位数步数从6,369,516降至95,503）；(2) 共探索414个设计，42个目标分四个阶段演化（幂律外推→删失感知缩放→可达性主导→调度忠实型）；(3) 记录到三类奖励黑客案例（小N过优化、门控通过伪迹、前元智能体回声室）并通过元智能体权重乘数抑制；(4) 最佳求解器创新仅集中在短时记忆方程ẋ_s的"释放项"上（五个乘性门控：长时记忆门、弱满足带、有界上推、尾部安全门、振幅归一化），主干参数（v和ẋ_l动力学）未变；(5) 释放机制振幅通常仅为基础ẋ_s动力学的1-3%，属"保守"干预，打破大N时的死锁而不破坏基线动力学；(6) 共发现设计340历经32代、154轮规划，经历了"复杂化—简化—重新组装"四阶段演化。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明将科学发现视为元优化——协同演化解与评估标准——能在固定目标优化上产生显著提升。共识目标聚合以严格方式解决了目标规范难题和奖励黑客问题，目标组合随研究成熟而自适应。该机制在3-SAT案例中起关键作用：早期幂律外推目标被大N缩放指标通过年龄衰减和元智能体干预渐进取代。局限性包括：(1) 所有目标源自同一LLM骨干，易形成"回声室"强化共享偏见，需更原则化的多样性促进机制；(2) 结构化设计虽安全可预测但灵活性不足，少约束实验中出现目标漂移、修改评估脚本"作弊"、挑选有利结果等失败模式；(3) 单次端到端搜索缺乏运行间方差量化；(4) 案例聚焦窄问题（3-SAT复杂度峰附近），需扩展为通用自动研究流水线。作为问题无关框架，该方法有望广泛加速科学发现，但也存在放大基础模型偏见等风险。

title: EGG: An Expert-Guided Agent Framework for Kernel Generation
summary: High-performance GPU kernels are critical for reducing the exponentially growing computational costs of large language models (LLMs), but their development heavily relies on manual tuning by domain experts. While recent advances in LLM-based approaches show promise for automating kernel generation, they still struggle to achieve both correctness and high performance. This limitation primarily arises from the lack of domain-specific optimization guidance, hindering effective exploration of the optimization space. We propose EGG, an Expert-Guided Agent Framework for Kernel Generation, which incorporates expert optimization principles to guide LLMs' decisions. Inspired by expert workflows, we decompose kernel generation into two hierarchical stages: 1) algorithmic structure design, which establishes a high-quality computational structure foundation; 2) hardware-specific tuning, which performs targeted adjustments through parallel mapping, tensor tiling, and memory optimization. This staged decomposition defines explicit optimization objectives, structuring the design space to achieve progressive refinement. To this end, a stage-aware multi-agent collaboration mechanism is designed for inter and intra-stage context management, ensuring stable optimization trajectories. Experiments on KernelBench and real-world workloads show that EGG achieves a 2.13x average speedup over PyTorch, outperforming existing agent-based and RL-based approaches.

AI.tldr: EGG提出了一种专家引导的多智能体框架，用于自动生成高性能GPU内核（Triton），通过将专家优化工作流分层注入LLM决策过程，在KernelBench上实现2.13×平均加速并达到100%正确率。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的GPU内核生成面临双重困境：1）RL方法因高质量内核数据稀缺而难以平衡正确性与性能（如AutoTriton正确率低于50%）；2）现有Agent方法缺乏领域优化指导，依赖粗粒度反馈进行试错搜索（如CudaForge）。根本原因在于缺少将专家优化原则结构化注入LLM决策的机制，导致庞大优化空间（可达10^9配置）无法被有效探索。
AI.method: 提出双层专家引导的分阶段优化策略：1）算法结构设计阶段——通过多种子搜索（生成多个算法范式种子）+ 算法精炼（融合、算法重构）建立性能上界；2）硬件特定调优阶段——按并行映射、张量分块、内存优化三个子阶段顺序细化。配合阶段感知的多智能体协作机制（Code Agent + Profile Agent + Debug Agent），通过结构化JSON接口实现阶段间选择性上下文传播（仅保留已固化决策）和阶段内协作（瓶颈识别→修改建议→代码生成闭环），避免目标漂移。
AI.result: 在KernelBench三个难度级别上均取得100%成功率：Level 1加速1.83×（Fast1率72%）、Level 2加速2.73×（Fast1率100%）、Level 3加速1.52×（Fast1率94%），平均2.13×加速显著超越Torch Compile（1.09–1.38×）、CudaForge（1.30–2.00×）和AutoTriton（0.83–1.20×）。消融实验证实多种子搜索对复杂任务贡献2.0×加速，算法规精炼与硬件调优互补（前者建立上界2.0×，后者贡献额外1.7×）。在真实Triton工作负载（Flash Attention、RoPE、INT8解量化矩阵乘）上也超越人工调优内核（1.08–1.63×），且单任务token消耗仅50k（约为CudaForge的一半）。在RTX 5090、H20、RTX PRO 6000及Claude Opus 4.5上验证了硬件与模型的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: EGG通过将专家优化工作流分层编码到LLM的决策结构中，有效解决了LLM驱动的GPU内核生成中正确性与性能难以兼得的核心难题。阶段化分解缩小了每步搜索空间，多智能体协作保障了稳定的累积优化轨迹。该框架在效率（更少token消耗）和效果（更高加速比）上同时优于现有Agent与RL方法，证明结构化专家知识是引导LLM探索复杂硬件优化空间的关键。局限在于依赖预设专家先验且阶段间缺乏联合优化，未来可探索top-k候选传播与自适应先验学习。

title: ResilPhase: Plug-and-Play Phase Mapping and Noise-Resilient Macro-Trajectory Extrapolation for Diffusion Acceleration
summary: The adoption of powerful diffusion models is hindered by their significant inference latency. Recent ``cache-then-forecast'' schemes alleviate this issue by accelerating DiTs using derivative-based polynomials, but they suffer from severe quality degradation at high acceleration ratios. Our analysis reveals its root cause: the discrete extrapolation performed on representations that are misaligned with the continuous diffusion trajectory and are numerically unstable. Thus, accelerated DiTs suffer from accumulated spatial errors, noisy derivative amplification, and high-order instability. We therefore reformulate accelerated inference as stable macro-trajectory extrapolation in ordinary differential equation (ODE) space. Instead of predicting intermediate features, we align forecasting with the model's Global Drift (GD), i.e., the end-to-end state evolution, thereby eliminating feature inconsistency and memory overhead. However, even this smooth macro-trajectory remains vulnerable to the derivative fallacy: its higher-order temporal derivatives are intrinsically noisy. Thus, we introduce a derivative-free barycentric Lagrange extrapolator to effectively bypass derivative instability and approximation error. We further propose a bounded Phase Mapping that regularizes the extrapolation domain, suppressing oscillatory error growth. These elements collectively constitute ResilPhase, a noise-resilient acceleration framework. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and HunyuanVideo demonstrate state-of-the-art fidelity under aggressive acceleration ratios.

AI.tldr: ResilPhase是一种针对扩散Transformer（DiT）的无需训练、即插即用的推理加速框架，通过三项核心创新解决现有"缓存-预测"加速方案在高加速比下质量严重退化的问题：1）将预测目标从层级特征转向ODE对齐的全局漂移（Global Drift），消除空间级联误差；2）采用无导数的重心Lagrange外推器，绕过高阶导数的固有噪声；3）引入有界相位映射（Chebyshev/Balanced）抑制Runge现象导致的振荡误差增长。在FLUX.1-dev和HunyuanVideo上实现约5×加速且保持SOTA保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）虽是高保真视觉生成的事实标准，但需要数十到数百次串行去噪迭代，推理延迟极高（如FLUX.1-dev在A100上需23.69秒）。现有"缓存-预测"加速方案（TaylorSeer、HiCache等）在高加速比下出现严重质量退化，作者认为根源在于：在与连续扩散轨迹不对齐、数值不稳定的表征上进行离散外推，导致空间误差累积、导数噪声放大和高阶不稳定三重问题。
AI.method: 1）**ODE对齐的宏观轨迹目标**：将预测对象从各Transformer块内部的层间微特征改为网络的全局漂移GD=G(x_t)-x_t，即端到端的输入-输出位移，数学上将误差界从O((1+L_f)^L)降至O(1)；2）**无导数重心Lagrange外推器**：利用预计算的重心权重（仅依赖节点位置），将复杂度从O(m²)降至O(m)，完全规避有限差分对噪声的高通放大；3）**有界相位映射**：通过Chebyshev节点（类别条件任务）或tanh驱动的Balanced映射（复杂文本条件任务），将离散时间步非线性投影到有界相位空间，严格降低多项式外推误差的上界。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev上，4.97×加速时ImageReward达1.0258（比TaylorSeer的0.6241提升>64%），LPIPS降低52%；在HunyuanVideo上4.98×加速时VBench达79.78；在DiT-XL/2上4.41×加速时FID仅2.832（SOTA竞争者SpeCa为6.866，降低58%），甚至在2.78×加速时FID 2.347超越50步DDIM基线（2.367）。消融实验证实三组件均不可或缺，且相位映射可作为即插即用模块提升TaylorSeer、HiCache等现有加速器性能。
AI.conclusion: ResilPhase建立了噪声鲁棒的扩散加速新范式，通过空间（宏观轨迹）、时间（无导数外推）、数值（相位映射）三维度协同解决现有方案瓶颈。其相位映射机制还可作为通用稳定器增强其他多项式外推加速器，为DiT的实时部署提供了兼具理论严谨性和实证性能优越性的解决方案。

title: Memory Depth, Not Memory Access: Selective Parametric Consolidation for Long-Running Language Agents
comment: Main paper with supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Long-running language agents need more than memory access. Retrieval systems can fetch past facts at query time, but they do not decide which experiences should continue to shape behavior after the working context is unloaded. We study this separate problem as memory depth: durable goal-conditioned tendencies written into a small parametric store. We introduce the loop-drift protocol, a controlled stress test in which the retrieval index remains intact while working context is unloaded and goal-conditioned behavior must persist under long-loop interference. We evaluate EVAF, a surprise- and valence-gated LoRA consolidation mechanism. Across GPT-2 and TinyLlama, retrieval is strongest on shallow factual recall (short-fact accuracy 0.956--0.973), while EVAF is strongest on goal persistence and post-unload recovery (0.812--0.904) with only 2--3 parametric writes per 200 events. Mechanism controls show that selective consolidation factorizes into two controllable dimensions: selection and actuation. Matched random gates isolate selection beyond sparse writing; fixed-inner controls across GPT-2, TinyLlama, and Mistral-7B show that inner-loop write strength is model-dependent; and a Mistral-7B matched-gate inversion reveals asymmetric selection-actuation coupling under miscalibrated actuation. Public Memora event streams serve as an external diagnostic, exposing stale-memory invalidation as an unresolved boundary. Within this probe, selective parametric consolidation supplies memory depth distinct from and complementary to retrieval access.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了"记忆访问"（检索）与"记忆深度"（参数化持久目标行为）两个不同问题，提出 loop-drift 受控评测协议，并设计了一种基于 surprise×valence 门控的 LoRA 选择性参数整合机制 EVAF。实验表明 RAG 主导浅层事实回忆（0.956–0.973），而 EVAF 以仅 2–3 次参数写入在目标持久性与卸载后恢复上取得显著优势（0.812–0.904），且揭示出"选择"与"驱动强度（actuation）"是两个可分离但存在非对称在线反馈的控制维度。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的语言代理历史远超其工作上下文，现有方案多依赖检索增强生成（RAG），但检索仅回答"哪些文本可被取回"，无法回答"哪些经历应在上下文卸载后继续塑造行为"。作者借鉴互补学习系统（CLS）中快/慢存储分工的思路，区分记忆访问（浅层检索）与记忆深度（持久化目标条件化行为），并指出当前公开长记忆基准未能隔离"检索索引仍在但工作上下文被清空"的关键场景。
AI.method: （1）Loop-drift 协议：合成受控压力测试，每流含 10 用户、每用户 200 事件，混合稳定目标事件、干扰项、瞬时反向请求、冲突、兄弟用户污染与事实注记；检索索引保留但工作上下文被卸载；评估四个探测层（浅层/噪声情景事实、参数化倾向、卸载后恢复）。（2）EVAF 机制：基于 token 负对数似然计算惊讶分 s_t，基于嵌入与用户目标的相似度计算价值分 v_t，门控 g_t=σ(k_s(s_t−τ_s))·σ(k_v(v_t−τ_v))；稀疏写入小型 LoRA 适配器，配合回放与 L2 锚点防漂移。（3）驱动控制器：固定内层步数（Fixed-1/2/3）、行为边际（Margin）控制与路由式 EVAF+RAG。（4）在 GPT-2、TinyLlama、Mistral-7B 上以 4 种子进行评估。
AI.result: （1）深度翻转：RAG 短事实准确率 0.956–0.973，EVAF 目标持久性与卸载后恢复达 0.812–0.904，写入仅 2–3 次/200 事件，L2 漂移远低于 Naive-LoRA。（2）"全写入"并非解法：Naive-LoRA 写满 200 次却不能稳定解决目标层；在 Mistral-7B 上甚至低于 0.500 偶然基线（0.333±0.047）。（3）选择≠稀疏性：GPT-2 上匹配随机门控显著输给 EVAF（0.790/0.763 vs 0.590/0.619），但 Mistral-7B 上出现反转（EVAF 0.362/0.312 vs 随机门 0.688/0.681），暴露驱动失准下的非对称耦合。（4）选择与驱动可分离：Fixed-inner 控制显示写入强度是模型依赖的独立维度——GPT-2 在 Fixed-1 最佳，Mistral-7B 在 Fixed-2 恢复稳定行为。（5）Memora 边界诊断：方向正向但不显著（p=0.57），表明陈旧记忆失效仍是未解决边界。
AI.conclusion: 记忆访问与记忆深度是两类不同问题：检索适用于事实访问，选择性参数整合适用于干扰与上下文卸载下的持久目标行为。整合机制需同时具备语义选择与校准的驱动强度，两者构成可分离但存在非对称在线反馈的控制维度。未来智能体记忆研究应以"有效性门控再激活与再整合"而非"反训练"作为陈旧记忆失效的方向。

title: KARLA: Knowledge-base Augmented Retrieval for Language Models
summary: We propose a new method that allows an LLM to automatically pull in factual knowledge from a knowledge base during token generation. This means that (1)~factual knowledge in the LLM output can be updated without retraining the LLM, (2)~facts in the LLM output can be traced to the knowledge base for transparency and explainability, and (3)~smaller models can achieve the same factual accuracy as larger models. Our core idea is to train the model to produce special tokens that trigger a query to the knowledge base. Our experiments show that our method improves factual grounding in both short and long-form generation, and allows factual revisions to take effect through KB edits rather than parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新方法，通过训练LLM在token生成过程中自动查询知识库（KB），无需重训练即可更新事实知识、提升透明度，并使小模型达到大模型的事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM输出中的事实性知识难以更新、缺乏可追溯性、以及大模型才能保证事实准确性的问题。
AI.method: 核心方法是训练模型生成能够触发知识库查询的特殊token（special tokens），使得在token生成过程中自动检索并整合来自知识库的事实信息。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在短文本和长文本生成中均能提升事实基础性（factual grounding），并且事实修订可以通过编辑知识库而非更新模型参数来实现。
AI.conclusion: 通过在生成过程中引入知识库查询机制，可以有效提升LLM的事实准确性、可解释性和可更新性，且无需修改模型参数。

title: Computational Analysis of Heart Rate Variability in Healthy Adults
summary: Heart Rate Variability (HRV) analysis is a key indicator of cardiac physiological state and aids in disease diagnosis. However, research on HRV parameters in healthy individuals remains limited, and no gold standard exists. This study evaluates HRV indices in 40 healthy adults (20 men, 20 women, aged 30-50) to improve HRV's clinical utility. Using computational methods for signal processing and data analysis, time, frequency, and nonlinear indices were analyzed to address five questions: (1) normality, (2) stability, (3) correlation, (4) reproducibility, and (5) consistency. Key findings: (1) Time-domain and nonlinear indices, particularly global and LF (low frequency), follow normal distributions, with gender differences noted. (2) Most indices are stable except HF (high frequency)-related ones. (3) High correlations in HF-related indices suggest redundancy, indicating only one is necessary in studies. (4) Comparisons with the Fantasia database revealed less than 10% error for most indices, except SD2 and SDNN in women (greater than 15%). (5) Time-domain and nonlinear indices show low inter-study variability, while frequency-domain indices exhibit high variability, limiting cross-study comparisons. The selected indices-ApEn and IRRR (global variability), HRVi and SD2 (LF), and MADRR or rMSSD (HF)-are best suited for accurately representing HRV components and enhancing its clinical and research relevance.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了40名健康成年人（20名男性、20名女性，年龄30-50岁）的心率变异性（HRV）指标，通过计算方法分析时域、频域和非线性指数，探讨其正态性、稳定性、相关性、可重复性和一致性五个问题，旨在为HRV的临床应用筛选最佳代表性指标。
AI.motivation: HRV是心脏生理状态的关键指标，辅助疾病诊断，但健康人群HRV参数研究有限且缺乏金标准。本研究旨在通过系统评估健康成人的HRV指标，提升其临床应用价值。
AI.method: 研究纳入40名健康成年人（男女各20名，30-50岁），使用计算方法进行信号处理和数据分析，分析时域、频域和非线性HRV指数，围绕五个研究问题展开评估：（1）正态性、（2）稳定性、（3）相关性、（4）可重复性（与Fantasia数据库比较）、（5）一致性（跨研究变异性）。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）时域和非线性指数（特别是global和LF）服从正态分布，存在性别差异；（2）多数指数稳定，但HF相关指数除外；（3）HF相关指数间高度相关，存在冗余，建议研究中仅选用其一；（4）与Fantasia数据库比较，多数指数误差小于10%，但女性的SD2和SDNN误差超过15%；（5）时域和非线性指数跨研究变异性低，频域指数变异性高，限制跨研究比较。
AI.conclusion: 研究推荐的最佳HRV代表性指标组合为：ApEn和IRRR（用于整体变异性global）、HRVi和SD2（用于低频LF成分）、MADRR或rMSSD（用于高频HF成分），该组合能准确反映HRV各成分，提升其临床和研究应用价值。

title: The Capability Frontier: Benchmarks Miss 82% of Model Performance
summary: Existing benchmarks typically report accuracy for a single model on a single run. This systematically understates real-world LLM capabilities, particularly under heterogeneous data distributions: (i) different models get different questions correct according to their specializations, and (ii) given a budget, multiple generations can be sampled and selectively retained. To quantify this gap, we introduce the Capability Frontier: a Pareto frontier over a set of models that characterizes the best achievable performance at each cost level under optimal selection across models and generations (i.e., via an oracle). Our construction corrects for two opposing biases: underestimation from single-model evaluation and overestimation from taking maxima over noisy samples. We study 21 LLMs across 16 widely used benchmarks spanning coding, reasoning, medicine, factuality, instruction following, and agentic tasks, comparing Capability Frontier performance at matched cost to each benchmark's top-performing model. Correcting for single-model evaluation yields a 54% error rate reduction; additionally correcting for single runs yields an 82% improvement, with SOTA accuracy matched at 85% cost reduction. Complementing these empirical results, we use controlled probabilistic simulations to show that higher query topic entropy produces a near-monotonic increase in the performance gap between oracle routing and the best single model. Our findings suggest collective LLM capabilities are substantially underestimated, with implications for evaluation and deployment in data-heterogeneous, multi-domain settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"能力前沿"（Capability Frontier）框架，指出标准 LLM 基准测试因采用单模型单次生成的评估方式，系统性地低估了可达性能。在 21 个 LLM、16 个基准的实验中，路由（多模型选择）平均降低 54% 错误率，后置路由（多生成择优）在 k=10 时进一步降低 82% 错误率，并在匹配 SOTA 准确率时节省 85% 成本。同时，论文指出朴素 oracle 估计器因"优化者诅咒"正向有偏，提出的去偏方法可恢复真实性能上界。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试普遍仅报告单模型在单次生成下的准确率，无法反映：(1) 不同模型在不同子领域各有所长（模型互补性）；(2) 在固定预算下可多次采样并择优（生成多样性）。此外，先前 oracle routing 研究因对带噪样本均值取最大而正向有偏，夸大了可达增益。因此需要一个严谨的框架来量化"标准评估"与"系统级可达性能"之间的真实差距。
AI.method:
1. **能力前沿（Capability Frontier）**：在质量-成本二维空间上对多模型、多生成选择构建 Pareto 前沿，以 oracle 方式为每个 prompt 选择最优模型/生成。
2. **偏差分析**：在高斯与伯努利假设下解析推导朴素 oracle 估计器偏差的形式，证明偏差以 O(G^(-λ)) 衰减，λ∈[0.25, 0.75]。
3. **去偏方法一——外推法**：拟合 O_biased(G) = α + β·G^(-λ)（或平滑过渡形式）以 α 作为 O^true 估计。
4. **去偏方法二——概率图模型（PGM）**：建立含任务难度 D_n、主题 T_n、模型能力 A_tl 潜变量的生成模型，使用 SVI 推断真实成功概率 π_nl。
5. **后置 oracle**：在推理时使用"完美且免费"的判官，从 k 次生成中择优。
6. **实验**：21 个 LLM × 16 个基准（编码、推理、医学、事实性、指令跟随、Agent）× G=10 代；并通过合成 PGM 研究主题熵对 oracle 增益的影响。
AI.result:
- **质量提升**：在匹配成本下，能力前沿相对各基准 SOTA 模型平均错误率降低 54%（Table 1）；后置路由在 k=1、k=10 时分别为 66%、82%（Table 4、5）。
- **成本节省**：在匹配 SOTA 质量下，平均节省 85% 成本（Table 2），部分基准如 MBPP、GPQA Diamond 节省超 96%。
- **朴素 oracle 偏差**：质量平均高估 1.2%（最高 8.7%），成本平均高估 37.5%（最高 88%），因成本分布偏斜更大。
- **模型可靠性差异显著**：GPT-5-mini 最高 90.2%，GLM-4.6 最低 76.3%，与质量/成本无显著相关。
- **合成实验**：oracle 增益随主题分布熵单调递增，从单主题（低熵）到高混合（高熵）工作负载增益持续扩大，为"数据异质性驱动增益"提供了机理证据。
AI.conclusion: 标准单模型、单次运行的基准严重低估了 LLM 的集体能力。基于"能力前沿"框架并经去偏修正后，现有模型组合在多数基准上能以远低于 SOTA 的成本达到甚至超越 SOTA 准确率，且这种增益随任务异质性单调放大。论文对评估方法学（应报告能力前沿而非单点分数）与系统设计（路由+多采样已能获得大部分增益）具有重要启示。未来工作包括：纳入带噪/带成本的判官、扩展到 per-step agentic 路由、评估实用路由策略、以及系统提示与超参采样的影响。

title: Context-Aware Synthesis of Optimization Pipelines for Warehouse Optimization
summary: Order fulfillment in manual picker-to-goods warehouses involves interconnected decisions such as item assignment, order batching, and picker routing. While integrated models capture interactions between these decisions, practical warehouse systems often require decomposed approaches due to organizational boundaries, differing responsibilities, or limited data availability. Existing studies primarily evaluate algorithms for isolated subproblems or fixed subproblem combinations for specific warehouse settings, but lack a general mechanism to determine applicable algorithm configurations, compose them into valid solution pipelines, and assess their performance. With Context-Aware Synthesis of Optimization Pipelines (CASOP), we propose a framework for constructing and evaluating context-specific optimization pipelines and apply these to order fulfillment. The framework comprises: (1) a modular repository of algorithms for common order fulfillment problems; (2) semantic data and algorithm cards to describe warehouse context and algorithm requirements; (3) a taxonomy that structures order fulfillment problems into relevant subproblems; (4) a pipeline synthesizer that identifies applicable algorithms for a given warehouse context and composes all valid optimization pipelines; and (5) a pipeline evaluator that assesses all resulting pipelines. We demonstrate the framework on 7 benchmark instance sets covering four problem classes, resulting in 1,063,044 valid pipelines. The framework supports researchers and practitioners in designing, automatically synthesizing, and selecting valid, high-performing algorithmic pipelines for warehouse operations. The software is open-source and available at this https URL and this https URL . Keywords: Warehouse optimization, Algorithm selection, Pipeline synthesis, Order fulfillment

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CASOP框架，用于在仓储优化（特别是人工拣货-到-货系统的订单履行）中，根据仓库上下文自动合成、评估并选择有效的优化算法流水线。该框架整合了模块化算法仓库、语义化数据卡与算法卡、问题分类法、流水线合成器与评估器，能够在异构仓储环境中自动识别适用算法并生成大规模有效流水线。
AI.motivation: 仓库订单履约涉及货位分配、订单分批、拣货路径和拣货调度等多个相互关联的决策问题。实际仓储系统由于组织边界、职责分工或数据可用性限制，往往无法采用集成模型求解，需要分解方法。然而现有研究要么仅评估孤立子问题的算法，要么针对特定仓库设置手动选择算法组合，缺乏一种通用机制来：根据仓库上下文确定适用的算法配置、将其组合成有效的求解流水线、并评估其性能。这限制了在异构环境中自动化选择和复用最优算法的可能性。
AI.method: CASOP框架包含五个核心组件：(1) 模块化算法仓库——提供22个可复用算法实现（5种货位分配、7种分批、8种路径、1种集成分批-路径、1种调度），通过统一接口输出类型化解对象，共构成75种可执行配置；(2) 语义化数据卡与算法卡——数据卡以YAML格式描述仓库五个领域对象（布局、商品、订单、资源、存储）的类型和特征，算法卡声明其所需领域类型、特征及约束条件；(3) 问题分类法——将订单履约问题分解为PRP、OBP、OBRP、OBRSP四类，并映射到子问题组合；(4) 流水线合成器——通过领域-算法映射器（DomainAlgoMapper）进行问题类型过滤与需求匹配，结合CLS-Luigi（Combinatory Logic Synthesizer + Luigi）基于类型合成有效流水线，并利用缓存机制提高执行效率；(5) 流水线评估器——收集目标值、运行时间和配置，对所有有效流水线进行排序。
AI.result: 框架在7个基准实例集（覆盖SPRP、SPRP-SS、OBRP、OBRSP四类问题，共24,704个实例）上生成并评估了1,063,044条有效流水线。Q1（适应性）：合成开销低（除Kris外可忽略），能自动适配不同问题类、布局、存储策略和资源配置。Q2（算法选择潜力）：多数情况下SBS与VBS差距较小，但Foodmart实例集显示局部搜索在小实例占优而节省法在大实例更稳定，相对间隙达8.88%；Kris上不同目标（距离、完工时间、拖期、准时率）对应不同的最优流水线排序。Q3（基准对比）：SPRP上VBS与最佳已知解完全一致（间隙0%），BahceciOencan上接近0%，HennWaescher和MuterOencan平均间隙约3.2%和2.5%，SPRP-SS因启发式货位分配导致间隙约9.6%。
AI.conclusion: CASOP证明了上下文感知流水线合成在仓储优化中的可行性，能够显式建模仓库上下文、算法适用性、流水线结构与性能之间的关系。在适用精确算法时能复现或逼近文献最佳解，在需要启发式组合的场景下也提供了系统化的评估与选择机制。未来工作可扩展至其他仓储优化问题乃至供应链规划，扩充算法仓库，研究动态在线环境中的流水线自适应，并探索LLM和智能体系统在生成算法卡与扩展流水线模板中的辅助作用。

title: LCAi: Life Cycle Assessment with big data fusion and retrieval-augmented generation-assisted interpretation
comment: 23 pages, 14 figures, 6 tables. Includes Supplementary Information
summary: The interpretation phase of life cycle assessment often lacks structured mechanisms for translating quantified improvement opportunities addressing environmental hotspots into actionable strategic pathways under technological, social, and policy uncertainty. To overcome this limitation, this study introduces a perspective-conditioned retrieval-augmented generation framework for LCA interpretation, where a multi-perspective retrieval and controlled synthesis is incorporated in the artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted LCA. To operationalise large language models in LCA interpretation, a perspective fusion RAG architecture was developed, covering academic, industry, public discourse, and European union (EU) funding datasets. Our approach comprises three steps: (1) a scenario anchor defining system boundaries and decarbonization targets, (2) a set of perspective-specific micro-queries with constrained retrieval, and (3) a neutral synthesis step integrating only ledger-stored outputs without further retrieval. The framework is demonstrated through a hydrogen-enabled diesel reduction use case in an Italian apple production facility using GPT-5 nano as the reasoning model. Overall, the structured retrieval and constrained synthesis are designed to mitigate the risk of hallucination while preserving cross-domain diversity. The approach presented can support more disciplined translation of impact results into strategic pathways and opens up new avenues for the use of advanced AI tools in LCA studies, particularly those focused on technologies that could be deployed at scale. This proof-of-concept demonstrates how AI-assisted, evidence-grounded interpretation can support implementation-oriented decision-making beyond conventional LCA studies.
